description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Skärholmen, offering races for all ages, from a Mini Race for the youngest participants to a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over. The race is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works with young people in Sweden’s Million Programme suburbs. There is music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a specially designed medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, uplifting fitness festival that encourages exercise and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over
Lilla Skärholmsloppet: approximately 1.6 km for children from preschool class to Year 6
Mini Skärholmsloppet: 500 metres for children aged 0–6
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Music and DJs along the course. A medal for everyone who completes the race. The entry fee includes a race bib, medal, fruit and drink. Lilla Skärholmsloppet has start times divided by school year, with colour-coded start groups. The Mini Race is 500 metres and can be run together with a parent. Late registration may be available at race-bib collection on 15 May and on race day, subject to availability. The race centre at SKHLM offers race-bib collection and bag storage; late registration may be available subject to availability. The recommended route is the red line 13 metro to Skärholmen. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the sources provided.

name: Borgarloppet Trail Race
location: NIK Arena (Näsvikens skidstadion), Näsviken, Hudiksvall Municipality, Sweden
description: Borgarloppet is a scenic trail race along the Borgarleden trail between the Dellen lakes, finishing at NIK Arena in Näsviken. The course features varied terrain, with a long climb at the start, followed by a downhill section, an easier middle section and a challenging finish with technical trails and steep hills. Participants in the 13 km class are bussed to the starting point, and there are several water stations along the course. After the race, kolbulle and a well-stocked coffee table are offered to everyone except the children’s class, which receives cordial, a bun, a banana and a medal at the finish.
course_highlights: The course follows the Borgarleden trail, with beautiful views over the southern part of Lake Dellen
The terrain includes a long climb, downhill running, and technical trails with steep hills
Water stations are located at 6.2 km, 9.9 km, 13.8 km and 18.7 km
additional: Start and finish at NIK Arena (Näsviken ski stadium). The 13 km starting point is at Simabobacken; participants are bussed from the ski stadium to the start. Online registration closes on Thursday evening before race day. After that, on-site registration is available until one hour before the start, with payment by Swish only. Race bibs are collected on site. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women’s and men’s classes, and to everyone in the children’s class. The cutoff is at Borgarberget (19 km) after 3:30 hours. Start and finish at NIK Arena (Näsviken ski stadium). Participants in the 13 km classes are bussed to the start at Simabobacken. In 2026, kolbulle and a coffee table at the finish were included in the entry fee, except for the children’s class.

name: Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka
description: Kilsbergen Out & Back is a unique and friendly trail run in Ånnaboda, near Örebro, where participants choose their own distance by running one, two or all three out-and-back routes. The race offers hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections and beautiful trails. Everyone starts at the same time from the same place, creating a social and relaxed atmosphere throughout the day. After finishing, participants are served a simple hot meal, with a vegetarian option.
course_highlights: Three out-and-back routes of 10 km, 26 km and 54 km
Hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections
The Bergslagsleden Trail, with a turnaround point at the Rusakulan viewpoint
additional: The maximum number of participants is 100. Bibs can be collected from 08:00 at the race centre. The start, finish and race centre are at the warming hut by the artificial snow ski track in Ånnaboda. Toilets are available in the area; changing facilities and showers are at the SM hut by the lower car park. Trail shoes with good grip are recommended. Runners must carry all their own equipment and fuel; there is no support along the course. The race centre will have an aid station with water, sports drink, bananas, sweets, crisps, buns and more. Runners may leave their own drop bags there. Parking is recommended at the lower car park, with signs directing you to the race centre. The organiser’s information lists the start time as 09:00, a maximum of 100 participants and the final registration date as 15 May. Runners are responsible for their own equipment and fuel; support is permitted only at the race centre. Trail shoes with good grip are recommended.

name: Hälleforsterrängen
description: Hälleforsterrängen is a running race organized by Hällefors Running Club and held in Hällefors. The race is part of the club’s annual competition program and welcomes runners of different age groups and ability levels. The club provides financial support to members taking part in running races and encourages carpooling and wearing club clothing. Hälleforsterrängen offers a great opportunity to run in scenic surroundings and take part in a well-organized local running event.
additional: The club reimburses entry fees and mileage expenses for children, young people and juniors at running races, as well as 50% of the entry fee for seniors and veterans in races in Närkes Långloppscup. Wearing club clothing is required to receive reimbursement. Carpooling is recommended. The club also reimburses the entry fee, accommodation, mileage expenses and food for participation in Vasastafetten. Previous editions have included 5 km, 10 km and children’s races. This information applies to 2026 and does not confirm the format for 2027.

name: Örbyhus half-marathon (10K) - Örbyhus
location: Örbyhus, Tierp Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden

name: Kajenloppet
organizer: Nacka Hockey Friidrott i samarbete med Kajen i Nacka Strand
description: Kajenloppet is a running experience along the waterfront in Nacka Strand, suitable for the whole family. The race is organised by Nacka Hockey Friidrott in collaboration with Kajen in Nacka Strand, with a focus on the joy of movement, community and local engagement. The course offers beautiful views of the inlet and takes runners past Svindersvik and around Kvarnholmen before the finish at Kajen. There are distances for everyone, from children’s races to longer routes, and the event is a lively celebration full of energy and spectators.
course_highlights: Run along the waterfront with views of the inlet
The course passes Svindersvik and loops around Kvarnholmen
Start and finish at Kajen in Nacka Strand
additional: The 400 m children’s race starts at 10:30, and the 1,200 m children’s race starts at 11:30. Kajenloppet is a lively celebration full of energy, spectators and community. Kajen also offers activities such as mini golf and pétanque near the event area. Previous editions have included 6 km and 10 km races as well as children’s races; distances and arrangements may vary from year to year.

name: Adelsö ultra
description: A new ultratrail race on Adelsö on 16 May 2027. Adelsö is one of the Mälaren islands on the outskirts of Stockholm. We have worked hard on the course and are proud to present a scenic marathon-distance XL that combines coastline and technical forest trails with 600 metres of climbing. Beyond the natural experience, the race offers a journey through historically significant landscapes, which we have made an effort to highlight along the route. One of the most exciting ultraraces in Stockholm in spring 2027 for those who love trail running.

name: Vårruset Stockholm
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Vårruset Stockholm is a popular spring running event held on Norra Djurgården, with distances of 2.5 and 5 km. The event offers a lovely spring evening with timing, a medal, a finish-line goodie bag, and a music quiz with prizes. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggan/Universitetet, and the event has a friendly atmosphere, with teams able to enjoy a picnic after finishing. This recreational race welcomes both individual runners and teams, with a focus on fun and community.
course_highlights: Course on Norra Djurgården, starting on Fiskartorpsvägen
Distance options of 2.5 km and 5 km; the 5 km course is officially measured
Start and finish on the grass area at Stora Skuggan/Universitetet
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register early; otherwise, they must be collected on site. Teams consist of 5 people and receive a picnic after finishing. Changing rooms and showers are available for a fee at Frescati Sports Center. The event area is easily accessible by public transport and bicycle. Parking is limited and subject to a fee.

name: Namdalskarusellen 2027 løp 4 - 3000m

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 80 ,- (+ lisens) for enkeltløp i karusellen.

description: The Namdalskarusellen is a race series organized by Namdal Running Club in Trøndelag, focused on the joy of running and giving your best. Race 4 in 2027 is a 3000-metre road race at Svenningmoen Stadium in Overhalla, where participants run 7.5 laps around the athletics track. The series offers a participation prize to those who complete at least four of the eight races, and has age-group categories to ensure fair competition.
course_highlights: 7.5 laps around the athletics track at Svenningmoen Stadium
Road race in Overhalla, Trøndelag
Participation prize: porcelain mug for taking part in 4 of 8 races
additional: Age-group categories: 12–14, 15–17, 18–22, 23–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75+. A porcelain mug participation prize is awarded to those who take part in at least 4 of the 8 races in the Namdalskarusellen.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten takes place on Wednesday, 20 May 2026, in Folkparken in Norrköping. Four people form a team and take turns walking, jogging or running a lively 4 km leg each. There are classes with and without timing, and the race is promoted as an accessible, festive relay for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and young people can take part completely free of charge, and there is special information for schools.

name: Vårruset (Falun)
description: Vårruset is Sweden’s largest recreational running tour for women—a fun and welcoming spring evening where participants can run, jog or walk 2.5 or 5 km. The event tours 19 cities from 4 May to 4 June 2026, and Falun is one of the locations. All participants receive, among other things, a medal and a race bib, while teams of five are rewarded with a picnic after finishing. The race has been held since 1989 and is aimed at recreational runners of different ages, in line with the recommendations for each distance.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is a 5 km running race starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race offers a pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the entire course, making it a popular running event. Participants can run individually or in teams of at least five people, with the team result based on the five fastest runners. The 2.5 km lap is run twice, with the start, lap point and finish in Stadsparken. Race bibs are distributed well before the start, with the option to collect them the day before or on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km course in central Västervik, starting and finishing in Stadsparken
The 2.5 km lap is run twice
Pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the entire course
additional: Race bibs are distributed before 17:30 on race day. Teams receive their race bibs together in one envelope. Race bibs can be collected on Tuesday 18 May at Intersport from 11:00 to 14:00, or on Wednesday 19 May at the stage in Stadsparken from 12:00. You can participate individually or in a team of at least five people; the five fastest times are added together.

description: Blodomloppet in Linköping is a recreational race that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race is open to both individuals and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, and participants can choose different distances within the same team. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity that ends with a large picnic and has a strong focus on attracting new blood donors. Youth teams receive a discount, and blood donors are offered a special discount on the entry fee. Participants also have the opportunity to travel free on public transport in Östergötland on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances for women and men
The race takes place in Linköping, with the start and finish in central areas
Water stations are located along the course
additional: All participants who register by 14 May and provide a mobile phone number will receive a ticket link by text message for 6 hours of free public transport in Östergötland on 21 May. Team registration is for 3–5 people, and teams always pay for 5 even if they have fewer members. Bib pickup and late registration are available at several locations in the days before the race. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person, both for individual and team entries. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. Registration for 2027 opens in a few weeks, according to the organizer’s website.

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden’s largest women’s fitness tour and takes place on Thursday, May 21, 2026, starting at 19:00 at Lögastrand. The event offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and is suitable for both experienced runners and those who want to jog or walk. Everyone who registers individually receives a medal, a finish-line goody bag, and a race number; teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. Timing is available for the 5 km distance, but can be opted out of during registration if you do not want your result published.

description: Stigtomtaloppet is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta, welcoming all age groups and runners, from children to adults, including a new dog category. The race offers distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km on a mix of paved roads, forest trails and residential streets. It is a popular recreational race that also features team competitions with a picnic after the race, bringing participants together. Since starting in 2012, the race has grown to become the largest in the Nyköping region and is known for its friendly, inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course on paved roads, forest trails and residential streets
Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill
Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish
additional: Start and finish at ICA Nära in Stigtomta. Participant bags with race bibs and timing chips must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. Team competitions have a mass start and include a picnic basket (no special diets). The dog category has its own start time and prize table. A refreshment tent serving fika and accepting card payments is available. Parking with guidance and bicycle parking are available. Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill. Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish.

name: Sidsjö Trail
organizer: Sidsjö Böle IF P-14 tillsammans med morron
description: Sidsjö Trail is a challenging and fun trail race set in the scenic surroundings of Sidsjön and Södra Berget in Sundsvall. The race offers several distances, from a 1 km children’s race to 12 km, and is suitable for both seasoned trail runners and beginners looking to test their limits. The courses feature varied terrain, beautiful views, forests and lakes, with nature at the heart of the experience. The event is documented with photos and video, and children receive a Kexchoklad wafer bar at the finish. Sidsjö Trail is organized by the local football team Sidsjö Böle IF P-14 together with morron, helping support the team’s activities and community involvement.
course_highlights: A trail race through varied natural surroundings around Sidsjön and Södra Berget
Beautiful views, forests and lakes along the course
Distances include a 1 km children’s race, 3 km, 6 km and 12 km

name: Tolvanloppet 12km
description: Tolvanloppet is a city race with a friendly, charming atmosphere and events for all ages (in 2026, participants ranged from 2 to 98 years old). Adults can choose between two distances, the main event being 12 km (the shorter distance is 6 km). The course winds through the old residential neighborhoods of Bromma and is described as beautiful but challenging, with quite a few hills. Along the route, expect plenty of support from residents, including their own water stations (in addition to the course’s four official ones) and refreshing sprinklers. All this makes the race Stockholm’s most charming street race.

name: Ludvika stadslopp
description: Ludvika Stadslopp is an annual running festival that brings together elite runners and recreational runners in Ludvika. The start and finish are at Charlie Normans Square, centrally located between the railway station and the marina. The event is characterized by large crowds, many participants, and a wide range of activities for all ages. Together with partners and volunteers, it creates a wonderful atmosphere of health, exercise, and community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Charlie Normans Square in Ludvika
A route through the central parts of the town, near the railway station and marina
Large numbers of participants and crowd support create a festive atmosphere
additional: The event has over 1,100 registered participants and offers activities for both young and old. Thanks go to the participants, spectators, volunteers, and partners who make this well-run and popular running festival possible. Information about the start location and event format comes from previous editions and has not been confirmed for 2027.

name: Luleå Stadsmara
description: Luleå Stadsmara is a classic recreational race held at the university campus in Porsön, Luleå. The race is aimed particularly at upper secondary school students and offers a spectator-friendly 10 km course that passes through Mjölkudden, the city centre, Lulsundet and Björkskatan before returning to the university. After finishing, participants receive fruit and drinks and have the chance to win great raffle prizes. Timing is done with a chip, and results are reported live online.
course_highlights: Start at the university campus in Porsön
The course passes through Mjölkudden, the city centre, Lulsundet and Björkskatan
A spectator-friendly course, with fruit and drinks after the finish
additional: Race bibs are collected inside Stil Sportcenter, Universitetsvägen 11C, 977 54 Luleå. Registration is through PE teachers. Chip timing and net time. Live results online. Race bibs are collected at the reception of StiL Sportcenter, and timing is done with a chip. Late registration is stated to cost an extra 50 kr.

name: Uka Pain
description: Uka Pain is a series of challenging trail races in Älvdalen, offering distances from 12 km up to 100 miles. The races feature spectacular scenery, high mountain peaks and technical trails, making them one of Sweden’s major autumn running experiences. The start and finish are at Hotell Älvdalen, which also serves as the hub for the race and support. The longest distance, 100 miles, features a unique course consisting of three laps of the 50 km course, with spectacular views from several mountain peaks.
course_highlights: The course passes three of Älvdalen’s highest peaks: Hykjeberg, Skärklitt and Väsaberget
Technical trails and varied terrain, with approximately 1,500 metres of elevation gain on the 52 km course
Start and finish at Hotell Älvdalen, with spa and sauna access available to 100-mile participants
additional: Start and finish at Hotell Älvdalen. Bib pickup at The Running Company near Hotell Älvdalen. Drop bags are permitted for the 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile races, with a maximum size of 60x40x40 cm. Mandatory equipment requirements apply to the 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile races. A bus is provided for 100-mile participants from Hotell Älvdalen to the start at Boggberget. Maximum time limits: 28 km – 10 hours, 50 km – 12 hours, 100 km – 22 hours, 100 miles – 34 hours. A T-shirt is included for registrations made by 30 April. A finisher’s medal is exclusive to the 100-mile race. Spa and sauna access for 100-mile participants. The race takes place on 28–29 May 2027. Bibs can be collected at The Running Company, Dalgatan 81F. Bring your own cup for the aid stations; a participant T-shirt is included for those who register by 30 April 2027.

name: VirsboRUN
description: VirsboRUN is a trail race featuring a varied and exciting course in an untouched nature reserve, partly through Hälleskogsbrännan, the site of a 2014 forest fire. The race offers several distances, from 5.3 km up to a challenging half marathon of 21.2 km, with 101 metres of elevation gain per lap. There is also a free children’s race of approximately 800 metres, suitable for the whole family. The start and finish are at Skräddartorpet, where participants can enjoy medals, freshly grilled hamburgers and a wonderful atmosphere. Everyone is welcome to take part and experience the beautiful, challenging terrain, whatever their age or experience.
course_highlights: Trail race in an untouched nature reserve, with sections through Hälleskogsbrännan, the site of a 2014 forest fire
5.3 km loop with 101 metres of elevation gain per lap
Children’s race of approximately 800 metres, starting and finishing at Skräddartorpet
additional: Start and finish at Skräddartorpet. Warm-up with music and a course presentation before the start. Maximum of four laps (21.2 km), with a time limit of 3 hours. An extra water station is located at approximately the halfway point. A relay option is available for families with children. Race numbers are handed out at the start. The children’s race is not officially timed, and all participants receive a medal and a surprise bag. Freshly grilled hamburgers are available in the finish area after the race. A free children’s race of approximately 800 metres is offered.

name: Å-Varvet
description: Å-Varvet is a classic running race in Eskilstuna, offering a scenic and varied course along the water and through the city’s parks. The race is popular with both elite runners and recreational runners, with a great atmosphere and crowd support along the entire route. It’s a perfect event for anyone looking to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings while enjoying Eskilstuna’s charm.
course_highlights: The course runs along Eskilstuna’s waterways and through its parks
Varied terrain with both asphalt and gravel
Crowd support along the entire course
additional: The distance is 10,549 metres.

name: Bėgimo varžybos Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio r. Kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams laimėti
organizer: Kupiškio r. kūno kultūros ir sporto centras
description: The running competition for the prizes of Pavel Fedorenka and the Kupiškis District Physical Education and Sports Centre invites participants to register and compete. The event is held in Kupiškis to promote sporting activity and community spirit. It is a great opportunity to test your abilities and enjoy running in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The event is open to all age groups
Compete for prizes from Pavel Fedorenka and the Kupiškis District Physical Education and Sports Centre
Location: Kupiškis, Lithuania
additional: The event will take place on May 29, 2027. Registration is available online and via social media.

name: Stadionloppet
description: Stadionloppet is a family-friendly running event held at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The main race is 5 km long and takes place on a scenic two-lap course created by Kalle Berglund. The event is marked by a wonderful sense of community, where children, young people and adults can all take part and cheer one another on. The start, lap point and finish are at the beautiful stadium, offering a unique running experience in a setting where the buzz of the city meets greenery and birdsong.
course_highlights: 5 km two-lap course around Stockholm Olympic Stadium
Course created by Kalle Berglund, a former world-class runner
Start, lap point and finish at Stockholm Olympic Stadium
additional: All members of Djurgården Friidrott run for free and receive a registration code when they join. Several shorter distances are available for children and young people. Members can also take part as volunteers and be part of the event. Start times and categories are preliminary and may change. Stadiongirot, a cycling race held in collaboration with Djurgården Cykel, also takes place on the same day. Members of Djurgården Friidrott can run for free with a registration code. Distance and category details for 2027 are preliminary and may change. Free trial training on the course is held ahead of the race.

description: Blodomloppet in Umeå is a recreational event that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event is open to participants of all ages and abilities, including children and teams, and ends with a shared picnic. It is a social and healthy activity that promotes community and wellbeing while supporting a good cause. Blodomloppet is part of Sweden’s largest recreational running event, with a strong focus on blood donation and health.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses in Umeå
The children’s race, Lilla Blodomloppet
Shared picnic after the race
additional: Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected at IFK Umeå’s club premises on 21–22 May and 24 May, and at Väven on 25 May. Teams of at least 5 people receive a picnic bag. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. Registration changes are free of charge until 21 May; after that, changes require an in-person visit and cost SEK 50. An order ID is required to collect race bibs. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. The last day to register a team and receive the picnic bag offer is 18 May. Individual registration is stated to be available until 25 May.

You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either on your own or together with colleagues and friends. The event is part of Sweden’s largest fun run series, with a strong focus on health and social connection, and traditionally ends with a large picnic. Blodomloppet is open to everyone and promotes a healthy lifestyle while supporting youth activities in the organizing clubs.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km and 10 km courses
Lilla Blodomloppet for children
Water stations along the course
additional: The event offers discounted team registration and an Excel template for large groups. Changing facilities, toilets, storage, water stations and medical assistance are available on site. After the event, participants can enjoy a large picnic. The main races start at 18:30. The event is organized by Strands IF Friidrott together with GeBlod Gävleborg. Timed 5 km and 10 km races are available. Lilla Blodomloppet is available for children.

name: Vårruset Karlstad
organizer: Vårruset i samarbete med IF Göta Karlstad
description: Vårruset in Karlstad is a popular spring running event offering a lovely, friendly running experience for women of all ages. The race follows a 5 km course, with both timed and untimed participation options. After the finish, teams of five are treated to a picnic, creating a pleasant opportunity to socialize. The event area is located between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet, and the organizer encourages participants to travel to the start in an environmentally friendly way.
course_highlights: 5 km course, timed or untimed
Start and finish in the area between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Bergvik in the days before the event and at the venue from 15:00 on race day. Race information is sent out about one week before the event. There is a supervised area where participants can leave their warm-up clothes before the start. The organizer recommends cycling or taking public transport to the event area. City buses are free upon presentation of a race bib or race information. Teams consist of 5 people and must be complete no later than one month before the event to receive picnic vouchers. Changing rooms are available at Sundsta Sports Hall. Teams registered with five people receive a picnic after the finish. Individual participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag, and a race bib.

name: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp

price_tiers.distance: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp (7 km) och AktivRundan (3,8 km)

description: Gladsheim Finspång City Race is an annual fun run through beautiful Finspång, starting and finishing in Bruksparken. The race offers a 7-kilometre course with smooth, even surfaces, ideal for both runners and recreational participants. For a shorter challenge, there is AktivRundan, approximately 3.8 kilometres with no timing, and children can take part in XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan, a 1.7-kilometre route through an easy-to-run park setting. All participants receive a medal and energy products, and there are great prizes to be won. The race is open to everyone, whether they walk, jog or run.
course_highlights: 7 km course with smooth, even surfaces through central Finspång
AktivRundan: 3.8 km without timing for walkers and joggers
XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan: 1.7 km for children through an easy-to-run park setting
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday, 26 May, between 15:00 and 19:00. Late registration is available at the bib collection point and at the start and finish area from 15:00 on race day. Timing uses a chip on the race bib tab; without it, no time will be recorded. The children’s race has four start times between 17:00 and 18:00, depending on age group. All participants receive a medal, energy products and a water bottle sponsored by local businesses. The children’s race prize-giving takes place on the stage in Bruksparken at 18:15. The race’s official website currently provides information about the 2026 edition; prices and practical details for 2027 have not been specified.

The race is open to everyone, whether taking part alone or with colleagues and friends. There are also special races, including Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet, for different ages and abilities. Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that ends with a shared picnic and helps promote blood donation and youth sports in the region.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is officially measured and runs through Uppsala
The 5 km and 2.5 km courses are popular but not officially measured
Option to participate as a team of 5
additional: Team registration for 5 people is available. An Excel template for large registrations can be downloaded. The 10 km course is officially measured, while the 5 km and 2.5 km distances are approximate. Dogs are welcome to participate. A shared picnic is offered after the race. Water stations are located along the course. Changing facilities and toilets are available. Medical services are on site. Race bibs are distributed before the start. The race highlights the importance of blood donation.

name: Bėgimas „Kutaliai – Kaltinėnai“
description: The “Kutaliai–Kaltinėnai” run is a traditional cross-country race held to commemorate the 141st anniversary of the birth of Aleksandras Stulginskis, President of the Republic of Lithuania, and the Day of the Constituent Seimas. The race takes place over hilly terrain, encouraging physical activity and respect for sport. The start is in Kutaliai village, and the finish is at the stadium of Aleksandras Stulginskis Gymnasium in Kaltinėnai, Šilalė District. The event is for athletes from city and district schools and anyone else who meets the health requirements.

description: Blodomloppet in Örebro is a fun run that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run with friends, family or colleagues. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, Specialomloppet and Lilla Blodomloppet for children. It is a social, healthy activity that also promotes team spirit and wellbeing, with the option to take part in teams of five. After the race, participants often gather for a picnic, and the event area is well equipped for an enjoyable day for the whole family.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses for women and men
Specialomloppet, approximately 2.1 km
Lilla Blodomloppet: approximately 750 m or 2.1 km for children aged 1–12
additional: You can register individually or as a team of five, with the option to fill vacant places later. Discounts are available for blood donors and ICA Stammis members (SEK 40), but not during late registration. There is no age limit for the 5 km and 10 km distances, but participants should be able to complete the course on their own or accompanied by an adult. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children aged 1–12, and adults may accompany them as long as they do not disturb others. A large picnic is offered to participants after the race. You can use your wellness allowance when registering. The race takes place at Trängens IP. You can register individually or as a team of five. Participants receive, among other things, a T-shirt, race bib and medal; prices vary depending on the distance and registration date.

name: Vårruset
organizer: Marathongruppen, tillsammans med Hässelby SK, Spårvägens FK och lokal arrangör KFUM Örebro Friidrott

tiers.description: Vill du ha det bästa priset? Du vinner på att anmäla dig tidigt!

description: Vårruset in Örebro is a popular spring running event offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km on a course measured for accuracy. The race is open to all ages, with a recommended minimum age of 7 for the shorter distance when accompanied by an adult, and 11 for the longer distance. Participants receive a medal, a race bag, a race number, and the option of timekeeping for the 5 km. Teams that register are offered a shared picnic after the finish, creating a lovely social spring evening at Gustavsviksbadet. The event is all about community and enjoyment, with activities and a music quiz for participants.
course_highlights: Course measured for accuracy: 5 km
Start and finish at Gustavsviksbadet
Water station and toilets at the event area
additional: Race-number collection takes place at Intersport Marieberg in the days leading up to the race. Picnic for teams of 5 after the finish. The event area is at Gustavsvik Camping, where parking is limited; participants are encouraged to travel in an environmentally friendly way. Changing at home is recommended. A water station and toilets are available on site. Participants can leave warm-up clothes in a bag marked with their name and race number. Race information is sent by email approximately two weeks before the event. Timekeeping is available as an optional extra for the 5 km. For the 2.5 km, the recommended minimum age is 11, or 7 when accompanied by an adult; for the 5 km, the recommended minimum age is 13, or 11 when accompanied by an adult. Information for Örebro 2027 has not been confirmed in the sources.

name: 3. Benno Viirandi nimeline rahvajooks
description: The 3rd Benno Viirand Memorial Fun Run is a family-oriented running and Nordic walking event held in Mustla. The race follows a 5 km course, starting near the Vambola bus stop in Soe village and finishing at the Tarvastu Gymnasium stadium. The event aims to honour the memory of the legendary runner Benno Viirand and promote running as a healthy way to spend time. In addition to the main race, free children’s races are held at the stadium. Participants are provided with race numbers and can register in advance or in person on race day.

name: adidas Shake Out Run
description: The adidas Shake Out Run is a 5 km race starting and finishing at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. It’s a perfect warm-up for participants running the Stockholm Marathon the following day, as well as an opportunity for other runners to experience the unique marathon atmosphere during the event weekend. The first 1,000 people to register will receive an adidas T-shirt in their chosen size to run in, distributed at the event. After the race, people who register later can also collect T-shirts in the remaining sizes.
course_highlights: 5 km distance, starting and finishing at Stockholm Olympic Stadium
The race serves as a warm-up for the Stockholm Marathon
A unique marathon atmosphere during the event weekend
additional: Age limit: 13 years (11 years when accompanied by a parent or guardian). Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start. Payment options include online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, and invoice via Klarna. The event is organised by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK. The age limit is 13 years, or 11 years when accompanied by a parent or guardian. Late registration can be completed online until one hour before the first start.

name: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve
description: The 55th Arco Vara Run Around Lake Harku is a traditional 6.5 km running race taking place on 30 May 2026 at Lake Harku beach. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its second event. There are refreshment points along the course, which is marked and secured by a course marshal team. In addition to runners, Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome; they start in the last group. The event centre is at the start/finish area, where race numbers are also issued and awards presented.

name: Koeru kergejõustikuvõistlused
description: Koeru Athletics Competition is a traditional track and field event held at the Koeru Secondary School stadium. Men and women compete in two age groups and take part in several events, including the 100 m run, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw, and 1000 m run. The winner is determined by adding the points from their three best events. The competition is open to everyone, and participants may enter all events. Young athletes use throwing implements appropriate for their age group.

name: Maardu kevadjooks
description: Maardu Spring Run and Health Walk is a traditional sports day held in Maardu, bringing together people of all ages who enjoy being active. The event features several runs and health walks for different age groups and abilities, including children’s runs, a youth run, a walk for people with special needs, and 3 km and 5 km runs. Participation is free, and every finisher receives a medal. The event aims to offer the joy of movement, a sense of well-being, and an active day outdoors, while highlighting time spent together with family and friends.

name: adidas Stockholm Marathon
description: The adidas Stockholm Marathon is a classic marathon that takes place this year on 30 May 2026 and attracts both elite and recreational runners. The race is 42,195 metres long, measured according to current regulations, and follows a new course through central Stockholm. The event is organised by athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the organisers highlight extensive runner services along the course. The race starts at Stockholm Olympic Stadium and offers seeding opportunities through events including adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan.
course_highlights: 42,195 metres, measured according to the Swedish Athletics Association and IAAF
New course through central Stockholm (including Sveavägen and Kungsgatan), passing through the city
World-class runner services along the entire course
additional: Start and finish area: Lidingövägen outside the clock tower at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The race starts in two waves, at 12:00 and 12:10. The marathon time limit is 6.5 hours, and there are four checkpoints with cut-off times along the course. Seeding: the deadline for submitting a time for seeding is 3 May 2026; adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan count towards seeding. adidas Premiärmilen (10 km) takes place in Norra Djurgården, has a total elevation gain of 117 m, mixed surfaces and a provisional start time of 11:00; the time limit is 2 hours and the contact for Premiärmilen is info@premiarmilen.se. The event is organised by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the website is provided by Marathongruppen i Stockholm AB. The event is sold out for 30 May 2026. The course runs through central Stockholm and finishes at Stockholm Olympic Stadium; runners can also take part in related Adidas events such as Premiärmilen, Premiärhalvan and Shake Out Run.

name: Backyard Ultra Vänge
description: The loop is a real gem, if we may say so ourselves—a slice of Uppland at its best. The race hub is High Chaparral Park, with its large green spaces: a natural race base in the heart of the community of Vänge. Backyard Ultra Vänge will draw spectators along the course, which awaits you dressed in lovely spring attire. We have taken care to create a varied and somewhat challenging course. The result is an experience where something is always happening and the running never gets monotonous. Large parts of the race take place on the slightly bumpy trail on the outskirts of the community. You’ll feel as if you’re flying over soft ground beneath big trees and past colossal rocks. Several national-team runners began their running careers here, and many prominent floorball players have sweated through hard training sessions. An oasis in the forest—with a glimpse of Highway 72. A road tunnel takes you beneath the highway and into the unique Uppland rowing village of Vänge-Ekeby. The village, which has been a listed building since 1998, has medieval origins and a preserved village layout. Vänge Hembygdsförening has given the village an active cultural life and attracted many visitors. The course winds through this fantastic setting. Take the opportunity to enjoy the atmosphere and a glimpse of society as it once was. Then it’s back beneath the highway and into the forest on small trails. Before you know it, you’re back in the community and looping around High Chaparral. Take a short rest and perhaps enjoy some of the energizing snacks on offer. Then you’re off again. Wonderful!

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.backyardvange.se/): 2027-05-29 — "Kommande lopp planerat den 29 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-22)

name: Seskarö Trailrun 2026
location: Seskarö Havsbad & Camping, Seskarö, Haparanda Municipality, Sweden
distance_verbose: 12 km, 7 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: Seskarö Trailrun 2026 is northern Sweden’s most fun race, offering courses for everyone, regardless of experience or age. It’s a competition and an experience for the whole family, with a focus on the joy of running. The courses wind through Seskarö’s fantastic trails and the beautiful natural surroundings of the Haparanda Archipelago, with varied terrain including forest, gravel, cobblestones and sand. Several distances are available, from 500 metres for the youngest participants to 12 km for those looking for a greater challenge on technical terrain.
course_highlights: The course follows existing trails and combinations of trails, with varied surfaces including forest, gravel, cobblestones and sand
Technically challenging sections with jumps over logs and rocks, as well as sandy and cobblestone sections
Detailed course maps for 12 km (clockwise), 7 km (clockwise) and 3 km (counterclockwise) are available on site
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Friday 29/5 from 17:00 to 20:00 and on Saturday 30/5 from 08:00 at Seskarö Havsbad & Camping. Race numbers must be collected at least 30 minutes before the start. All participants receive a Seskarö Trailrun participant medal. Showers and toilets are available. Proceeds from the entry fee go towards maintaining and developing the Seskarö Trails outdoor recreation area. The race is held at Seskarö Havsbad & Camping. Proceeds go towards maintaining and developing the Seskarö Trails outdoor recreation area.

name: Blue Mountain Trail Run
price_range: 150-450 kr beroende på distans och anmälningstid

price_tiers.distance: 15 km - Alvars stig by Nordväggen AB
6 km - Östra Ånnabodasjön by ICA Glansen

description:
Blue Mountain TrailRun is a trail race in Kilsbergen, 20 kilometres west of Örebro. There are four courses of 6, 10, 15 and 21 km, all starting and finishing at First Camp Ånnaboda.

The courses follow Bergslagsleden and the MTB trails around Ånnaboda: narrow trails, roots and rocks, boardwalks over streams, moss-covered spruce forest and views of forest lakes. The 21 km Blankhult course has 527 metres of elevation gain and is the race’s long loop for those looking for technical trails and hills. The 15 km Alvars stig is the middle-distance course, with trails all the way. The 10 km Trolldalsvägen is the classic 10-kilometre course. The 6 km Östra Ånnabodasjön course goes around the lake on mostly easy-running trails and is suitable as a first trail race.

Men’s and women’s categories on all courses, no time limit, electronic timing and a medal for everyone who finishes. The runner who breaks the course record on the 21 km course receives SEK 5,000. The fifth edition takes place in 2027. The race has been organised by Garphyttans IF Orientering since 2023.
course_highlights: Technical trails and hilly terrain along stage 9 of Bergslagsleden
Passes several forest lakes, including Norra Ånnabodasjön and Stora Dammsjön
Climb to Sånnabodahöjden, with sweeping views over Närkeslätten
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the race office from 09.00. Registration opens on 1 December 2026. The registration deadline is 22 May 2027. Late registration is available on race day from 09.00 to 09.15, subject to availability. Start times: 6 km at 09.43, 21 km at 10.00, 15 km at 10.35 and 10 km at 11.00. Aid stations with water, sports drink and snacks are located approximately every five kilometres. Trail shoes are recommended. Burgers, coffee and refreshments are available in the finish area. Swim in Södra Ånnabodasjön after the race. 21 km course records: 1:16:41 (men) and 1:29:16 (women).

name: Öland Lighthouse Challenge
location: Långe Erik Lighthouse, Byxelkrok, Öland, Sweden
description: Öland Lighthouse Challenge is an ultramarathon starting at Långe Erik Lighthouse on Öland, with three distances: 100 miles, 50 miles and 50 km. The race offers a fantastic running experience along the coast of the Kalmar Strait, through meadows and forest, and across the unique Alvar limestone plain, with views of the Baltic Sea. The finish location depends on the distance: the 50 km finishes in Djupvik, the 50 miles in Lindby and the 100 miles at Långe Jan Lighthouse. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal and a T-shirt as a memento.
course_highlights: Start at Långe Erik Lighthouse and finish at Långe Jan Lighthouse for the 100-mile race
Run along the coast of the Kalmar Strait and through meadows and forest
Views of the Baltic Sea and Öland’s unique Alvar limestone plain
additional: All distances start together on Friday at 15:00 at Långe Erik Lighthouse. Aid stations or energy stations are located approximately every 20 km along the course. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal and a T-shirt. Get 15% off accommodation at Böda Sand during the weekend when booking with the code Lighthouse Challenge. Medal and T-shirt for everyone who completes the race. Energy and hydration stations are located along the course; the official race website states that they are approximately 20 km apart. Published prices apply to 2026 and may change for 2027.

name: „Vilties bėgimas“
description: The Run of Hope is a civic initiative dedicated to fostering a culture of solidarity and hope in support of people with cancer and their loved ones. The event takes place in Klaipėda Old Town and offers a range of distances, from 0.2 km for children to a full marathon of 42.195 km. The race follows loop courses, allowing participants to enjoy views of the city while contributing to an important social mission. This traditional event brings athletes and the community together for a shared purpose.

name: Tromsøstafetten 2027
description: Tromsøstafetten is a new celebration of community in central Tromsø, focused on togetherness, atmosphere and enjoyment. The race consists of eight exciting and challenging legs with varying surfaces, distances and elevation. There is room for everyone, whatever your pace, and you are encouraged to take part with family, friends, a sports club or colleagues and experience the relay spirit together. The start and finish will be near central Tromsø, and the race offers a unique opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings with a great atmosphere along the course.
course_highlights: Eight varied legs with different surfaces, distances and elevation
Start and finish near central Tromsø
Several different categories to suit all levels and paces
additional: The minimum age is 13 (born in 2014). Medals will be awarded to the three best teams in each category, and prizes will also be drawn among all participating teams. Results will be published during and after the event. The course and start/finish location will be announced in early 2027. The minimum age is 13. The course and exact start and finish locations will be announced in early 2027. Medals will be awarded to the three best teams in each category, and prizes will be drawn among participating teams.

name: Läänemaa sörgib ühissörk
description: Läänemaa Jog Together is a fun, relaxed family event taking place on 31 May at Haapsalu Railway Station. The group jog is about 3+ kilometres at an easy pace (~7:30 min/km), welcoming everyone in Läänemaa who enjoys being active. The event is the campaign’s grand finale, bringing together the various jogs held across the county during May. Both previous participants and newcomers are welcome to enjoy being active together and strengthen the sense of community.

name: Meie oma maijooks 2026
description: Our own Maijooks 2026 is a traditional running event held on 1 June at the Kolga-Jaani School stadium and sports fields. The event offers various distances and age categories suitable for runners, Nordic walkers and recreational athletes of all ages. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle, provide an opportunity to compete and celebrate family-friendly activities in the Kolga-Jaani area. Participants can enjoy a pleasant evening run on the light-traffic path and at the stadium, with recognition for the top runners and representatives of the area.

name: Virtuaaljooks suvi 2026
description: Virtual Run Summer 2026 is a flexible, remote running event that allows participants to complete their chosen distance in their local area at a time that suits them. The event offers several distance options, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21 km), as well as the option to take part in a children’s race. Participants can record and upload their results to the GoAndRun.eu portal, ensuring that results are reliable and can be compared with those of other participants around the world. The virtual run offers a convenient, environmentally friendly way to take part in sport without having to travel to an event venue.

name: Vårruset Sundsvall
description: Vårruset Sundsvall is a popular spring fun run held at Hamnträdgården, with the start and finish in central Sundsvall. The event offers two distances, 2.5 km and 5 km, with the course passing through the city centre and along Selångersån. It is a fun run with timing on the 5 km distance and a great sense of community. Teams can take part, and participants are treated to a picnic after finishing. The event is open to all ages, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult, and is a perfect spring activity for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Hamnträdgården in Sundsvall
The course passes through the city centre and along Selångersån
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km, with a certified 5 km course
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport in Birsta City in the days before the event. Teams of 5 people are treated to a picnic after finishing. You can opt out of timing when registering. There are no changing facilities at the venue, but there is a supervised area where you can leave warm-up clothes. Water stations and toilets are available at the event area. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km (11 when accompanied by an adult) and 11 for the 2.5 km (7 when accompanied by an adult). Participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. Teams consist of five people and receive a picnic after finishing.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: Stora Tuna OK och Kvarnsvedens GOIF Friidrott

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: ANMÄLNINGSAVGIFT 1750kr Lag (3-5 deltagare, picknickkasse ingår) fr.o.m. 8 maj

description: Blodomloppet in Borlänge is a fun run that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event is open to both individual participants and teams. Teams consist of 3–5 people, who can take part in different distances. The event ends with a shared picnic and offers an inclusive, social atmosphere for participants of all ages and abilities. Lilla Blodomloppet is a shorter race of approximately 800 metres for children, held in the area around the event grounds. Blodomloppet is part of Sweden’s largest series of fun runs, focusing on health and blood donation.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km running routes head north across Sportfältet and split at Storsvängen
The walking route has no finish arch and ends at the fruit and medal tables
Lilla Blodomloppet is approximately 800 metres long and takes place in the area around the event grounds
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (3–5 participants). Team members can take part in different distances. Team members receive a picnic bag. Late registration for teams is not possible after 21 May, but individuals can register late until 28 May at 12:00. Late registration on race day is available between 15:45 and 17:45, with payment by Swish. Name, category or distance changes can be made by email no later than 21 May, or at bib collection on 26 May from 16:30 to 18:30. A basic kiosk is available at the event grounds; payment is by Swish only. Water stations are available along the course. Lilla Blodomloppet is approximately 800 m long and takes place in the area around the event grounds. Teams consist of 3–5 participants and can choose different distances or categories. A picnic bag is included with team registration. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. Registration prices and information for 2027 may be updated.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a traditional running series event that began in 2016 and will take place in three stages in 2026. The runs are held on the Kambja health trails, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy forest paths and some asphalt sections. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and motivate people to take up recreational running. Each stage features a 10 km race, as well as a health run and a power run, which uses body weight and elevation gain in its calculations. Runners who participate in all three stages will receive a series T-shirt, and the grand prize winners will receive a Merida Big Nine 20 bicycle.

name: Vårruset Östersund
location: Storsjön, north of Badhusparken, Östersund, Sweden
organizer: Marathongruppen i samarbete med lokala idrottsklubbar, däribland Trångsvikens IF
description: Vårruset in Östersund is a springtime fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances along the shore of Lake Storsjön, north of Badhusparken. The event is family-friendly, with a recommended minimum age of 7 when accompanied by an adult, and offers a lovely spring evening with a post-finish picnic for teams. The start and finish are by Lake Storsjön, and the 5 km course is officially measured. Participants receive a medal and a finish bag, and can enjoy a music quiz and prizes. They can choose whether or not to have their time recorded.
course_highlights: The course follows the shore of Lake Storsjön, with the start and finish by the lake
The event area is north of Badhusparken, near Jamtli
Officially measured 5 km course, with a 2.5 km distance also available
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Östersund on 23 and 30 May, 11:00–17:00. Teams consist of 5 people, and team members must register individually. A post-finish picnic is included for teams and can be collected by presenting the picnic voucher on the team captain’s race bib. The event area is easily accessible on foot, by bicycle, or by train to Västra station. There is a water station, portable toilets, and a facility at the information desk for storing warm-up clothes and valuables. The 5 km course is officially measured. Five-person teams receive a picnic after the finish. Information about the location and event setup comes from the organizer’s 2026 information; details for 2027 have not been confirmed by the sources.

name: 5. ETAPP - Merimets
description: Stage 5 – Merimetsa is part of the 24th Tervisejooks ja -kõnd series, which takes place in the car parks at Pelguranna and Stroomi Beach. This 3.6 km stage gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and fitness trails in a coastal area. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers who want to spend time actively and improve their health. The series stages take place in different parts of Tallinn, offering varied landscapes and views.

name: Blodomloppet Stockholm
organizer: IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö SOK
description: Blodomloppet in Stockholm is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or in a team with colleagues and friends. The race is a popular workplace wellness activity and ends with a large picnic, offering a social and meaningful experience for all ages and levels. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children, Specialomloppet, and the option to participate remotely.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in central Stockholm
Walking category where dogs are allowed
Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 1–12
additional: Dogs are allowed in the 5 km walking category. Wheelchairs and walking poles are permitted only in the walking categories. Strollers are not allowed during the race, but are allowed in the event area. Team registration (at least 5 people) includes a picnic bag, with extra bags available to purchase. Tents can be rented for teams or companies in the event area. Start times are divided into several groups for the 5 km and 10 km, including walking and competitive categories, with prizes for the top 3 runners. Teams must register with five people. The walking categories are not timed; blood donors receive a discount. Information about the course route and start times for 2027 will be announced later.

name: Valgamaa lahtised MV
description: The Valgamaa Open Championships in Orienteering Sprint is an orienteering competition held in the Valga area. The competition is part of the RMK Eestimaa Orienteerumispäevakud, family events with no age restrictions. The courses are designed for participants of different skill levels, and competitors can choose a pace that suits them. Timing is used at the competition, and an SI card can be rented if needed to help with orienteering. The event is for everyone who wants to enjoy outdoor activity and orienteering in good company.

name: Vårruset 2025 — Luleå
location: Luleå University of Technology, Porsön, Luleå, Sweden
description: Vårruset in Luleå is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and offers a welcoming and inclusive running experience. The race is organised by Marathongruppen and takes place at beautiful Porsön, by Luleå University of Technology. Participants can choose between the 2.5 km and 5 km distances on a course measured for accuracy. The event includes a medal, a finish-line goodie bag, a music quiz with prizes, and timing for the 5 km race, and concludes with a picnic for team participants.
course_highlights: Course measured for accuracy for the 5 km race
Start and finish at Porsön, Luleå University of Technology
Water station and sponsor village at the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Luleå in the days before the race, as well as at the event area on race day. Teams that register receive a picnic after finishing, which can be collected by presenting the picnic voucher on the team leader’s race bib. There are no changing facilities, but participants can leave their warm-up clothes in a bag labelled with their name and bib number. Toilets and water are available on site. The event area opens at 16:00, with a sponsor village and activities. RaceTimer’s search results list Vårruset Luleå on 12 June 2025. Information about the distances and event format comes from Vårruset’s official website.

name: Lammasmäe Eesti Ööjooks - Rakvere 2026
description: LAMMASMÄE Estonian Night Run - Rakvere 2026 is a night running race taking place in Rakvere on June 12, 2026. This popular sporting event brings together running enthusiasts and offers an exciting, lively night-running experience. The race takes place amid the beautiful scenery around Rakvere, giving participants a unique opportunity to enjoy sport and the urban environment at night.
course_highlights: Night run in Rakvere and its surroundings
Beautiful and varied terrain
Lively and energetic race atmosphere
additional: The event includes a range of distance options and promotes healthy lifestyles and community support.

name: NATTMILEN 2026 - Sundsvall
description: Nattmilen is a popular night race in Sundsvall, celebrating its fifth anniversary in 2027. The race offers 5 km and 10 km distances with a mass start and timing, as well as an optional untimed distance. The race starts at 22:00 from Stora torget and has a festive atmosphere with music, energy and an after-run at restaurant Bloco. Nattmilen is an event for everyone, from beginners to experienced runners, and has become one of Sundsvall’s most anticipated summer running evenings.
course_highlights: Run through Sundsvall’s beautiful stone city
Mass start and timing for the 5 km and 10 km distances
Sweden’s only finish chute with a bar, in place since 2023
additional: Late registration is available online until 30 minutes before the start on race day, as long as places remain. Race bibs can be collected at Stadium City Sundsvall during race week or at the start area between 19:00 and 21:30 on race day. There is a water station along the course with water and sports drink. After the race, participants are invited to an after-run at restaurant Bloco with mingling and festivities. Participants can choose to run without timing at either 5 km or 10 km. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by an adult, or be at least 14 years old to run independently. The organizer documents the race with photos and video that may be published, but participants can opt out of appearing by contacting event@morron.se. The event is documented in photos and video. The stated race date is 4 June 2027; previous race information gives 5 June 2026.

name: Lofoten Ultra-Trail
description: Lofoten Ultra-Trail is a spectacular trail race that spans the entire Lofoten archipelago, from Kirkefjorden in the west to Svolvær in the east. The route features mountain ridges, white beaches and grey cliffs, with the sea almost always in sight or right at your feet. The race takes place in the light of the midnight sun, so you don’t need a headlamp. This race is for anyone seeking a unique experience in beautiful and challenging surroundings, with distances ranging from 12 km to 100 miles.
course_highlights: The route covers the entire Lofoten archipelago, from Kirkefjorden to Svolvær
Terrain featuring mountain ridges, white beaches and grey cliffs
The race takes place in the light of the midnight sun, with no need for a headlamp
additional: Registration and bib collection take place at RETUR in Svolvær from Tuesday at 12:00 during race week. The race has a strong environmental focus, with support from the organizers along the way; external support is permitted only at selected aid stations. The race is a UTMB Index qualifier and awards ITRA points. Para athletes are welcome and are encouraged to get in touch before registering to discuss arrangements.

name: Peura Trail
distance_verbose: 100 km, 50 km, 37 km, 23 km, 13 km, 5 km

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The Jaanikese running cross-country race is the second event in the series and takes place at the Jaanikese Motor and Leisure Centre. The course features varied terrain suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event offers the chance to enjoy a sporting competition in beautiful natural surroundings and is part of the centre’s active running and cycling trail.

name: Narva Linna Jooks - 5 km ja 21,1 km
description: The Narva City Run is the largest mass-participation sports event in Ida-Viru County, taking place on June 5 and 6 at Joaorg in Narva. The two-day event features a mile run around Town Hall Square on Friday, followed by the main races on Saturday, including the 5 km and 21.1 km distances. This year’s course is flatter, allowing runners to achieve better times, and the event also hosts the Estonian Road Mile Championships. The Narva City Run brings thousands of recreational runners and elite athletes to the course, offering a great mass-participation sports experience.

name: Luhamaa piirijooks
description: Luhamaa Border Run is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance follows paved roads around the Luhamaa village hall and is approximately 5.9 km long. There are also shorter mini-distances and races for toddlers, suitable for participants of all ages. The series aims to provide a sporting and friendly race experience amid Võrumaa’s beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Padise liigub
description: Padise liigub is part of the Lääne-Harju movement series and takes place at the Padise community centre of the Lääne-Harju Cultural Centre. The route passes through Padise’s beautiful landscape, offering excitement and scenic views for runners, walkers and Nordic walkers. The event is suitable for the whole family, with children’s races in addition to the main 5 km distance. It is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy being active in a historic and naturally beautiful setting.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The 2nd Jaanikese Cross-Country Run takes place on 6 June 2026 at the Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Centre and is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa Running and Walking Series. The event offers several distances, including children’s races, a 2.7 km run and walk, and the main 5.4 km run. The routes follow the motocross track, giving participants the chance to enjoy a sporting competition across different age groups. The organiser, Valgamaa Sports Association, welcomes all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy an active day.

name: SunRun
description: SunRun Saaremaa 2026 is a team running experience held amid Saaremaa’s beautiful natural scenery. The run starts at sunrise in Kuressaare and finishes at sunset at Illiku laid in Orissaare, covering a total of 180 km. Any group, circle of friends, or sports club can take part by forming a team and dividing the distance among its members. The aim is not to win, but to run together with friends at a comfortable pace and enjoy the experience. Each participant receives a GPS wristband that serves as a baton, and there are refreshment and food stations along the course.

name: Björnfrossa Ultramarathon
location: Kungsbergets skidanläggning, Sandviken Municipality, Gävleborg County, Sweden
description: Björnfrossa Ultramarathon is a 65 km trail race through the scenic bear country of Gästrikland, starting and finishing at Kungsberget Ski Resort. The course mainly follows the Gästrikeleden Trail and features beautiful, occasionally technical trails, as well as some gravel roads. The race is organised by the Björnfrossa Organising Association and offers a challenging experience with approximately 1,200 metres of elevation gain and four aid stations along the way. Participants are advised to carry mandatory equipment, including a headlamp and mobile phone, for safety and communication.
course_highlights: 65 km of trail running along the Gästrikeleden Trail
Occasionally technical trails and sections of gravel road
Over 1,200 metres of elevation gain and four staffed aid stations
additional: The start and finish are at Kungsberget Ski Resort. Bib numbers are handed out at the start area and must be worn visibly throughout the race. Mandatory equipment includes a headlamp and a mobile phone with the race organisers’ number saved. There is no drop-bag service, so participants must carry all their equipment from the start. Medical staff are available at the start/finish, but participants are responsible for themselves out on the course. The maximum time limit is 12 hours. The start and finish are at Kungsberget Ski Resort. Previous race information states that there are four staffed aid stations, a 12-hour time limit, and mandatory headlamp and mobile phone; the race is not a sanctioned competition.

name: Söder Runt
description: Söder Runt is a popular 10 km race around Södermalm in Stockholm, known for its beautiful, fast course along the water with no uphill sections. The race attracts many runners looking to set a personal best and offers a flat, easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel. After the finish, runners can enjoy a popular After Run party with music, mingling, food and drinks. The start and finish are at Tantolunden and Hornstulls strand, respectively, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: 10 km around Södermalm along the water
Flat, easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel
No uphill sections; many runners set personal bests
additional: Water stations are available after 4 km and at the finish. Strollers and dogs are not allowed. All participants receive a medal and products at the finish. The minimum age is 14 for the race and 18 for the After Run. Payment is made via the website by card, Swish, invoice or bank giro/postgiro for larger groups. The start is provisionally scheduled for 19:45. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. Minimum age: 14; strollers and dogs are not allowed.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.soderrunt.se/): 2027-06-05 — "Jubileumsupplagan äger rum lördagen den 5 juni 2027 kl. 19:45." (was estimated 2027-06-05)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Jubileumsupplagan äger rum lördagen den 5 juni 2027 kl. 19:45.

name: Samogitia Ultra 2027 - Where Dreams Go to Die
description: Samogitia Ultra is a unique endurance race held in the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai, Lithuania. Participants run a 6.7 km forest trail loop every hour on the hour, continuing until only one runner remains, known as the Last Man Standing. The race challenges runners' endurance, strategy, and grit, with a minimum of 7 loops required to earn a medal. The course features about 70 meters of elevation gain per loop and is set in a beautiful natural reserve.
course_highlights: 6.7 km forest trail loop with about 70 meters of elevation gain
Course runs through the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai
100% forest single- and double-track trails and gravel; the same loop is run day and night
additional: Runners must complete each 6.7 km loop within one hour or be eliminated. A minimum of 7 loops (46.9 km) is required to earn a medal. Runners receive warnings 3, 2, and 1 minute before each loop. Personal tents can be set up from 6 PM the day before the race near the start gate. Toilets are available about 50 meters from base camp. Water and hot water are available at base camp. There are no showers, but a clean lake is nearby. Walking during the race is allowed and recommended. Personal items can be left in tents, but are not the organizer's responsibility. The event has a tent base and aid stations, but there are restrictions on support along the course.

name: The Arctic Triple - Lofoten Ultratrail - inkl. NM
description: Lofoten Ultra-Trail is a spectacular trail race that stretches across the entire island chain from Kirkefjorden to Svolvær. The race offers varied terrain with mountain ridges, white beaches and steep cliffs, with the sea almost always in sight. Participants run in the midnight sun, creating a unique experience without the need for a headlamp. The race is part of The Arctic Triple, a series of three challenging races in Lofoten that also includes ski and triathlon competitions. Lofoten Ultra-Trail is also an official Norwegian Championship venue and awards UTMB Index points.
course_highlights: The race runs along the entire island chain from Kirkefjorden to Svolvær
Terrain featuring mountain ridges, white beaches and steep cliffs
The race takes place in the midnight sun, with no need for a headlamp
additional: Registration and bib pickup take place at RETUR in Svolvær from Tuesday at 12:00 during race week. The race is open to para-athletes, who can be offered an adapted course and logistics. Lofoten Ultra-Trail is a UTMB Index race and awards ITRA points. Relay and stage races are also available, as well as a 4-day stage race with luggage transport and accommodation included. The race includes the Norwegian Championships in 2027.

name: The Arctic Run
description: The Arctic Run is a unique island marathon held on Hadseløya in Vesterålen, Northern Norway. The race offers a scenic and varied course with a maximum elevation of 300 meters, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Participants can choose between a full marathon, a half marathon with views of the sea and mountains, and a 10K route that combines urban and natural landscapes. The event highlights the region’s stunning natural beauty, including views of Langøya, the Lofoten Wall, and the mountains in Bø, making it a memorable experience for all runners.
course_highlights: Marathon route around Hadseløya island with 300 meters maximum elevation
Half marathon with views of the sea, Langøya, and the Lofoten Wall
10K route through the city center, residential areas, and natural landscapes, with 79 meters of elevation
additional: The event includes a free 600-meter TAR Family Run at 10:00 AM on race day, with no timekeeping. Bib pickup is available from 08:00 to 09:45 AM at Hurtigrutemuseet. Food and drink stations are located at several points along the course and offer energy drinks, juice, water, bananas, nuts, chocolate, cookies, and dried fruit. Toilets are available at the start, finish, and along the course. Camp TAR offers drop-in showers, with passes available for purchase. Photographers will capture moments from the race, which will be available to purchase after the event. Shuttle buses run from several hotels to the race. The information page also covers food and drink stations, toilets, baggage storage, and pacers. A free 600-meter family run is also held.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 24. Laekvere – Simuna jooks
description: The third stage of the 2026 Lääne-Virumaa running and walking series is the traditional Simuna–Laekvere Run, which has earned a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts. The run is distinctive because its direction changes every year. The event takes place at Simuna School and welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: E-Lux Peetri Jooks
description: E-LUX Peetri Run is one of Estonia’s liveliest mass-participation sporting events, bringing together running enthusiasts of different ages and abilities. The main distance is 10 km, which is timed, with prizes awarded to the top finishers. There is also a charity run, a youth run and children’s races. The event takes place in Peetri and, alongside the running, features a large expo and market area with a variety of vendors and entertainment. The charity run supports the Children’s Foundation of Tartu University Hospital and, through it, children with mobility impairments. All finishers receive a cool summer medal.

name: Simuna-Laekvere rahvajooks
description: The Simuna-Laekvere People’s Run is a traditional recreational running event held every other year, alternating between Simuna and Laekvere. The course follows paved roads, with rolling sections and a few climbs, offering participants a varied running experience. The event is friendly and well organized, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants, and also offers a sauna and hot soup after the run. The number of participants is usually around 100, creating a pleasant, relaxed atmosphere. Age-group prizes are awarded, and the first ten finishers receive a running shirt.

name: Västerås Stadslopp
price_range: 2026: 120–400 kr beroende på lopp och anmälningstid
description: Västerås Stadslopp is a festival in Vasaparken, inviting runners of all ages to take part in various races, including children’s races and a team race. The event is organised by Västerås Friidrottsklubb and offers a wonderful atmosphere, with activities for children, mascots, and opportunities to participate regardless of disability. Race bibs are collected on site, and services include bag drop and water stations. Teams that register receive a food bag after the finish, making it a fun, social running experience.
course_highlights: Children’s races with three different distances to choose from
Children’s activity area with an obstacle course, high jump and shot put
Start and finish in Vasaparken, with access to toilets and water refill stations
additional: Race bibs are collected on site in Vasaparken on 7 June from 09:00, with a separate collection time for the 2.5 km and longer distances after 11:00. Teams of four receive a food bag after the finish. Toilets and water refill stations are available at Rådhuset near the start. Bag drop is available, but there is no cover. The children’s races are limited to 400 participants and are fully booked for 2026. Mascots and a children’s activity area will be on site. The date for 2027 will be announced later. Race bibs are collected in Vasaparken. Teams of four can receive a food bag/picnic after the race.

name: Eidemila 2027
location: Kvaløy kirke, Eidkjosen, Kvaløya, Tromsø, Norway
description: Eidemila is an annual 10 km race that has been held since 2008, starting at Eidkjosen and finishing at Kvaløysletta. The race is organized by Tromsø Running Club and attracts runners who want to track their progress and compete for fast times.
