It is a popular event in the region with a rich history and results available to participants. The race has a tradition of bringing experienced and new runners together in a great running atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km course from Eidkjosen to Kvaløysletta
Held annually since 2008
Fast course with good opportunities for personal bests
additional: Results and statistics from previous years are available to participants, including winning times, age groups and team competitions. In 2026, bib collection was outdoors at Eide Handel. There were no changing facilities, and parking was available at Eide Handel.

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of athletics events combining track races, throwing events and jumps. Each evening features one throwing event, one jumping event and running distances, offering a varied athletics experience. Competitions take place at Võru Stadium, and the IAAF scoring tables are used to determine the rankings. The series has five stages, one of which is the Võru County Championships. Participants must register separately for each stage, and their race bib is valid for the entire season.

name: Lääne-Virumaa noorte MV
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Youth Championships is an athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Rakvere. The events include several athletics disciplines, such as running, jumping and throwing, and are intended for different age groups from U-14 through to adults. The competition aims to honor the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. All age groups receive medals, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at the stadium and starts at 11:00; registration opens at 10:00.

name: 6. ETAPP - Nõmme terviserada
description: The Nõmme health trail is part of the Tradehouse health running and walking series organized by Stamina Sports Club, which encourages people to stay active by collecting health kilometres. This stage offers a chance to enjoy the Nõmme area health trail, which is suitable for both runners and walkers. As part of the series, participants can collect health kilometres at both in-person and remote stages, as well as through personal training. The event is open to everyone interested in physical activity who wants to improve their health and spend time actively.

name: Gallaberget Trailrun
description: Gallaberget Trailrun is a trail race organized by Vretstorps IF Löpning. The race features a more challenging course with plenty of trails and forest terrain, offering a demanding and scenic running experience. After the race, participants can enjoy some social time with hot dogs in buns and a swim in the evening sunshine. The event attracts runners of different ages and abilities and is appreciated for its great atmosphere and well-organized arrangements.
course_highlights: A more challenging course with plenty of trails
Forest terrain and scenic surroundings
Hot dogs in buns and a swim in the evening sunshine after the race
additional: After the race, hot dogs in buns are served, and participants can swim in the evening sunshine. Previous races have had around 65 registered runners and included great prizes from sponsors such as Vitamin Well and Nocco. The 2026 edition had a 10 km race category. After the race, hot dogs in buns were served, and participants could go for a swim.

name: Avesta Night Sky Run Knattelopp
description: Avesta Night Sky Run is an evening trail race held at Dalahästen Ski Center in Avesta. The race offers two distances, 3.33 km and 10 km, which mostly follow the trails on the esker around the ski slope. It is an enjoyable and challenging trail course suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The event is part of Dalaportens OL’s race program and offers a unique evening running experience.
course_highlights: Trail race of 3.33 km or 10 km
The course mostly follows the trails on the esker
Runs around the ski slope at Dalahästen Ski Center
additional: Participants receive a medal and Festis. The sources describe the race as part of Avesta Night Sky Run but give race dates different from the stated date of 2027-06-09.

name: Liikumissari" 8.Järvamaa järvede jooksud" V etapp Paide tehisjärve jooks
location: Paide tehisjärv, Paide, Järva County, Estonia

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 3. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 3rd stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event held on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful views of the lake and varied terrain. The event is part of a series organised by the Joosu Health Sports Club, which promotes an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone is welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lake views throughout the course
Varied terrain suitable for runners of different levels

name: Vanglateenistuse jooks
description: The Prison Service Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place at the Jõhvi music square. This athletics event gives participants the opportunity to enjoy a run in the beautiful surroundings of Ida-Viru County. The series includes several stages in different locations, offering a varied running experience. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and is traditionally well organized and friendly.

name: ELVA SÜDAÖÖJOOKS 2026 TARTUMAA LIIGUB ETAPP
description: Elva Midnight Run 2026 is a nighttime running and walking event held near the Elva Cultural Centre. The races start in the evening and offer several distance options, including a 10 km run and walk, as well as children’s races. The event is part of Tartu County’s exercise events and is suitable for both active runners and families. The organizers welcome everyone to take part and enjoy a sporty evening in Elva’s beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Eesti noorte KV
description: The Estonian Youth Archery Cup takes place in Pärnu, giving young athletes the opportunity to compete and develop their skills. Several archery clubs from across Estonia take part, making it an important event on the calendar for young archers. The competition is held at Tammiste Stadium, where athletes can demonstrate their accuracy and skill. The event is a tradition and supports the development of young people in archery.

name: Öland Ultra Trail
description: Öland Ultra Trail is a fantastic trail adventure through the beautiful natural surroundings of northern Öland. The race offers two distances, 50 km and 25 km, starting from Böda Sand and Byxelkrok respectively, with both distances finishing at Böda Sand. The course offers scenic views and passes places such as Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, and pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Passes Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen
50 km starts at Böda Sand; 25 km starts at Byxelkrok
Both distances finish at Böda Sand
additional: Late registration is available until 11 June, as well as during bib collection on Friday 12 June from 19:00 to 20:00 and on race day, 13 June, from 07:30 to 09:00. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. Aid stations are located along the course. A T-shirt is included in the entry fee for participants who register by 6 June and specify their shirt size. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal. Pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt if they register by 6 June. The 50 km race starts at 09:00 and the 25 km race at 10:00.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/oland-ultra/): 2027-06-12 — "Tid & datum 12 juni 2027 50 km kl. 09:00" (was estimated 2027-06-12)

name: Urskogsloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 200 kr och anmälan stänger den 10/6.

description: Urskogsloppet is a recreational race on simple trails through a magnificent old-growth forest in Örnsköldsvik Municipality. There are two distances: the original long race of 19.7 kilometres, starting in Backe/Berg and finishing at Bigvallen in Björna, and a shorter 6.6-kilometre race that starts and finishes at Bigvallen. The race is always held on the Saturday before Midsummer weekend and partly follows the Urskogsleden hiking trail. Björnadagen, with activities and an awards ceremony, takes place alongside the race. The terrain is uneven in places, with logs, rocks and wet sections, providing a unique running experience close to nature.
course_highlights: Run on simple trails through old-growth forest
Partly follows the Urskogsleden hiking trail
Uneven terrain with logs, rocks and wet sections
additional: The race starts in Backe/Berg, with bus transport from Björna. Depending on the number of participants, there are two start groups, starting at 11:00 and 11:30. Timing is by wrist chip, with a split time at 11.5 km. At the finish, there are changing rooms and showers, as well as the option to buy food for those who pre-ordered. Shoes with spikes are not allowed in the changing facilities. Parking is available at Björna School, and carpooling is recommended. The race has four checkpoints with drinks and light refreshments. The terrain is wet and uneven in places, so runners should be prepared. The 19.7 km course has four checkpoints. Registration, parking and changing facilities are at the school in Björna, and bus transport to the start in Berg is included for registered participants.

name: Nalta Backyard Ultra
description: Nalta Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon where endurance matters, not speed. The challenge is to run one lap of an approximately 6.7-kilometre course every hour on the hour, for as long as you can. The start and finish are at Ursberget ski lodge in Piteå, and the race continues until only one runner can complete another lap. It is a test of both physical and mental strength on a technically demanding forest course.
course_highlights: 6.7-kilometre loop with approximately 65 metres of elevation gain
The course includes forest trails, running tracks, gravel road and approximately 500 metres of asphalt
Technically demanding sections, clearly marked with signs and course tape
additional: Registration takes place from 07:30 to 08:30, with the race briefing at 08:30. The start and finish are at Ursberget ski lodge, with a grassy area for participants’ equipment. There are two small changing rooms, one shower and two toilets at the event area. The site map shows the start area, lap checkpoint, finish, race management, refreshment area, participant area and recommended parking. The race starts at 09:00 and continues every hour on the hour. Registration is listed as 07:30 to 08:30, and the race briefing at 08:30. Participation is at your own risk.

name: Flosjön-Edstjärn
location: Flosjön–Edstjärn, Gagnef Municipality, Dalarna County, Sweden
description: Flosjön-Edstjärn is a half marathon organized annually by Edstjärns Idrottsklubb in Gagnef. The race is open to everyone and runs through scenic areas around Flosjön and Edstjärn. It is a well-established event that promotes sport and community, especially among young people. The club encourages participation in various sports and offers a great opportunity to experience beautiful scenery while running.
course_highlights: Half marathon around Flosjön and Edstjärn
Scenic views and varied terrain
Organized by the volunteer-run Edstjärns IK, with a focus on youth sports
additional: All registrations are binding, and participation is at your own risk. Personal data is handled by Edstjärns IK and Mitt Lopp. Names and results are published at www.eik.one. The organizer may stop the race if necessary to protect participants’ health and safety.

name: EKVA lahtised kergej. võistl.
description: The EKVA Open Athletics Competitions take place in Kohila and offer veterans and recreational athletes the opportunity to compete in a variety of track and field events. The competitions are intended for active athletes of all ages who want to test themselves and enjoy the thrill of athletics. EKVA regularly organizes various championships and series that promote running and athletics in Estonia. The competitions are open to both recreational athletes and veterans, with age-group events available.

name: Viimsi maraton
description: Viimsi Marathon 2026 takes place on the Viimsi Peninsula and offers participants a course consisting of one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied terrain includes both paved roads and forest trails, with climbs and descents throughout the distance. It is a great opportunity to enjoy a summer run with a positive community.

name: Dadathlon Run and Festival (Stockholm, Hagaparken)
description: DaddyHood Dadathlon is a sporting event for dads and children that aims to inspire movement and quality time together. The event takes place both live in Hagaparken, Stockholm, and virtually for participants who cannot attend in person. It is a family-friendly activity that promotes healthy habits and a sense of community among active dads and their children.
course_highlights: Family-friendly run in Hagaparken, Stockholm
The event offers both live and virtual participation
Strollers are welcome during the run
additional: The event is part of a global virtual sports challenge featuring three sports over three months: running in May, cycling in June, and hiking. Strollers are welcome during the run. Virtual participation is free, and the event aims to create unforgettable memories and build healthy habits together with the children. Dadathlon consists of three events held at different times throughout the year. Activity can be recorded using an app or sports watch.

name: Rapla Selveri suurjooks, virtuaaljooks
description: Rapla Selveri Suurjooks is a traditional running race held in Rapla, offering several distance options from children’s races to a half marathon. The race centre is located in the Rapla Selver car park, and the routes run along the town’s streets and highways. They are clearly marked and measured. Participants’ safety is ensured, and the event is organised by Kehakultuur OÜ in cooperation with Jooksja magazine. Pre-registration closes on 20 May, and start groups are formed according to expected finish times to ensure a smooth and safe race day.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
organizer: VIF Gute Friidrott och Blodcentralen i Visby
description: Blodomloppet in Visby is a fun run organised to raise awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promote a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km on scenic routes that include Visby’s city wall, old town, promenade, Almedalen and harbour. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children, with shorter distances. The event is open to individuals and teams, and ends with a group picnic for participants.
course_highlights: The 5 km route follows Visby’s city wall and passes through the historic old town
The 10 km route includes the city wall, promenade, Almedalen and Visby harbour
Lilla Blodomloppet takes place in an urban setting and starts behind the main stage
additional: Late registration is available on site from 16:00 on 16 June at the Information Tent. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib, medal and gift for blood donors. Team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing or use a picnic card (valid only for Blodomloppet at a distance). The scenic routes pass through historic and central parts of Visby. Water stations and medical assistance are available. Changing facilities and toilets are provided. Parking information and directions are available on the website. Participants can register individually or in teams of up to five. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib and medal; team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing. Lilla Blodomloppet has distances of 300 m and 1.6 km.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/visby/): 2027-06-15 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 15 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-15)

name: Filter Temposari (3. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or inline skating. The events take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring speed races with individual starts. The Tallinn event is held at Vabaduse väljak, on a short, technical course well suited to sprint enthusiasts. Series finishers are eligible for the Kullapada awards programme, which rewards consistent participation in every event.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 IV etapp 400m
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage IV (400 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is intended for all running enthusiasts. The series features various distances and age groups, with participants earning points according to their placing in each race. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners; payment is in cash at the venue. Pre-registration is recommended and closes at 16:30 on race day. Those who register later will be placed in the later races. Series winners are determined by age group, and the awards ceremony takes place at the end of the series.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Distance Running Series is a sports series in Kohila Municipality consisting of several stages and aimed at sports enthusiasts in the region. The series aims to promote sports and physical activity and give participants the opportunity to compete over various distances. Participants at each stage receive a commemorative medal, and points are tallied across the series in the competition classes. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Centre, which supports a healthy lifestyle and active movement.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is an athletics track-running series organized by Tartu Spordiselts Kalev, offering the opportunity to take part in multiple meets at stadiums in Tartu and Ülenurme. The series aims to provide competition opportunities for children and young people and promote participation in athletics in the city and county of Tartu. Competitions take place during the summer months and are open to various age groups. Registration closes at 12:00 on the day of the competition, allowing for flexible participation.

name: Midsommarjoggen 2026
description: Midsommarjoggen is a running celebration in the Rynningeviken Nature Reserve in Örebro, inviting runners, families and colleagues to kick off Midsummer week together. The race is 7.2 km long and follows easy-to-run gravel paths with beautiful views and two wooden bridges over the Lillån River. The youngest runners can take part in an exciting 600-metre Kidsrun without timing. After the finish, the evening continues with a pleasant after-run gathering with food, drinks and good company at Stora Hjortstorps Gård.
course_highlights: 7.2 km through the Rynningeviken Nature Reserve on easy-to-run gravel paths
Two wooden bridges over the Lillån River
Two longer hills near Venastugan
additional: The Kidsrun starts at 17:45, with runners gathering at 17:40. Race numbers can be collected from 16:00 to 18:00 on race day. Timing is done with a transponder, which is lent out at race-number collection and must be returned after the race. Water and sports drink are available at 3 km and 5 km. Toilets are available near the race area and at the refreshment stations. There are no changing facilities or showers on site. An after-run gathering with food and drinks is offered after the race (not included in the entry fee). Young people born in 2008 or later receive a 50% discount on the entry fee. Members of certain running clubs may receive a discount through the members’ pages. Group registration is available by contacting info@epictrail.se. After-run gathering at Stora Hjortstorps Gård with food, drinks and good company.

name: Rakvere lahtised MV
description: The Rakvere Open Championships are athletics championships held at Rakvere Stadium. The competition brings together the local sporting community and offers an opportunity to watch a variety of track and field events. The event is open to everyone interested and creates a sporty, supportive atmosphere.

name: Tallinna noorte MV
description: The Tallinn Youth Championships is an individual athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Tallinn. The competition includes several age groups, from U-14 to adults, and a range of athletics events, including running, jumping, putting, and throwing. Its aim is to honour the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. Medals are awarded in all age groups, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at a stadium and starts at 11:00 in the morning; registration opens at 10:00.

name: Tänndalen 100 miles
location: Ski Lodge Tänndalen, Tänndalen, Härjedalen Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Tänndalen 100 Miles is a spectacular 161-kilometre ultrarace on easy-running asphalt through the mountain landscapes of Sweden and Norway. The race starts at Ski Lodge in Tänndalen and takes you across vast mountain expanses, alongside sparkling waters and all the way to the World Heritage city of Røros, before returning to the finish at Ski Lodge. The race offers magical midsummer light and a unique mountain experience for ultrarunners.
course_highlights: 161 km of easy-running roads through the mountain landscapes of Sweden and Norway
The route includes a loop to Funäsdalen and the World Heritage city of Røros
Start and finish at Ski Lodge in Tänndalen
additional: The race starts at 19:00. The organiser’s information says sunset is around 23:00 and describes the race as one of the few 100-mile races where a headlamp is not needed. Prize money is offered to the top three finishers in both the women’s and men’s categories.

name: Borejoggen
price_range: 300–350 kr för Borejoggen och Lagjoggen enligt 2026 års prisuppgifter; Minijoggen 150 kr
description: Borejoggen is a long-established running race held in Torsby every Midsummer’s Eve, with a 42-year tradition. The race follows an 8.5-kilometre asphalt course through central Torsby and welcomes runners of all abilities, from elite athletes to recreational runners. Children and young people can take part in the 1.5-kilometre Minijoggen. There is also a popular team event, Lagjoggen, where three participants compete together and the team’s combined time is counted.
course_highlights: 8.5 km asphalt course through central Torsby
1.5 km Minijoggen for children and young people
Water stations at 2 km, 4 km, 5.8 km and the finish
additional: Mass start for Minijoggen at 9:30 on Östmarksvägen. Mass start for Borejoggen and Lagjoggen at 11:00 on Östmarksvägen. Changing facilities and showers are available at Torsby Ski Tunnel and Valbergsstugan. Prizes are awarded for the sprint prize at 2 km, the mountain prize at Kollsberg after 5 km, and the top three finishers in the women’s, men’s and team categories. Traffic marshals and course guides are stationed at road crossings with traffic. Medical care is available at the finish, with emergency response ready on the course. Previous editions have had their start and finish at Herrgårdsparken. Borejoggen and Lagjoggen have started at 11:00, and Minijoggen at 9:30. The prize and start times for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Orsakajtn
description: Orsakajt'n and Orsabajk'n are an MTB and running event held every Midsummer’s Eve in Orsa. The event follows a route through the Ore River valley, with forest trails, gravel roads and a little asphalt, and gentle to moderate climbs over sand ridges. Race numbers are sent digitally the day before and can be collected at the venue or at Karl Hedin in Orsa. The MTB race requires a licence and membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Cycling Federation.
course_highlights: The route runs through the Ore River valley on forest trails, gravel roads and asphalt
Gentle to moderate climbs over beautiful sand ridges
The route is marked with orange enduro arrows and kilometre signs
additional: Race numbers are sent digitally to your mobile phone the day before the event. Race numbers can be collected at Karl Hedin in Orsa on Thursday from 16:00 to 20:00, or at the start location on race day. No on-site entries; registration closes one hour before the start. No refunds in case of injury or illness. Parking is available at Lillåvallen. The MTB race requires a licence and membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Cycling Federation. Registration is online and closes one hour before the start; on-site entries are not available. Race numbers can be collected at Karl Hedin in Orsa or at the respective start location on race day. MTB competition classes require a licence and membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Cycling Federation.

name: Kuusalu valla kergej. MV
description: The Kuusalu Parish Athletics Championships is a traditional athletics competition held in Kuusalu. The event features various age groups and distances, offering opportunities for both recreational and advanced athletes. It is dedicated to the memory of Margus Keerma and is organized by the Treeningpartner sports club. The competition is a great opportunity to showcase your skills and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in Kuusalu Parish.

name: Ümber Saadjärve jooks
description: The 38th Around Lake Saadjärv Run takes place on June 20, 2026, in Kukulinn, offering participants a 17 km run and a fitness walk around Lake Saadjärv. The course follows a paved road and has three water stations to keep participants well supplied during the event. In addition to the main run, children’s races are held in different age groups, along with a fitness walk suitable for everyone who enjoys being active. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and the top participants are awarded prizes by age group. This traditional, well-organized event offers an enjoyable sporting experience for the whole family.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm
description: EcoTrail Stockholm is a nature-focused running event offering several distances for all ages and levels, from children’s races to ultradistances. The races follow beautiful trails through forests, the archipelago, countryside and urban environments, with a high proportion of nature experiences. The event is marked by a strong environmental ethos and sense of community, where runners can challenge themselves in an inspiring, well-organized setting. The finish is at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre on Norra Djurgården, with beautiful medals and an after-party for participants.
course_highlights: A high proportion of nature, with forest trails, archipelago and countryside
Viewpoints and sights along the course
Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre on Norra Djurgården
additional: Mandatory equipment for 58 km includes a water container holding at least one liter, a cup or mug for drinks at aid stations, and a mobile phone with a fully charged battery and the race organizers’ phone number. Aid stations do not provide cups; participants must fill their own cup, mug or bottle. The time limit for 58 km is 11 hours. For 21 km, a cup, mug or bottle for drinks is required. There are also children’s races and virtual races at various distances. Wooden medals with a unique theme are awarded to everyone who finishes. Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre. All finishers receive a wooden medal.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://stockholm.ecotrail.com/): 2027-06-19 — "19 juni 2027 EcoTrail Stockholm" (was estimated 2027-06-12)

name: Pasvalio maratonas
location: Pasvalio kultūros ir poilsio parko stadionas, Pasvalys, Pasvalio rajonas, Lietuva
organizer: Bėgimo mėgėjų ir sveikos gyvensenos klubas „Vėtra“, Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija, Pasvalio sporto mokykla
description: The Pasvalys Marathon is a traditional running event held in the city of Pasvalys. It aims to promote running among young people and adults and encourage a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place at the stadium in Pasvalys Culture and Recreation Park, where participants compete in the marathon, half-marathon, and children’s race. The course length and number of laps are adjusted for the different distances, with water and refreshment stations every 5 km. Participants receive prizes and commemorative medals, and the event is part of the Pasvalys City Festival “Vys par to ãlo” programme.
course_highlights: 10 km course; 4 laps for the marathon and 2 laps for the half-marathon
Water and refreshment stations every 5 km
Start and finish at the stadium in Pasvalys Culture and Recreation Park
additional: Race numbers are distributed from 8:00 at Pasvalys Stadium. The children’s 400 m race starts at 11:00. Participants must have a doctor’s permission or an application bearing a doctor’s approval; otherwise, they are responsible for their own health during the competition. Participants who finish within the time limit receive commemorative medals. Various distances are offered, and participants can look forward to medals, certificates, prizes, and refreshments.

name: Midnight Sun Marathon
description: The Midnight Sun Marathon in Tromsø is an Arctic running adventure beneath the midnight sun, with five distances offering a unique experience in the light of the sun that never sets. The race brings together thousands of participants from around the world and creates a festival atmosphere, with the whole city cheering on the runners. With spectacular mountain and fjord scenery, and an intimate atmosphere that only Tromsø can offer, this is one of the world’s northernmost marathons and a highlight of the racing calendar.
course_highlights: Run beneath the midnight sun, with daylight all night
Spectacular mountain and fjord scenery
A festival atmosphere, with cheers from across the city
additional: Bib distribution and the MSM Expo take place before the race. Bag storage is available at Kulturhuset and Havneterminalen. Changing facilities and showers are available at Gyllenborghallen. Refreshment stations are located approximately every 5 km and offer water, sports drinks and bananas. The Tromsø Red Cross Search and Rescue Corps has a medical station every 5 km and provides assistance and transport when needed. Warm-ups take place 15 minutes before the start of all distances. Bibs can be transferred in the event of illness or injury with a doctor’s certificate and an administration fee. The event offers five distances. The courses are officially measured and certified, and the Midnight Sun Marathon is a member of AIMS.

name: Trysil-løpet
description: Trysil-løpet is an inclusive race in central Trysil, with fast, flat courses suitable for all ages. Distances are 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 600 m and 300 m; the shortest races are untimed. The start and finish are at the north end of Trysilsenteret, and the courses are officially measured and designed to be fast, with little elevation gain. Places are limited for the 5 km and 10 km. All finishers receive a medal, with prizes for the top finishers in the longer distances.
course_highlights: Fast, flat course with little elevation gain
Start and finish at the north end of Trysilsenteret in central Trysil
Officially measured courses with few turns and good opportunities for fast times
additional: Race numbers can be collected from the event office in the foyer of Trysil cinema. There is a total limit of 400 places for the 5 km and 10 km. All finishers receive medals. Prizes go to the first three women and men in the 5 km and 10 km. A one-time licence is required for participants aged 13 and over who do not have an annual licence. Kondis members receive a discount of 40 kr. Timing and registration are handled by EQ Timing.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 4. Pariisi Maastikujooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 brings together fitness enthusiasts and recreational runners from spring to autumn, offering a variety of running and walking opportunities. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and encourage local people to take part in sporting events. The 4th Pariisi Cross-Country Run takes place on 21 June at Pariisi Holiday Village and is part of a long-running series featuring different age groups and distance options. Timing is chip-based, and race numbers must be attached to the stomach or chest, reflecting the organisers’ care for participants’ comfort and safety.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu is a varied obstacle race held at the Rummu quarry. On the course, participants climb, crawl, lift and drag their way through mud, water, sand and hills, making it a challenge for everyone. The race is part of the Vägilase jooks series, known as Estonia’s best OCR event. The course is more substantial and offers exciting obstacles and experiences in nature.

name: Maraton igas linnas Keila
description: Marathon in Every City Keila is a unique running event that gives participants the opportunity to run a marathon distance in different cities. There are refreshment stations every 400 metres along the course, as well as toilets, making the run more comfortable and supporting athletes’ well-being. The event is suitable both for experienced marathon runners and for those who want to test their endurance. It is well organised and offers an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Pärnumaa Võidupüha maraton
description: The Pärnumaa Victory Day Marathon takes place on 22 June 2026 in Tori Parish, with the race centre located by the historic Tori Estonian Soldiers’ Memorial Church. The marathon brings several new features and is organised in cooperation with the Pärnumaa Sports Association and its supporters. This traditional and legendary race offers athletes a varied and memorable experience.

name: Night Trail Run  Sommar 2025
description: Night Trail Run Sommar 2027 is a personal and unique trail race held on the longest day of the year in Sollentuna, Stockholm. The race starts early in the morning at 02:00 and offers 30 kilometres of wonderful trail running at dawn, as participants meet the light along the way. With a maximum of 100 participants, the race focuses on the experience and the chance to enjoy nature as it awakens. Navigation is by GPS route and map, and a generous breakfast is served after the finish so participants can share the experience with other runners.
course_highlights: 30 km of trail running at dawn, welcoming the summer light
Two aid stations along the course
Navigation by GPS route and map
additional: Maximum 100 participants for a personal experience. Start and finish at Attunda Orienteering Club’s clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22 in Sollentuna. Take the commuter train to Rotebro station and walk 1.5 km to the start/finish. Parking at Sollentuna Golf Club, followed by a 500 m walk. Registration is open until one hour before the start. Minimum age: 18. Breakfast is served after the race. Participant numbers are limited. A generous breakfast is served after the finish.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.nighttrailrun.se/om-sommartrail): 2027-06-21 — "Måndag 21 juni 2027. Start klockan 02.00." (was estimated 2027-06-20)

name: Häädemeeste Võidupüha jooks
description: The Häädemeeste Victory Day Run is a traditional running event held near the Häädemeeste bus station. The event invites everyone who enjoys being active to celebrate Victory Day in a sporting and community-minded spirit. In addition to the main race, a children’s run for the youngest members of the family will be held for the first time. After the run, participants can enjoy the Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden. Participation is free, and registration takes place on site.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Häädemeeste bus station
Children’s run before the main race
Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden after the run
additional: Registration and gathering take place on site at the Häädemeeste bus station from 16:00 to 17:30. Participation is free.

name: 49. Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve
description: The 49th Jaanijooks around the Karksi-Nuia Reservoir is a traditional running race held near the ruins of Karksi Order Castle. The race route circles the scenic Karksi-Nuia Reservoir, offering participants beautiful views and an enjoyable running experience. The event is intended for both recreational and experienced runners and offers a chance to enjoy an active day with the community.

name: Jooks suvesse
description: The Solstice Runs are an annual series of races consisting of several stages, where participants can earn points and compete in age groups. Jooks suvesse is one of the stages in the series and takes place in the Loode oak forest in Kuressaare. The course has varied terrain, including a cycle and pedestrian path and forest trails, which may be muddy depending on the weather. Participants are provided with electronic timing, reusable race bibs and drinking cups, and a sweet snack and drink at the finish.

name: Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälan stänger söndag 13 juni kl 23.59. Ordinarie avgift: 325 kronor.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Från 14 juni tillkommer 50 kronor extra (totalt 375 kr). Efteranmälan via hemsidan till söndag 20 juni kl 16.00.

description: Modine Söderköping City Race is a festive fun run taking place on June 22, 2027, with the start and finish in Brunnsparken in Söderköping. Participants can walk, jog, or run 5 kilometers through the town’s beautiful surroundings along the Storån River and Göta Canal. The race features music, performances, and plenty of encouragement along the course, creating a wonderful atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. After crossing the finish line, all participants are treated to a hearty summer plate by ICA Supermarket. This annual running celebration is organized by Norrköpings Löparklubb and attracts many participants and spectators.
course_highlights: 5 kilometers through Söderköping, starting and finishing in Brunnsparken
The course consists of three laps: the first along the Storån River and Göta Canal, the second through central Söderköping, and the third around Brunnsparken and the residential neighborhood
Music and performances along the entire course create a festive atmosphere
additional: Race bibs can be collected at ICA Supermarket Söderköping on Monday, June 21, from 12:00 to 18:00, or on race day in Brunnsparken from 15:00 to 18:30. The top flap of the race bib is the timing chip. After crossing the finish line, all participants are treated to a hearty summer plate by ICA Supermarket, served on the grass. On-site late registration is available at ICA Supermarket on June 21 from 12:00 to 18:00 and on race day from 15:00 to 18:30. Only Swish is accepted for on-site late registration. The 2027 race takes place on Tuesday, June 22, with a 19:00 start. All participants receive a medal. Race bibs can be collected at ICA Supermarket Söderköping or on race day in Brunnsparken. Late registration costs an additional 50 kronor.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://soderkopingsstadslopp.se/): 2027-06-22 — "Tisdagen 22 juni 2027 är det dags för Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp!" (was estimated 2027-06-15)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Tisdagen 22 juni 2027 är det dags för Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp!

name: 12. Rõuge maastikujooks-kõnd
description: The 12th Rõuge Trail Run and Walk is a trail running and Nordic walking event held in Rõuge Nightingale Valley, Võru County, offering participants the chance to enjoy nature and exercise. The event is suitable for runners, Nordic walkers and walkers who want to spend their time actively. The Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity organises the event to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants can experience beautiful scenery and the joy of exercise while enhancing their well-being.

name: Karlstad Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Ordinarie pris fram till sista anmälningsdag

description: Karlstad Stadslopp is a community celebration and recreational race featuring a fast, scenic 10 km course through the most central parts of Karlstad. The race is marked by a sense of community and the joy of running, with many spectator spots along the course. In addition to the main race, there is also the Minilopp for children aged 7–12 and the Miniminilopp for the youngest children. Karlstad Stadslopp is a traditional summer event that brings together over 3,000 runners and is part of SM-veckan.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course through central Karlstad
Start on Tingvallabron at 18:35
Many spectator spots where runners pass several times
additional: Seeding for start corrals is based on the estimated running time provided at registration. Team competition for the 10 km, with 5–6 people per team; the five fastest times count. Bib pickup and late registration take place in Museiparken on race day. Concert with Dotter at Sandgrund after the finish. Gift cards are available to purchase as gifts. There is also the Karlstad Minilopp for children aged 7–12 and the Miniminilopp for children aged 0–6.

name: St Olavsloppet
organizer: St Olavsgruppens Ideella förening i Sverige och St Olavsloppet A/S i Norge
description: St Olavsloppet is a unique three-day relay race stretching from Trondheim in Norway to Östersund in Sweden. The race offers two main distance options, StOlav 340 and StOlav 210, with teams running timed daily stages and using GPS tracking. It is a social and challenging competition for teams in various categories, including open teams, corporate teams and club teams. There are drink stations and timed changeovers along the route, and the event is characterised by a great atmosphere and teamwork among participants.
course_highlights: Three-day relay from Trondheim to Östersund
Drink stations approximately every four kilometres and at changeovers
GPS tracking with a relay baton for each team
additional: Start groups are based on the team’s running speed, with seeding by the race management. Race bibs must be worn clearly visible on the chest and back, without being folded; otherwise, a time penalty will be added. Changeovers are permitted only at regular and extra changeover points, with timing at regular changeover points. GPS transmitters are attached to the relay baton, which is handed over at changeovers. Teams may hand out their own drinks, but not from moving vehicles. Discounts are available when multiple teams from the same association or company register. Teams can take part in one, two or three daily stages. Categories include, among others, open class, corporate teams, women’s teams and club teams.

name: Trosa Stadslopp
description: Trosa Stadslopp is a traditional community celebration and running race held every year on the Friday after Midsummer in the beautiful summer town of Trosa. The race offers categories for all ages and ability levels, from young children to elite runners, on a varied course through the town centre and close to the water. Chip timing and several start groups create a welcoming, race-friendly atmosphere for both recreational and competitive runners. Trosa Stadslopp is known for its positive atmosphere, enthusiastic spectators and compact course, creating a unique running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs through summery Trosa, close to the water
Chip timing with two intermediate timing points in the 8.9 km race
Competitive and recreational categories for all ages and ability levels
additional: Race bibs with disposable chips are handed out from 10:00 on race day at Team Sportia Trosa. The cutoff time to reach the lap point in the 8.9 km race is 40 minutes. Start groups are available for elite runners, and runners in categories 1 and 2 can choose their start group. The jogging and Nordic walking events start shortly before the competitive categories. Parking is available, with a voluntary fee supporting youth activities. All runners receive 50 cl of Vitamin Well at the finish of the 8.9 km and 4 km races. Registration is available via the race’s registration portal; late and on-site registration have specific dates and fees.

name: Sillamäe promenaadijooks
description: Sillamäe Promenade Run is a well-known city race held near the Sillamäe Cultural Centre. The race began as a stair run and has been called the Promenade Run since 2021. The event offers various distances, from short races for little ones to the adults’ 7 km main distance, which also challenges trained athletes. It is a community-oriented and engaging event, with several activities in addition to running, and important contributions from supporters and volunteers.

name: EUTR - Estonia Ultra-Trail Race
description: The 9th edition of the Estonia Ultra-Trail Race (EUTR) will take place on 26–27 June 2026 in Narva, Ida-Virumaa County, Estonia. The race starts and finishes at the Akkekula (Nut Hill) sports complex. Organized by the non-profit sports club SK ETR, the event features trails certified by the International Trail Running Association (ITRA), with finishers eligible for ITRA points. The race offers several distances for trail runners of different levels, including an ultra-trail and shorter trail options.

name: Fjällmaraton Gastronomi
location: Ottsjö and Trillevallen, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Fjällmaraton Gastronomi is a relaxed mountain marathon offering an experience-filled day in the Åre Mountains, with good food and drink served along the classic mountain marathon trails. Participants can choose between two distances, 22 km and 43 km, both following well-marked trails, with starts in Ottsjö and Trillevallen respectively and the finish in Ottsjö. With an open start time, runners and walkers can complete the course without time pressure, making the race an enjoyable experience in a mountain setting. Accommodation near the start and finish is recommended for the best transfer options.
course_highlights: Local food served at aid stations along the course
Well-marked mountain trails with scenic views
Two distances: 22 km and 43 km, starting in Ottsjö and Trillevallen respectively, and finishing in Ottsjö
additional: Entries can be transferred for a fee of 250 kr. Food and drink stations serve local food, and a kåsa (drinking cup) is provided for use at cup-free stations. Bus transfers to the start are available from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, with return transfers after the finish. Electronic chip timing. A safety team is in place to respond quickly to accidents. The number of start places is limited (400 participants). The open start time allows participants to complete the course without time pressure. Those who want to take it easy are advised to start early. The entry fee includes, among other things, food and drink stations and bus transfers.

name: Jordgubbslunken
description: Jordgubbslunken is a popular fun run held every year on the first Saturday after Midsummer in Rudskoga. Participants can choose between 6 km and 10 km on winding village roads through a beautiful historic rural landscape, with gravel and grass surfaces. Children can take part in Minilunken, a 500-metre race. The event welcomes everyone from competitive recreational runners to families looking to enjoy a pleasant walk. All participants receive a litre of strawberries at the finish and have a chance to win great prizes.
course_highlights: 6 km loop on gravel roads
10 km loop on gravel roads and well-mown grass
Beautiful winding village roads through the historic rural landscape
additional: Start and finish at Grunnebacka School. Categories for men, women and children. All participants receive a litre of strawberries at the finish. A generous prize table is offered, and a top prize is drawn using the race number. Start and finish at Grunnebacka School. All finishers receive strawberries and a medal; the top prize is drawn using the race number. Prices shown are from previous events and may change for 2027.

name: Silverleden Ultra 100 Miles
location: Silvergruvan, Hällefors Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Silverleden Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon in Bergslagen, with several distances ranging from 9 km to 100 miles. The races follow the well-marked Silverleden, a hiking trail with hilly terrain and beautiful views. Silverleden Ultra 100M is known as one of Sweden’s toughest 100-mile races, with a high DNF rate, while the shorter distances offer tough but accessible challenges for different runners. The event includes transport to the start for some distances and nearby accommodation options. The race is marked by a love of running and a strong sense of community in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: Hilly, trail-filled terrain with steep climbs
Fantastic views from the hilltops along the trail
Well-marked hiking trail with bridges over marshes and waterways
additional: Bus transport is included in the entry fee for the 33 km and 100-mile races, departing at 13:00 on Friday for 100M and 11:30 on Saturday for 33K. Children and young people can take part in the 9 km race for free when accompanied by a registered adult. A limited number of caravan and motorhome pitches are available at the start and finish; book by email. To have a name and club/town printed on the race bib, register by 31 May. Silverleden Ultra’s program includes distances of 9 km, 33 km, 64 km and 100 miles. The official website lists the race weekend as 2–3 July 2027, which does not match the stated date of 26 June.

name: Muraste jooks
description: The Muraste Run is part of the Harku Municipality running series and takes place on June 28, 2026, at Muraste School Stadium. The course runs along Muraste’s streets and shared-use paths, on marked roads open to traffic. A variety of distances are offered for both children and adults, as well as a family competition. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each age group, and participants who complete the series receive a season medal. The event is organized by MTÜ TreeningPluss, which promotes the joy of movement and an active lifestyle.

name: Märgatud laps jooksmas
description: The charity running series “Märgatud Laps jooksmas” takes place at the Kose song festival grounds and offers participants the chance to enjoy a sporting experience while supporting a good cause. The series aims to bring the community together and make the joy of exercise accessible to all age groups. The event is open to everyone interested in running and creates a friendly, supportive atmosphere.

name: TrailÖvik
location: Själevad, Örnsköldsvik Municipality, Västernorrland County, Sweden
description: TrailÖvik is a trail race in Själevad with four different courses to suit all levels. Participants can enjoy a challenging running experience in magnificent natural surroundings, with fantastic trails and fairytale views of the World Heritage Site of the High Coast. The course has been praised by both recreational and elite runners for its fun trails, challenging climbs and beautiful views, with no gravel roads or asphalt. The event has a welcoming, family atmosphere while still being professional, and is well worth travelling to experience.
course_highlights: Fantastic trails in magnificent natural surroundings
Fairytale views of the World Heritage Site of the High Coast
Challenging climbs and no asphalt sections
additional: Race bibs must be collected at the arena no later than 30 minutes before the start. On-site registration opens at the arena and closes 30 minutes before each start. The courses are marked with signs and tape, but runners are encouraged to study the map carefully before starting. Printed maps are available at the beginning of Älgstråket, and digital maps can be downloaded to the Avenza Maps app. Spiked shoes are recommended in wet weather due to slippery rock slabs. Safety staff are available at checkpoints and the finish to help with minor injuries and discomfort. Results are posted immediately after finishing at the arena and on the website. It is possible to test-run the courses.

name: Böda Beach Run
location: Böda Sand Beach Resort, Löttorp, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Beach Run is a challenging and fun race for the whole family, with distances ranging from 500 metres to 10 kilometres. The race takes place on the beautiful, long sandy beach at Böda Sand Beach Resort on Öland, offering a unique and scenic running experience. Everyone who finishes receives a medal as a keepsake. The event is held annually and is part of Böda Sand’s wide range of summer activities and events.
course_highlights: Run on one of Öland’s most beautiful beaches, with almost two miles of white sand
Courses ranging from 500 metres to 10 kilometres
Family-friendly race with a medal for everyone who finishes
additional: The race is part of Böda Sand’s summer programme, with activities for the whole family. There are several distances to choose from, making it accessible to both children and adults. Böda Sand also offers many other sports and leisure activities alongside the event. Everyone who finishes receives a medal. An accommodation offer at Böda Sand has previously been mentioned in the race information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.bodasand.se/evenemang/): 2027-06-30 — "Böda Beach Run — 30 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-23)

name: Millionfiskløpet 27
description: Millionfiskløpet is a 4.2-kilometer race in Sjøvegan in Troms. The race has been held in early July, with start lists and results for participants. Take part in a short, straightforward running challenge in Sjøvegan.
course_highlights: 4.2 km course
Held in Sjøvegan in Troms
The race has been held in early July

name: Byrundan
location: Unos park, Gamleby, Västervik Municipality, Sweden
description: Byrundan is a running race held in Gamleby, starting and finishing in Unos Park. The race offers distances for all ages, from children to adults, on a beautiful summer course through Gamleby. There are several categories and distances, including children’s and youth races, as well as a joint start for the 4 km and 8 km races. All participants receive a medal after finishing, and prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, along with sprint prizes in the 4 km and 8 km races. Byrundan is part of TOUR DE RUN and is organised by Gamleby OK.
course_highlights: The course runs through beautiful summer scenery in Gamleby
Start and finish in Unos Park
Water stations at the start/finish and at 4 km
additional: Race numbers can be collected in Unos Park from 15:00 until one hour before the start. Children are offered hamburgers/sausages after the race, sponsored by ICA Supermarket. Medals are sponsored by Metallfabriken Norden AB. Professional timing by Racetimer. The prize ceremony takes place at approximately 19:25 for children and 20:45 for everyone else. A sprint prize at 450 m for the 4 km and 8 km races is a gift card worth 3000 kr. The 8 km course record comes with a 1000 kr prize.

name: Lofoten Skyrace
description: HOKA Lofoten Skyrace is a spectacular trail race held in Svolvær, with three distances: 15 km, 32 km and 42 km. The courses offer varied, technical terrain, panoramic views, challenging ridges and experiences in nature whatever the weather. The race takes place over two days, with the marathon distance on 2 July and the shorter distances on 3 July 2027. A dedicated SkyCrew helps ensure a great race experience and safety along the way. Participants must be self-sufficient with drinks and nutrition, and must carry the mandatory equipment.
course_highlights: 42 km with approximately 2,000 metres of elevation gain over Matmora, Isvatnryggen and Tjeldbergtinden
Technical, varied terrain with panoramic views and challenging ridges
Natural and staffed drink stations along the way on all distances
additional: Registration opens on 15 September 2026 at 12:00, with a queue system to ensure fair allocation. Bib collection takes place at Sport1 in Svolvær in the days before the race. A HOKA shake-out run and Kids race are also held beforehand. Bus transport to the marathon start is available. Runners must bring a fully charged mobile phone, drinks and nutrition, and mandatory equipment may be checked before the start. Registration for 2027 opens on 15 September 2026 at 12:00. Participants in the 42 km race must be at least 18 years old and must provide their own drinks and nutrition. Bus transport to the start can be selected during registration, and the courses may be changed at short notice due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 22. Emumäe jooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 brings together recreational athletes and active people from spring to autumn, offering a chance to test their abilities in different age groups and distances. The 22nd Emumäe Run is the series’ fifth stage and takes place on 4 July at Emumäe. The series aims to popularise running and fitness walking and support local recreational athletes. Races are held over several distances, from short children’s races to main races of up to 10 km. Timing is chip-based, and race numbers must be attached to the stomach or chest.

name: Võhma terviseraja maraton
description: The Võhma health trail marathon is a trail marathon held on the health trail in the town of Võhma. The course is a 620-metre loop that must be completed 68 times, for a total of 42.2 km. The race takes place on 4 July 2026, starting at 9:00, and offers participants a medal, timekeeping, course support, refreshments at the finish, and washing facilities. In addition to the marathon, there is an opportunity to run a shorter distance for free and without timekeeping, suitable for everyone who enjoys being active.

name: J. Lossmanni mälestusjooks
description: The Jüri Lossmann Memorial Run is a traditional running competition held in Viljandi. The event takes place on 4 July 2026, starting at 19:00. The run is dedicated to Jüri Lossmann and offers participants the chance to enjoy a pleasant summer evening and a sporting challenge.

name: Kolmårdsrundan / Kolmården Ultra Trail
description: Kolmården Ultra Trail is a challenging and scenic running experience in the deep forests of Kolmården, with distances of 45 km and 60 km. The course offers varied terrain, with forest trails, mountain ridges featuring spectacular views, sections along the shores of Bråviken, and technical running in nature reserves. The race is suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners seeking a memorable trail experience. At the finish, participants receive a medal and a light meal, included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Start in Kolmården Forest, with trails through varied terrain
Views from the mountain ridge at Kvarseboklint and running along the shores of Bråviken
Technical and challenging running through Bråviksbranten Nature Reserve
additional: Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, running vest/backpack/belt with at least 0.5 L of fluids, a pressure bandage/blood stopper, and a map with the emergency number (provided at bib collection). Aid stations: the 45K has 4 stations, and the 60K has 5 stations offering sports drink, energy products, and water. The cutoff time for the 45K is 13:30 at 44 km (pace 9:00 min/km). Participants are served a light meal at the finish. Start and finish at Klintvallen in Kvarsebo. Medical services are available on site. After finishing, participants receive a medal and are offered hot vegetarian soup. Mandatory equipment rules apply; aid stations are located along the course.

name: Mörksuggejakten TrailRun

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startavgift före 1/7 Barn och ungdom upp till 16 år 150 kr

description: Mörksuggejakten is one of Sweden’s most popular events in the long-distance race cup, offering a top-class competition since 1997. The cycling race in Rättvik features a beautiful and varied course covering 74 km, with a shorter 46 km option. The route passes through Rättvik, climbs to heights with breathtaking views over Lake Siljan, follows gravel roads and trails, and passes distinctive locations such as Dalhalla and Springkällan. Younger participants can take part in Lilla Mörksuggejakten, with several spectator-friendly courses in the Jarl area. Mörksuggejakten TrailRun also offers 10 km and 20.8 km runs starting from IK Jarl Rättvik.
course_highlights: The course offers beautiful views over Lake Siljan from the heights around Vidablick and the Hedsåsen summer pastures
The route follows gravel roads and trails, and crosses narrow suspension bridges over the Enån valley
Passes distinctive locations such as Dalhalla, Springkällan and Kungshol
additional: Mass start for all classes at 09:30. Maximum time: 5 hours. Race bibs can be collected on race day from 08:00 at IK Jarl. The courses are marked with red-and-white tape and signs. The course is 95% trail and 5% gravel road. It is permitted to switch to a shorter distance during the race. Parking is available at Rättvik Arena; camping in the parking area is prohibited.

name: 6. Navi jooksu-kõnnitiir
description: The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series is a multi-stage series of running and walking events offering a range of distances for both adults and children. The main distances vary from approximately 5 to 8 kilometres, and the course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel roads, with a small section on soft terrain. The series also includes mini distances and runs for young children, suitable for all age groups. The events take place in various locations across Võrumaa, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy the region’s beautiful nature and sporting community.

name: Navi jooksutiir
description: Navi Run is a running, Nordic walking and walking event held in Võru County and organized by Navi Village Association. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy exercise and a healthy lifestyle in beautiful surroundings, and is suitable for participants of different abilities. Navi Run is part of a broader initiative to promote physical activity, with the aim of supporting an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone who enjoys being active is invited to enjoy a sporty day and the joy of movement.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a three-stage running series inviting both recreational and experienced runners to enjoy an active time outdoors. At each stage, participants can choose between a lap of the approximately 5 km health trail and a 10 km race. There is also an exciting power run to find the best ratio of strength to speed. Series finishers are eligible for prizes and prize draws, including a bicycle as the grand prize. Participation is free, and registration is available online and on-site.

name: 7. ETAPP
description: Käime Koos is a recreational sports series by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev, inviting participants to take part in various hiking and walking stages across Estonia. The 7th stage takes place on Kesselaid, offering participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment. The series aims to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle through hiking and walking together. Participants can experience varied terrain and combine exercise with good company.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment
Varied terrain suitable for walking and hiking
The series takes place in different parts of Estonia, showcasing local natural beauty
additional: Käime Koos stages take place in different locations across Estonia, where participants can enjoy nature and physical activity. The series is organised by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev. More information and contact: Sirje Soovik +372 506 2250.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 4. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 4th stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event around Lake Viljandi on the health and ski trail. The race is part of the traditional Joosu Series, offering participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The course has good footing and is suitable for runners of different abilities. The event is organised by the Joosu Recreational Sports Club, which welcomes all running enthusiasts to take part.

name: Vooremäe tipujooks
description: Vooremäe Tipujooks is a running competition organized by the Tartumaa Sports Association and held at Vooremäe. It is a traditional summer sporting event that invites running enthusiasts to take part and offers the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and competitive sport. The competition is part of the Tartumaa sports calendar and is suitable for runners of different ability levels.

name: 45. jooks ümber Pühajärve
location: Pühajärve Spa & Holiday Resort, Otepää, Valga County, Estonia
description: The 45th Run Around Lake Pühajärv is a traditional running race held around Pühajärv Spa & Holiday Resort. The distance is 10.7 km, and the course is well marked and secured, offering participants beautiful views of the lake. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its third event. The start is at 12:00 on Saturday, July 11. Participants are provided with timing, refreshment stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A 10.7 km course around Lake Pühajärv
Refreshment stations at 4.4 km and 7.7 km
The course is marked and secured by course marshals
additional: Start groups are formed based on previous results; elite runners may start in the first group. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the back of the race bib. Participants receive a medal, sports drink and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance along the entire course. The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:30, with awards for the top six. Participants can register on site, and discounts are available. The course runs around Lake Pühajärv and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triatlon 2026
location: Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triathlon takes place on 11 July 2026 at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre and offers an exciting recreational triathlon experience. The main distance consists of a 250 m swim, a 20 km mountain-bike ride and a 4 km run, which runs largely along the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Protection Area. In addition to the main event, participants can take part in the Stebby duathlon and youth duathlon, which are intended for different age groups. The event is well organised, with chip timing, medical support and aid stations. After the race, participants receive a medal and can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and bike washing facilities.
course_highlights: The swim takes place in the pond at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre; one lap, with a maximum depth of 2.5 m
The 20 km cycling course follows the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Protection Area
The 4 km trail run is marked and secured
additional: Starts are staggered in waves of five, with a 10-second interval between each start. Competitors must wear a helmet while cycling and a timing chip around their ankle. The entry fee includes medical first aid, aid-station service, a medal, hot soup, a smoothie, access to a sauna and hot tub, and bike washing. There is a bag drop at the event centre and a place to change clothes in the sauna anteroom. The swim number must be written on the cheek or shoulder with a waterproof marker. Drafting is allowed during the cycling leg. Trail course, family races, free soup and sauna, registration information, entry fees vary, limited number of places

name: Mõisa jooks
organizer: SK Team Kehtna ja Alutaguse vallavalitsus
description: Kehtna Manor Run is a friendly, community-focused running event held in the grounds of Kehtna Manor. It offers three distances: a 5 km main race, a 2.5 km youth race, and a 500 m children’s race, welcoming participants of different ages. Alongside the races, the event features Children’s Day activities, pony rides, and trampolines, creating a pleasant family-day atmosphere. It is organized by SK Team Kehtna, which is dedicated to promoting sport and physical activity in the community.

name: 5. Pühajärve pargimiil
description: The 5th Pühajärve Park Mile is a 1.6 km running race held in the park of Pühajärve Holiday Resort on Saturday, July 11, 2026. The start and finish are at the same location, and the race begins at 12:10. The race is open to all running enthusiasts and offers a pleasant opportunity to enjoy a run in a beautiful park setting. Participants are provided with a medal, a race bib, chip timing, sports drink and water at the finish, and medical assistance along the entire course.

name: Pajusi Mudajooks
organizer: MTÜ Sporty ja MTÜ Pajusi Küla Selts
description: Pajusi Mudajooks is a popular mass-participation sporting event in Central Estonia, offering participants an exciting and adventurous obstacle course on a route of up to 10 km. The event takes place on July 11, 2026, in Pajusi village and is suitable for both individual runners and teams. The course features natural and man-made obstacles that challenge participants’ physical and mental endurance. Separate courses are available for children, and all finishers receive a medal as a keepsake. Free parking and hot soup after the run are provided for participants.

name: Böda Sandsloppet
location: Böda Sand SportCamp, Böda, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Sandsloppet is a family-friendly running race held at Böda Sand SportCamp on Öland. The race offers several distances for both children and adults, with routes through lovely forest terrain. Adults can choose between 6.5 km and 4 km, while shorter distances are available for children and young people. All participants who finish the race receive a medal as a keepsake. The event has a welcoming atmosphere and is open to runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Route through lovely forest terrain
Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp
Distances available for both children and adults
additional: Late registration is available through 8 July, followed by race-number collection on race day from 15:00. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. Children and young people under 11 are not timed and there is no prize ceremony for them. Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp. Register by 3 July 2027; late registration is available for a higher fee. Children aged 11 and under are not timed and there is no prize ceremony.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/bodasandsloppet/): 2027-07-10 — "Tid & datum 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-02)

name: Musköloppet
description: Musköloppet is a popular running race held in the spectacular archipelago setting of Muskö. The race has a long tradition and celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2022, after being paused during the pandemic. There are several different courses and categories, including children’s races, and the event offers a wonderful nature experience, with the start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård. Late registration is available on site up to one hour before the start.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the beautiful archipelago setting of Muskö
Start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård
Children’s races over 1.5 km and 2.5 km for different age groups
additional: Late registration is available on site at the start and finish area up to one hour before the race begins. There are water stations along the course, and runners may arrange their own drinks. Race management may decide to restart the race if needed. Pacing assistance from non-competitors is not permitted. The children’s races start at 10:00 for 1.5 km (ages 7–10) and at 10:30 for 2.5 km (ages 11–14). The countdown on the official website indicates 10 July 2027. However, the published times and distances on the website are for 2026. The relay costs 150 kr per team, and the children’s race for ages 4–6 is free, according to the published information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.muskoloppet.se/): 2027-07-10 — "Nedräkning till Musköloppet 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-10)

name: Gotland Run 511k (2026)
description: Gotland Run 511k is a unique running adventure and a journey to explore your inner landscape. It is not a traditional race, but a self-supported run around the beautiful island of Gotland, including a loop around Fårö, starting and finishing in Visby. Participants have 10 days to complete the approximately 511 km course, with support from four Angel Stations along the way. The organizer provides basic support, while runners are responsible for their own food and accommodation.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Visby, Gotland’s medieval capital
Clockwise loop around the island, including Fårö
Mixed terrain with asphalt, gravel roads, and shorter trails
additional: Participants must check in twice daily using an online tool. Accommodation on the first night is at Visby Fängelse Hostel in shared rooms. A pre-race dinner and briefing are held the evening before the start. Angel Stations offer support, water, rest, and sometimes shower facilities. The ferry to Fårö runs every 30 minutes, but requires a call between 22:00 and 05:30. The run must be completed on foot within 10 days, averaging approximately 51 km per day. Luggage storage is available at the hostel. Parking is available near the ferry terminal, with cheaper options at Visby Airport. This is a self-supported event: participants are responsible for most of their food and logistics. The entire distance must be completed on foot within ten days, with regular position reports.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://runtrip.se/race-memo-2027/): 2027-07-10 — "SATURDAY, JULY 10 — The race starts at 10:00 am outside the main entrance of Visby Fängelse" (was estimated 2027-07-03)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: SATURDAY, JULY 10 — The race starts at 10:00 am outside the main entrance of Visby Fängelse

name: Branäsutmaningen
description: Branäsutmaningen is a summer adventure in Branäs featuring a challenging 6-kilometre course. Branäs is known for its beautiful natural surroundings and family-friendly outdoor activities all year round. In summer, activities include mountain biking, padel and water activities by the Klarälven River. Branäs is investing in family-friendly cycling trails and scenic hiking trails, making it a perfect place for an active and fun summer experience.
course_highlights: A challenging 6-kilometre course
Family-friendly downhill trails and wide cross-country trails
A scenic location by the Klarälven River, with hiking trails and fishing
additional: Branäs offers family-friendly lift-accessed cycling, with the six-seat express lift Sjöexpressen at the heart of its cycling programme. There are barbecue and rest areas with views, miles of gravel and paved roads for training, and cycling tracks for children at Soltorget. Food and drinks are available at Ladan restaurant in the centre. The summer map includes a pump track, zipline, trampoline with a big airbag, and trails in Logläntan. Start at 14:00 at Soltorget. Family Day also includes Björnbuseloppet for children, an after-run and an evening of live music. The first prize in the race is a family ski holiday.

name: Rástegáisái
description: Rástegáisái 2027 is a traditional uphill race and hiking event in Tana, Finnmark, organized by Sirbmá-Sirbma IL. The recreational hike starts between 08:00 and 12:30, and the uphill race has a mass start at 13:00 for all categories. Participants must bring a backpack with full-coverage outerwear for the descent. A hydration belt is recommended, as there is only one water station along the route. All participants receive a finisher’s prize, and prizes are awarded to the top three in every category. The event offers a challenging mountain route through beautiful scenery, with the opportunity to earn fitness points and visit a Perletur checkpoint along the way.
course_highlights: Uphill race with a challenging climb
Only one water station along the route, at the camp below the mountain
Opportunity to earn fitness points and visit a Perletur checkpoint along the way
additional: All uphill-race participants must bring a backpack with full-coverage outerwear for the descent. Runners without a backpack that meets the requirements will receive a 15-minute time penalty. Runners and hikers who have not reached the summit by 16:00 will be turned back by marshals. Hikers taking the shortest route (4 km) may start as late as 15:55.

name: Melbuløpet
location: Melbu torg, Melbu, Hadsel, Nordland, Norway
description: Melbuløpet takes place at Melbu Square and offers three officially measured distances: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km on a very flat, fast course, offering good opportunities to achieve fast times. A children’s race of approximately 600 metres is also held for the youngest participants. The race is part of Sommer-Melbu, a long-running summer festival held since 1986 and characterised by broad local involvement and a strong volunteer spirit.
course_highlights: Very flat and fast course
Three officially measured distances: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
Children’s race of approximately 600 metres
additional: The children’s race starts at 15:30 and the competitive race categories start at 16:00. Children’s race participants register on site. The race is held as part of the Sommer-Melbu festival, which lasts ten days and is run by volunteers. The listed start location is Melbu Square. Registration for the competitive race categories is via EQ Timing, while children’s race participants register on site.

name: PALMS Südasuve Challenge - Võsu 2026
location: Võsu, Lääne-Nigula vald, Lääne County, Estonia
description: PALMS Midsummer Challenge - Võsu 2026 is a sporting summer event held in the town of Võsu. It is an enjoyable and active challenge for running enthusiasts, offering the chance to enjoy summer nature and community support. The event is part of the Estonian Night Run series and brings together runners from different regions. Võsu’s beautiful coastal scenery provides excellent conditions for a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Coastal scenery in the town of Võsu
A pleasant, active summer running environment
Part of the Estonian Night Run series
additional: The event includes a range of swimming distances and is open to both local and virtual participants, offering summer sea air and sport in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Vimka tõusu maraton
description: Vimka Tõusu Marathon is a summer marathon on the Viimsi Peninsula, offering participants one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied course includes both paved roads and forest trails, with several climbs and descents that make the run exciting and varied.

name: Semesterhalvmaran
location: Torps herrgård, Kumla Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
