description: Semesterhalvmaran is a recurring running event organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, inviting runners to experience the beautiful open landscapes of the Närke Plain. The race starts and finishes at Torps herrgård outside Kumla and offers a lovely running experience on gravel roads among rolling grain fields. After a two-year break, the race returns on July 11, 2027, welcoming runners of all levels to take part in a community filled with the joy of running. LK Gränslöst is an inclusive club that aims to bring runners from across the country together and build a strong community around running.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Torps herrgård outside Kumla
Run on gravel roads among rolling grain fields on the Närke Plain
Beautiful, nature-rich surroundings on the Närke Plain
additional: Registration is planned to open in January. The race is organized by the running club LK Gränslöst, which also organizes other races and group training every Wednesday at 18:00 in Örebro. The club focuses on community and the joy of running for all levels.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Söndagen den 11 juli 2027 är det åter dags för löpning på Närkeslätten när den är som bäst!

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of track and field events combining throwing, jumping, and running disciplines. The series consists of several stages, where participants can compete in different distances and events, with the IAAF scoring tables used to determine the rankings. The competitions take place at Võru Stadium and are open to athletes of varying abilities. The series offers a varied track and field experience for both recreational and advanced athletes.

name: Västervik City Run
description: Västervik City Run is a city race of approximately 6.3 km that takes place in and around central Västervik, starting and finishing at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget. The race offers a scenic course along the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken, passing landmarks including the Stegeholm Castle ruins and Myntbryggan. After finishing, participants receive a medal as proof of their participation. The race is a popular summer tradition that welcomes runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A city race of approximately 6.3 km in central Västervik
The course follows the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken and passes the Stegeholm Castle ruins
Start and finish at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget
additional: A children’s race (Sparbanksloppet) of 800 m for children up to 10 years old, with a group start from Fiskaretorget at 18:30. Participants receive medals after finishing. A separate Sparbanksloppet of approximately 700 metres is offered for children up to 10 years old. Registration for the 2027 race opens on 1 May.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.vikhockey.se/boka-bord-2/city-run/): 2027-07-12 — "Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!" (was estimated 2027-07-05)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!

name: Lüllemäe mägedejooks
description: Lüllemäe Mountain Run is the third event in the Valgamaa running series and takes place on the Lüllemäe health trails. The main race distance is 4.5 km, and children’s toddler and mini runs are also held at the Lüllemäe Basic School stadium. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and offers a chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting competitive atmosphere. Children’s runs are free, and the main race entry fees are reasonable, encouraging broad participation.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 9. Rakvere valla Suvejooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 is a multi-stage running and walking series featuring various running competitions in the Lääne-Virumaa region. Stage 9, Rakvere Municipality Summer Run, takes place on 18 July 2026 at Kooli 4 in Rakvere. The series aims to offer a sporting challenge and enjoyment to running enthusiasts and support an active lifestyle throughout the region.

name: Väinjärve jooks , 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VI etapp
description: The Järvamaa Lakes Runs is a traditional running series made up of several stages around different lakes in Järvamaa. The Väinjärve Run, taking place on 18 July 2026, is the series’ sixth stage. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and varied terrain around the lake. The series offers several distances and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Lidingöloppet Funäsfjällen
description: Lidingöloppet Funäsfjällen is a challenging trail race in a mountain setting, with steep climbs, sloping trails and flat meadows offering fantastic views of the mountains. The race combines adrenaline-filled running with scenic experiences and is held at Bruksvallarna ski stadium in Bruksvallarna. This is the fourth edition of the race, welcoming runners to a unique and beautiful challenge in the Swedish mountains.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and sloping trails
Flat meadows with incredible mountain views
A downhill stretch towards Bruksvallarna village after a tough climb
additional: Bib pick-up takes place at the venue in Bruksvallarna. A late-entry fee of SEK 100 applies to registrations on race day. During the week before the race, running clinics, shoe testing, try-out mountain running sessions and other activities are held in Bruksvallarna. Water stations and food and drink stations are available along the course.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.lidingoloppet.se/lidingoloppet-funasfjallen): 2027-07-17 — "Date 17 juli" (was estimated 2027-07-10)

name: Yttersia Skyrace Senja
description: Yttersia Skyrace Senja is a rugged and accessible skyrace held on the spectacular outer side of Senja, starting and finishing at Yttersia Base in Skaland. The course takes participants through dramatic coastal mountain terrain with long ridgelines, steep cliffs and fantastic views of Bergsøyene, Steinfjorden and Okshornan. The race features a continuous, runnable climb to Husfjellet, followed by narrow, exposed ridges and challenging technical terrain. It finishes with a social atmosphere, music and an after-run gathering at the finish area. This race is for those who want to experience authentic Senja terrain and a day filled with community and good spirits.
course_highlights: Dramatic coastal mountain terrain with long ridgelines and steep cliffs
Continuous, runnable climb to Husfjellet (632 m above sea level) with spectacular views
Technical, untouched terrain at Nonshaugen, home to a historic graphite mine
additional: The race starts with a short stretch of gravel road before continuing onto trail and uphill terrain. There is one drinking station at Litjebrusen. The finish area at Yttersia Base offers music, an announcer, awards, food, drinks and an after-run gathering with a social atmosphere into the afternoon and evening. For 2026, the course is listed as running over gravel road, trail and technical mountain terrain, with one drinking station. These details are not confirmed for 2027.

name: 31. Jooks-kõnd ümber Uhtjärve
description: The 31st Run-Walk Around Lake Uhtjärv is a traditional running and walking series in the Võru region, offering a range of distances for every participant. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Lake Uhtjärv, providing a sporting challenge for both runners and walkers. The series includes various distances and mini-distances suitable for beginners and experienced athletes alike. The event is part of the Võru County running and walking series, known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.

name: Jooks ümber Uhtjärve
description: The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series is a multi-stage series of running and walking events, offering a range of distances for both adults and children. The main distances range from approximately 5 to 8 kilometres, and the course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel roads, with some off-road sections. The series also includes mini-distances and runs for toddlers, suitable for all age groups. The event is open to everyone interested in sport and promotes healthy lifestyles and community involvement.

name: Aastajooks
organizer: Spordiklubi Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi MTÜ
description: The Pärnu Annual Runs are a traditional running series that began in 1985 and are inspired by the Eastern calendar, dedicating each year to its corresponding symbolic animal. The 2026 series is themed around the Year of the Fire Horse and consists of nine stages held in three different areas of Pärnu: Vallikäär, Pärnu Beach, and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail. Three stages take place at each location, offering participants a varied and enjoyable running experience. The series aims to provide a sporting challenge and enjoyment for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series is a competition for sports enthusiasts in Kohila Parish, offering a variety of running opportunities for different age and ability groups. The series aims to promote recreational exercise and provide participants with an enjoyable sporting experience. Participants receive a beautiful commemorative medal at each stage, and the series standings are based on points. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Centre, which provides modern facilities and a strong sporting environment.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is a running series competition organised by Tartu Spordiselts Kalev and held in the city of Tartu. The series has several stages, offering opportunities to take part in track races across different age groups. Competitions are held mainly at Tamme and Ülenurme Stadiums and are aimed at both young people and adults, providing a sporty and friendly competition environment. Registration closes at 12:00 on race day, offering flexibility for participants.

name: Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail
description: Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail on maailman pohjoisin ultrajuoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään Utsjoella, Lapin erämaassa. Reitti kulkee Kaldoaivin korkeimpien tunturien huipuille ja tarjoaa upeita, haastavia maisemia. Kilpailu testaa juoksijoiden kestävyyttä ja taitoja vaativassa luonnossa, mutta palkitsee kokemuksella, joka saa monet palaamaan vuosittain. Tapahtuma sisältää myös maastopyöräkilpailuja ja tarjoaa monipuolisia vaihtoehtoja eri tasoisille osallistujille.
course_highlights: Reitti kulkee Kaldoaivin korkeimpien tunturien huipuille
Upeat ja karut Lapin erämaamaisemat
Vaativa ja opettavainen polkureitti
additional: Ilmoittautuminen kahdelle päivälle antaa -30% alennuksen halvemman sarjan hinnasta. Osallistumismaksu sisältää huoltopisteiden juoma- ja energiansaannin, peseytymismahdollisuudet, varustepussin kuljetuksen maaliin, lähtönumeron, ajanoton, Kaldoaivi Ultra Trail -kevytrepun, KUT-tuotteen ja Finisher-riipuksen. Sarjan vaihdot ja siirrot ovat maksuttomia 7.7.2027 asti. Kilpailukeskukset ja lähtöpaikat ovat Nuorgamissa ja Utsjoella. Kilpailun aikataulu sisältää useita lähtöaikoja eri matkoille 23.7. ja 24.7.2027. Kilpailun osallistujakiintiöt vaihtelevat matkoittain, esimerkiksi MTB & E-MTB 57 km: 100 osallistujaa, Trailrun 168 km: 100 osallistujaa. Tapahtuma sisältää useita matkoja, joihin sisältyvät trailrun, mountain biking ja maantiepyöräily, ilman mukavuuksia reitin varrella. Osallistumiseen sisältyy kilpailunumero, aikamittauschippi, kevyt reppu ja finisher-riipus. Tapahtuma järjestetään heinäkuussa 2027, ja tarkemmat aikataulut ja ilmoittautumistiedot löytyvät verkkosivuilta.

name: Mispo maastikumaraton
description: Mispo Trail Marathon is a trail race held in the Kurgja area of North Pärnumaa. The race distances are 42.195 km (marathon), 21.097 km (half marathon), 14 km and 7 km. The start is at the C. R. Jakobson Farm Museum at 11:00, and the race office opens at 9:00. All finishers receive a drink, food, access to the sauna, a diploma and a medal at the finish. The traditional event is organised by Terviseklubi Mispo, an active sports club since 1989.

name: Sakala metsajooks
description: The Sakala Forest Run is a trail race held in the Metsarada area in Kurgja municipality. The event offers several distances, including a marathon, half marathon, and shorter 7 km and 14 km runs. The race starts at 11:00 from the C. R. Jakobson Farm Museum, and participants are provided with a drink, food, sauna, certificate, and medal at the finish. The traditional event is organised by the Mispo Health Club and offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere.

name: Helags Fjällmara
description: Helags Fjällmara is a classic mountain marathon held in the Ljungdalsfjällen since 1985. The race offers several distances to suit all levels, from the challenging 42 km full marathon to the 800-metre children’s race. It offers a unique mountain experience amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain, and is family-friendly, with races for both adults and children. The start and finish are on the meadow in the centre of Ljungdalen, and the event includes energy and drink stations, a personal cup, a medal for everyone who finishes, and showers and a sauna after the race.
course_highlights: Trail race amid the beautiful mountain scenery of the Ljungdalsfjällen
Distances ranging from an 800 m children’s race to a 42 km full marathon
Start and finish on the meadow in the centre of Ljungdalen
additional: Mass start for all distances. Race bibs are distributed at the gymnasium by the event area, with a chip for electronic timing. Energy and drink stations along the course and after the finish. A medal for everyone who finishes. Showers and a sauna are available after the race. Participant caps apply to each distance; for example, 100 participants for the 42 km race. Children under a certain age must run with an adult.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://helagsfjallmara.se/): 2027-07-24 — "24 Juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-17)

name: Hornsjön Runt
description: Hornsjön Runt is a traditional running race around Öland’s only inland lake, through beautiful and varied Öland countryside. The race offers several distances for both young people and adults, including a walking class. Along the course, participants pass gravel roads with limestone surfaces, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each class.
course_highlights: The race goes around Öland’s only inland lake
Varied terrain including gravel roads, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes
Three water stations along the course, as well as at the start/finish
additional: A walking class is available for 5.5 km and 11 km, with start times between 13:00 and 16:00 and no timing. Showers and changing facilities are available at Högby Idrottsplats. Prizes are awarded to the top three in all classes. The start and finish are at Pensionat Hornsjön. Youth classes have different start times between 15:30 and 16:00, depending on age and distance. There are distances for children and young people, as well as an untimed walking class. Everyone who finishes receives a medal.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/hornsjon-runt/): 2027-07-24 — "Tid & datum 24 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-17)

name: Hamra Trail Run 2026
description: Hamra Trail Run is a friendly, exclusive trail running event held in spectacular mountain surroundings at Pensionat Strandgården in Fjällnäs. The event offers three distances—Sprint 12 km, Distance 24 km and Ultra 48 km—with varying elevation gain and aid stations along the course. Runners are expected to be self-sufficient and follow the clearly marked orange flags along the route. The event is limited to a maximum of 150 participants and is known for its community spirit and scenic experience.
course_highlights: Sprint 12 km with approximately 300 m of elevation gain and 1 aid station at 4 km
Distance 24 km with approximately 630 m of elevation gain and 2 aid stations at 4 km and 20 km
Ultra 48 km with approximately 1,300 m of elevation gain and 4 aid stations, including at the start/finish
additional: Race bibs are collected at the race office on race day, with different collection times depending on the distance. A mandatory pre-race briefing is held before the start. Runners must bring their own cup/mug/bottle, as disposable cups are not used at the aid stations. Mandatory equipment includes an extra layer, a wind jacket/wind pants depending on the weather, a first-aid kit including an elastic bandage, and a fully charged mobile phone with the safety number saved. Parts of the courses are muddy and unmarked, particularly across Skenörsfjället, where the terrain is dense and rugged. The cut-off time for the 24 km is 3.5 hours, with a maximum time of 8 hours. Runners are encouraged to stop and help others if needed and to follow the flags carefully. GPX files for all distances are available. According to the available race information, the number of entries is limited to 150. A runners’ dinner is held after the finish.

name: KFC Südasuve Challenge - Pirita 2026
description: KFC Midsummer Challenge is a midsummer sports celebration taking place in Pirita for the third time. This community run offers beautiful views of the sea and the Old Town, with three distances to choose from. Participants can run, walk, or cover the distance with a stroller or walking poles. The start and finish are conveniently located in the same place on the beachfront, and the route follows a seaside pedestrian and cycling path without closing roads to traffic. All finishers will receive KFC gifts, and an event host and mascot will keep the spirits high.

name: Leigo Trail
description: Leigo Trail is a varied trail run in Southern Estonia, held around the Leigo Lakes. The race centre is at Leigo Tourism Farm, and the event offers a choice of distances and difficulty levels, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The routes follow forest trails, clay and gravel roads, and natural paths along the lakeshore, with technical climbs and descents and beautiful views. The event brings together nature, exercise, and community, offering an enjoyable experience for the whole family.

name: Iigaste metsajooks
description: The Iigaste Forest Run is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa running and Nordic walking series, held every summer. This forest run gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting challenge on the 7.4 km main course, as well as shorter running and Nordic walking distances. The event takes place in Iigaste village and is suitable for different age groups, with medals and diplomas awarded to the top finishers. Entry is affordable, and registration is conveniently available online.

name: Runmaröloppen 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Mini-Lunken 1.5km 60kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och en kula glass.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lunken 5.7km: från 150kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och finisherdryck.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Halvmarathon 21km: från 350kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och finisherdryck.

description: Runmaröloppen is a unique running event in the heart of the Stockholm archipelago on the island of Runmarö. The races offer a friendly, welcoming atmosphere and scenic courses suited to children, seniors and experienced runners alike. The start and finish are at Svängens Krog, and the day offers running, food, ice cream, swimming and a wonderful atmosphere. The half-marathon course is approximately 21 km long and is considered one of Sweden’s most beautiful, while Lunken, at 5.7 km, passes through lush sheep pastures and archipelago villages. Mini-Lunken and Antikrundan are shorter races for children and seniors, and there is also a dog class in which dogs receive an edible medal.
course_highlights: Half-marathon, 21 km around all of Runmarö, with historic and scenic views
Lunken, 5.7 km through lush sheep pastures and authentic archipelago villages
Mini-Lunken and Antikrundan, 1.5 km for children and seniors
additional: The start and finish are at Svängens Krog. Mini-Lunken starts at 11:00, and Lunken and the half-marathon start at 13:00. There are energy stations and encouragement around the island. After finishing, everyone receives a medal and a finisher drink; Mini and Senior Lunk participants are treated to ice cream. There are a maximum of 200 places for the half-marathon and 120 for Lunken in the first release, with another 30 places released later. A dedicated taxi boat runs between Stavsnäs Vinterhamn and Styrsvik, as does Vaxholmsbåt route #23. Race bibs can be collected at Svängen and Låttas Bageri. There will be an evening dinner and party at Svängen after the race. 20% of the surplus is donated to Skärgårdsstiftelsen. The event offers children’s races, a 5.7 km race and a 21 km half-marathon. Participant numbers are limited. According to the existing event information, 20 percent of the surplus goes to Skärgårdsstiftelsen.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.runmaroloppen.se/): 2027-07-25 — "Söndagen 25e juli - 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-18)

name: Salomon 27K
location: Ottsjö, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Salomon 27K is a mountain-running event covering 27 kilometres and crossing three mountains, with a beautiful finish in Ottsjö. Many consider it one of Sweden’s most beautiful races, offering a unique mountain experience and pure poetry in nature. Food and drink stations serving locally crafted food are available along the course, and a safety team can provide rapid assistance if needed. Participants can also take a bus transfer to the start and back after the finish.
course_highlights: 27 kilometres of mountain running across three mountains
Beautiful finish in Ottsjö
Food and drink stations serving locally crafted food
additional: Bus transfers to the start are available from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, as well as a return transfer after the finish. Electronic chip timing. A kåsa drinking cup is used at cup-free drink stations. A safety team is on hand to respond quickly to accidents. Entries can be transferred for a fee of 250 SEK. A large portion of the entry fee goes towards upgrading the Fjällmaraton trails for sustainable development. The race is part of Fjällmaratonveckan.

name: Pajūrio basatlonas
description: Pajūrio Basatlonas is a unique barefoot run on the seaside sand, held in Smiltynė, Klaipėda. The event takes place during the Sea Festival and gives participants an unforgettable experience of running between the sea and the dunes. The race promotes running culture in Lithuania and encourages a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose from several distances and enjoy the beautiful coastal scenery and gentle breeze.
course_highlights: Barefoot running on seaside sand
Start on the beach by the southern pier, Kopgalis, Smiltynė
Distances of 500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, with a 2-hour time limit
additional: A 2-hour time limit applies to all distances. Participants must have an identity document, a race number attached, and an electronic timing chip attached to their shirt. Participants run voluntarily and assume all risks associated with taking part. Barefoot running on seaside sand, various distances (500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km), online registration, regulations and rules, awards and commemorative medals.

name: Peak Performance Vertical K
description: Åre Vertical K is a prestigious vertical race held annually on Tuesday evening as part of Kia Fjällmaraton Årefjällen. The race starts with a mass start at Åre Torg and finishes at the summit of Åreskutan, gaining exactly 1,000 vertical metres. It is a demanding race, and participants can expect to give their all from start to finish. The course records to beat are 46:24 for women and 39:13 for men. Prize money is awarded to the top three finishers in both the women’s and men’s categories.
course_highlights: Mass start at Åre Torg
Finish at the summit of Åreskutan
Exactly 1,000 vertical metres
additional: Food and drink stations along the course featuring local food products. A kåsa is used for serving drinks at cup-free hydration stations. Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and bus transfers back after the finish. Electronic chip timing. Safety team for rapid response in the event of accidents. Entry can be transferred for a fee of SEK 250. Insurance is recommended to cover refunds in the event of illness or injury. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men. The course records are held by Emmie Collinge in 46:24 and Kilian Jornet in 39:13.

name: 10. ETAPP
description: TV 10 Olümpiastarti is a competition series organized by the Estonian Athletic Association for schoolchildren and young athletes. Competitions take place in various age groups and include a range of athletics events. The 10th stage takes place on July 29, 2026, at Tamme Stadium in Tartu, giving young athletes the opportunity to test their skills and gain experience. The series aims to support young people’s athletic development and provide a fun, motivating competition environment.

name: Fjällmaraton 100k
location: Fångåmon, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Fjällmaraton 100K is a classic mountain marathon that starts at dawn in Fångåmon and follows a beautiful, winding, easy-to-run trail to Vålådalen via Nulltjärn. The route then joins the classic Fjällmaraton course over Ottfjället and continues over Hållfjället, Grofjället and Välliste on the way back to Ottsjö. The race offers a unique atmosphere, with a recovery zone in the finish area where participants can relax in a sauna and recover with non-alcoholic beer. All participants must be self-sufficient during the race, with the option to refill water at official aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: Starts at dawn in Fångåmon
Beautiful, easy-to-run trail via Nulltjärn and Vålådalen
Passes over Ottfjället, Hållfjället, Grofjället and Välliste
additional: Food and aid stations along the course serving local artisanal food. The official drink is U Sport by Umara (lemon). Participants receive a Fold-a-Cup for use at the aid stations. Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and back after the finish. Recovery zone with a sauna and non-alcoholic beer in the finish area. Entries can be transferred for a fee of 250 SEK. A safety team is on hand to provide rapid assistance in the event of serious injuries. Participants are responsible for their own fluids and energy between the official aid stations.

name: Vormsi maraton
description: Vormsi Marathons VIII is a two-day running event on Vormsi Island, taking place on July 31 and August 1 near Sviby Harbour. Participants can choose the marathon or half-marathon distance on both days, with the courses running mainly on paved roads on Vormsi Island. The courses are marked, and timing is provided using electronic SI sticks. After the run, participants can join a social gathering and enjoy a sauna and hot soup at the finish. The event is small and friendly, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners.

name: 28. Holstre-Paistu maanteejooks Hanno Priksi mälestuseks
description: Holstre-Paistu Road Race is the fourth stage of Viljandi Municipality’s running series and takes place in Paistu. The race is intended for runners of all abilities and offers young people and adults alike the opportunity to take part. Participation in the series motivates runners to complete all four stages, and active participants are rewarded. The course runs through the scenic Viljandi County, offering an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Road race in the Paistu area
Participation opportunities in different age groups
Participants are motivated by awards in the running series

name: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane
description: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane is an obstacle course race held on the Lähte health trails. It is a varied and challenging run where participants climb, crawl, lift and are dragged through mud, water, sand and over hills. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers, offering an exciting and fun experience. The series aims to offer a multi-day competition where each stage has its own character, with an emphasis on both fun and physical challenge.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte is an obstacle race held on the Lähte health trails and at the outdoor gym. The courses are 4 km and 8 km long and offer participants a serious challenge, with a variety of obstacles testing both strength and agility. Vägilase jooks is Estonia’s most versatile obstacle race series event, suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers. The event is part of a series focused on terrain, obstacles and an adventurous experience.

name: Ottsjö 12k
location: Ottsjö, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn i åldern 10 -13 får springa tillsammans med förälder eller annan vuxen och endast betalar 200kr

description: Ottsjö 12K is a 12-kilometer mountain trail race with 300 meters of elevation gain. It offers a beautiful and memorable course without being as demanding as the longer distances during Fjällmaraton Week. The race is a perfect first step for runners who want to challenge themselves in a mountain setting and perhaps later try Salomon 27K or Kia Fjällmaraton. Children aged 10 to 13 can run with an adult at a reduced price, and youths aged 14 to 18 receive half off the entry fee. The race is organized with a focus on sustainability and safety, with food and drink stations along the course and bus transfers to the start and back from the finish.
course_highlights: 12 km of mountain trail with 300 meters of elevation gain
Beautiful and memorable course in a mountain setting
Food and drink stations featuring locally made food along the course
additional: Bus transfers to the start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker, and return bus transfers after finishing. Electronic chip timing. Safety organization for a rapid response in case of accidents. A kåsa (traditional drinking cup) is used at cup-free drink stations. Children aged 10–13 can run with an adult. Half price for youths aged 14–18. The standard minimum age is 14. Children aged 10–13 can participate with an adult for 200 kr, and participants aged 14–18 pay half the entry fee. The adult must stay in contact with the accompanying child throughout the race.

name: Bruksleden Terrängmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Sista dag för ordinarie anmälan är fredagen den 17 juli.

description: Bruksleden Trail Marathon is a trail race organised by Fagersta OK, offering two distances: 42 km (Helan) and 21 km (Halvan). The race follows the beautiful Bruksleden trail through forests, winding paths and past lakes, with varied and technically challenging terrain. With a limited number of 200 places, the event has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere. There are aid stations along the course staffed by volunteers, and after the finish, showers and a light meal are available. This is an ideal race for experienced trail runners and curious recreational runners alike who want to enjoy nature and a challenge.
course_highlights: Run through beautiful forests and along winding woodland trails
Pass sparkling lakes
Varied and technically challenging terrain with steep climbs and descents
additional: Places are limited to 200 to preserve a friendly atmosphere. There are aid stations along the course staffed by volunteers. Showers and a light meal are available after the finish. Previous editions have started and finished in the area around Fageråsen/Fagersta; the arrangements, distances and practical information for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Bodøryggen 2027
description: Bodøryggen is a spectacular mountain race in a national park, with two distances offering runners a unique experience and views of the Lofoten Wall, Landegode, Børvasstindan and Bodø city. The race is limited to 400 participants to preserve the quality of the experience. The start and finish are at The Wood Hotel on Rønvikfjellet, and the course crosses varied terrain from mountain to mountain. Participants receive a medal, food at the finish, spa access and transport to the start for half-marathon runners. This race is part of Bodø Run Festival, organised by Arctic Sport with a focus on authentic Arctic experiences and inclusive running events.
course_highlights: The 49 km ultradistance starts and finishes at The Wood Hotel and passes via Keiservarden, Junkerfjellet and several other mountain peaks
The 22 km half-marathon starts at Heia and finishes at The Wood Hotel, sharing part of the ultra course
Views of the Lofoten Wall, Landegode, Børvasstindan and Bodø city during the race
additional: Race bib collection is at Sport 1 Stormyra on Friday 30 July from 16:00 to 18:00 and at the start on race day. The spa on the 8th floor of Wood Hotel is open to participants after they finish. A long-sleeved wind jacket is mandatory. Transport to the start for the 22 km distance is available from Wood Hotel at 09:30, with limited places. There are water stations only on the 49 km distance; 22 km runners must bring their own drinks. Small snack stations with jellymen and fruit chews are available on both distances.

name: Altamila (NNM 10km gateløp)
description: Altamila is an annual running event held in Alta in early August. The event offers three main distances: a 5 km recreational jog without timing, the 10 km Advanti Altamila, and the Sport 1 Alta Half Marathon. The courses are known as some of the easiest and fastest in Norway, offering good opportunities for personal records. The start and finish are at the athletics track in Alta Idrettspark, and the event also includes a children’s race.
course_highlights: The Advanti Altamila 10 km is a very flat and fast course, officially measured by the Norwegian Athletics Association.
The Sport1 Alta Half Marathon consists of two laps of the Altamila course, plus an extra lap around the athletics track.
The 5 km recreational jog follows the same course, with a turnaround after 2.5 km.
additional: Race numbers can be collected on Friday between 12 and 19, or on race day from 12 to 16. There is a water station approximately 2.5 km from the start, and several in the finish area. All finishers receive a medal and have the chance to win draw prizes. The awards ceremony includes trophies for class winners and cash prizes for the fastest times and course records. Changing rooms and showers are available at Finnmarkshallen. Parking is available near the start area.

name: Vääna-Jõesuu jooks
description: The Vääna-Jõesuu Run is part of the Harku Municipality Running Series and takes place on August 2, 2026, at the Vääna-Jõesuu School stadium. The event offers several distances, from children’s races to the 5 km main race, which runs counterclockwise along the streets of Vääna-Jõesuu and a forest road. The series aims to motivate people to take part in sports and to promote the joy of exercise and an active lifestyle. The event is organized by local running and triathlon clubs in cooperation with the municipality and village associations.

name: Skärgårdsloppet
description: Skärgårdsloppet in Holmsund is a fun 7.4 km recreational race set in a beautiful archipelago environment. It is a Fun Run, meaning it is a recreational race with no official results list, except for the five fastest men and women. The start and finish are at Bräntebacken, and the course makes one loop around Lövöudden. All participants receive a medal, and the fastest man and woman receive a winner’s trophy.
course_highlights: 7.4 km course in an archipelago environment
Start and finish at Bräntebacken
One loop around Lövöudden
additional: The race is a Fun Run with no official timing for most participants, but times are recorded for the five fastest men and women. No times are recorded in the children’s race, and everyone is a winner. All participants receive the Skärgårdsloppet medal. The fastest man and woman receive a winner’s trophy. The main race is a Fun Run, with participants timing themselves in most cases. The children’s race is untimed.

name: ÜLEMISTE Ööjooks - Tallinn 2026
description: ÜLEMISTE Night Run - Tallinn 2026 is a running and walking event taking place in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn. The event offers an opportunity to get active and support well-being and health. It is part of a wider initiative to promote recreational physical activity in Estonia, organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban environment and support their mental and physical health.
course_highlights: Running and walking in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn
A great opportunity to get active and support your health
Organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity
additional: Participation involves running and walking; registration is open

name: Meråker Mountain Challenge
distance_verbose: 100 miles, 50 miles, 70 km, 50 km, Halvmaraton, 8 km, 2 km
description: Meråker Mountain Challenge is a demanding ultramarathon offering distances from 2 km to 161 km, including a spectacular 100-mile loop around Meråker Municipality. The courses feature varied terrain with mountains, forests, marshland and several peaks over 1,000 metres, and are suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and recreational runners. The event has a long tradition and also includes the Norwegian Championships in trail ultrarunning. The start and finish are at Teveltunet, and the race places a strong emphasis on safety, good logistics and runner support along the way.
course_highlights: The course crosses varied terrain with mountains, forests and marshland
The 70 km distance passes nine peaks over 1,000 metres in Meråker Municipality
The 100-mile loop goes around the entire municipality and features spectacular mountain sections
additional: All races start on Saturday, 1 August, except the 100 km and 100-mile races, which start on Friday evening. Race bibs are collected primarily at Teveltunet, and transport to and from the start is available by free bus with advance registration. Personal support is permitted on the 100K and 100M distances. Drinking water sources are not publicly monitored, and using a water filter is recommended. The event has offered several distances, including 8 km, 20 km, 50 km, 70 km, 100 km and 100 miles. On the 100-mile course, one drop bag may be handed in before the start and collected at Nøstmo after approximately 93 km.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 20. Tapa linnajooks
description: The Lääne-Viru County Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of running opportunities for different age groups and ability levels. The events take place in different locations across Lääne-Viru County, giving runners the chance to enjoy both urban and trail running. The 20th Tapa City Run takes place on August 8, 2026, near Tapa Gymnasium and is part of the series’ long-standing tradition of bringing together recreational athletes and running enthusiasts. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and provide enjoyable running experiences.

name: Paldiski liigub
description: Paldiski Moves is the third stage of the West-Harju Movement Series, held at Paldiski Sports Centre. The course passes Paldiski’s main attractions, streets and shared-use paths, offering participants beautiful natural views and a historic atmosphere. Free children’s races are organised for the younger members of the family, with an emphasis on the joy of movement and lifelong physical activity. The event takes place as part of Paldiski City Day, when the series’ top performers are awarded, and the evening ends with a concert.

name: Kia Fjällmaraton 45 km
description: Kia Fjällmaraton 45K is a demanding mountain marathon across classic mountain terrain, held during Fjällmaraton Week in the Åre area. The race dates back to 2005, and for 2026 the course is planned to cross Ottfjället along the event’s signature trail. The race welcomes both experienced mountain runners and curious beginners looking for an unusual and scenic challenge. To earn the well-known wooden medal, you must finish within the “medal time” (the winner’s time + 30%); all participants must be self-sufficient on the course.
course_highlights: The course crosses Ottfjället over classic mountain terrain
Food and hydration stations at Edsåsdalen (12 km, 25 km), Tobaksdalen (35.5 km), and Hållvallen (40 km)
Finish in Ottsjö, with a shared post-race lunch for all finishers
additional: Participants must be self-sufficient on the course; the official hydration product at the stations is Umara (2:1 lemon, 120 g/l). Water and toilets are available at the start in Trillevallen. Support along the course is not permitted except at the official stations. In addition to drinks, the stations offer bars, bananas, buns, and, at later stations, hot dogs, coffee, and broth. The race is approximately 45 km long with around 1,200 metres of elevation gain (according to a race report). Participants are self-sufficient between aid stations; official food and hydration are available at Edsåsdalen, Tobaksdalen, and Hållvallen. Kia offers Fjälltransfer, with free transfers between the finish and the parking area, as well as a bus between the finish and Undersåker/Åre. Accommodation in Åre near Kia Fjällmaraton includes, among other options, Hotel Åre Fjällsätra.

name: Stora Stöten Run
description: Stora Stöten Run is a trail race in the heart of the Falun Mine World Heritage Site, offering a historic and varied running experience. The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses, following old routes known as Vattnets Väg till Gruvan (The Water’s Way to the Mine). The race has three distances (21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km) and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational participants, with the option to run timed or untimed. The event is organised by the orienteering club OK Kåre, which welcomes participants to the start and finish at Falun Mine.
course_highlights: Three courses: 21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km, starting and finishing at Falun Mine
The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses along Vattnets Väg
Varied terrain: gravel, grass, trail tracks, nature paths and short paved sections; an initial climb and clearly marked downhill sections
additional: Start and finish at Falun Mine; warm-up begins at 12:10 on Falu Rödfärg’s paved area (approximately 7 minutes), led by Friskis & Svettis; all courses start at the same time, and runners are divided into two optional groups based on target pace (group 1: women ≤6 min/km, men ≤5 min/km). Runners can choose to run with or without timing; prizes go to the first three finishers on each course, with raffle prizes for other participants; teams can be registered (teams of 3), and registrations can be transferred free of charge through the registration system. The race information mentions aid stations/water stops, parking, race office, showers/changing facilities and course markings. All three courses start and finish at Falun Mine; results from previous years are available.

name: Ölands Marathon
description: Öland Marathon is a flat, easy-to-run marathon starting and finishing in the square in Löttorp. The course consists of a 2.1 km loop in Löttorp, followed by an 11.2 km loop run three times, for a total distance of 42,195 metres, entirely on asphalt. During the race, runners have views of Blå Jungfrun and pass three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water. All finishers receive a unique medal made of Öland limestone, and the women’s and men’s winners each win dinner for two at Kalk in Löttorp.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course
100% asphalt
Three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water
additional: Bib numbers can be collected from 12:00 on race day. Personal energy supplies must be handed in at least one hour before the start. Accommodation is available in four-bed cabins at Högby IP. Prizes are awarded to all age-group winners and the top overall finishers.

name: Svartåloppet
location: Svartå Folkets hus, Svartå, Degerfors Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Svartåloppet is a fun run held on the second Saturday in August, starting and finishing at Svartå Folkets hus. The race offers three distances: 2.5 km on flat roads, and 5.5 km and 14 km on hilly forest roads and trails. Timing is handled by Racetimer, providing a modern and reliable system. The race is open to all ages and has a long tradition in Svartå, dating back to the 20th century.
course_highlights: The 5.5 km and 14 km courses are hilly forest routes on forest roads and trails
The 2.5 km course is a flatter road route
Start and finish at Svartå Folkets hus
additional: Timing is handled by Racetimer using a modern and reliable timing system. Svartå IF is the organizer and has its own facilities, including a floodlit trail and club cabin at Hyttvallen. Results from several past years are available via Racetimer. The start and finish are at Svartå Folkets hus. Timing is handled by Racetimer.

name: Nätra Fjällskogslopp
location: Hinnsjöstugan, Nätra fjällskog, Örnsköldsvik Municipality, Sweden
description: Nätra Fjällskogslopp is a trail race organised by Nätra GIF youth since 2021. It has quickly become popular and sold out. The race offers four distances: 22 km, 15 km, 9 km and a 2 km children’s race, all through the beautiful and challenging terrain of Nätra Fjällskog. The courses follow trails and forest roads, cross bogs on boardwalks, and offer wonderful nature experiences with views of Hinnsjön and the coastal landscape. The start and finish are at Hinnsjöstugan, and the organisers ask participants to respect the nature reserves along the course.
course_highlights: Beautiful terrain with trails, forest roads and boardwalks across bogs
Climbs up Selshöjden and Västanåhöjden, with views of the coast and Ulvön
A downhill stretch with enchanting views over Hinnsjön
additional: Start times: 22 km at 9:30, 15 km at 9:45, 9 km at 10:00 and 2 km at 10:10. Bibs must be collected by 9:00. A clothes drop-off is available at Hinnsjöstugan. Recommended equipment includes a mobile phone, water/energy supplies and a map of the course. Parking is along the road past Hinnsjöstugan, a short walk from the start. Participants are asked to choose their starting position according to their ability, with those aiming to race at the front. The courses are marked with ribbons in different colours for each distance. Clear course markings and participant support.

name: Häv och Gräv Vikbovändan 2026
location: Vikbolandet, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: vuxen 490 kr (fram till den 30/6, sedan kostar loppet 540 kr)

description: Häv & Gräv Vikbovändan is a recreational race held on Vikbolandet in Östergötland during the summer. The main event is approximately 45 km long and features a scenic route with both gravel and asphalt sections. Along the way, participants can enjoy local delicacies at several aid stations. The event offers running, cycling and duo categories, as well as a children's race in the forest on illuminated trails. It is a welcoming, nature-oriented experience focused on community and local flavours.
course_highlights: Approximately 45 km, with a 50/50 mix of gravel and asphalt
Aid stations with locally produced delicacies and the opportunity to visit production facilities and a shop
Children's race in the forest on illuminated trails, with a medal and ice cream afterwards
additional: Start times: Children's race 10:30, Running + duo 11:30, Cycling 12:30. The children's race is free and does not require advance registration. Helmets are mandatory for cycling. All participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup to use at the aid stations to avoid disposable cups. On-site registration may be available if places remain, up until 30 minutes before the start. Participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup, which they should bring along during the race to reduce the use of disposable cups.

name: Kivijärviloppet
location: Kivijärvi, Övertorneå Municipality, Norrbotten County, Sweden
description: Kivijärviloppet is a traditional cross-country race organized by Kivijärvi IF since 1970. The race is held in the village of Kivijärvi in Tornedalen and offers several distances, with a 12 km main event open to both women and men, with no age categories. The race is known for its long history, beautiful courses and generous prize table, thanks to its sponsors. Many well-known athletes have taken part over the years, giving the race strong local and national standing.
course_highlights: Cross-country race with several distances: 0.5 km, 1.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 12 km
Course markers in different colors for each distance: yellow, white, blue and red
The race has used the same courses since it began in 1970, except during Covid
additional: Courses are marked with colors for different distances: 0.5 km and 1.5 km (yellow), 5 km (white), 7.5 km (blue), 12 km (red). The race offers a generous prize table for children, adults and recreational runners, thanks to generous sponsors. Kivijärvi is about 15 kilometers south of Korpilombolo along the Övertorneå road. Information on the official website applies to 2026 and does not confirm the date of August 7, 2027.

name: Storå 6 timmars och 3 timmars
description: Storå 6 Hours is a challenging ultrarace organised by Storådalens SK at Hagabacken School in Guldsmedshyttan. The race offers two distances, 6 hours and 3 hours, with participants running a 2,130-metre course featuring approximately 50 metres of elevation gain per lap. Sports drink and energy products are served at the lap point, and sausage rolls are available halfway through. All participants receive a T-shirt after finishing, and honorary prizes are awarded to the top three in each category. Results are published live on race day at hug-timing.se.
course_highlights: 2,130-metre laps with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain
After 20 laps, runners reach marathon distance with a total elevation gain of 1,000 metres
During the final 30 minutes, runners complete a shorter lap
additional: The start, lap point and race centre are at Hagabacken School, which has showers, toilets, services and medical care. Parking for the 6-hour race is on the gravel football pitch behind the school; for the 3-hour race, parking is at Guldsmedshyttebruk, 500 m away, or at the start. Timing is by ankle chip, which must be returned after the race. Umara sports drink and other products are served at the lap point. Sausage rolls are available halfway through the race. All runners receive a T-shirt after completing the race. Honorary prizes go to the top three in each category. The race has been cancelled due to too few participants. The planned start times were 11:00 for the 6-hour race and 14:00 for the 3-hour race. Timing was to be by chip.

name: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE
description:
Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is the trail-running adventure for anyone looking to combine the joy of running, a challenge and spectacular scenery. Choose between 42 km, 21 km or 10 km—and bring the whole family! Children up to 12 years old can run for free in Barnens Fjällmaraton.
The course takes you over rugged mountain trails, boardwalks and winding paths all the way to the finish and the lively After Run party at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. Fjällmaraton Sälen is a deluxe running experience. Secure your place and experience the mountains with us!

name: VI Ilgų nuotolių bėgiko Piotro Silkino jubiliejinis 85-mečio bėgimas
location: Kretingos Vasaros estrada, Maironio g. 15, Kretinga, Lithuania
description: The 85th-birthday run of long-distance runner Piotr Silkin is a traditional race held at Kretinga Summer Amphitheatre. The competition follows a lap format, with marathon participants completing one 2.2 km lap and twelve 3.3 km laps. The event celebrates longtime runner Piotr Silkin and attracts running enthusiasts from various places. Participants can enjoy both athletic competition and a welcoming community atmosphere.
course_highlights: The marathon course consists of 1 lap of 2.2 km and 12 laps of 3.3 km each
The competition takes place at Kretinga Summer Amphitheatre
The lap format lets spectators follow the race and support the participants
additional: Various distances and age groups will be offered at the event; results will be published, and registration is online.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 VI etapp 1000m
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage VI (1000 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is open to everyone interested in running. The series includes different distances and age groups, with participants earning points and winners determined by age group. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners. Registration is primarily available in advance, and on-site registration is possible until 18:30. The series winners will be awarded after the final race. To place among the prize winners, participants must take part in at least four stages.

name: Filter Temposari (5. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time-trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or roller skating. The stages take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring individual-start speed races. The races are short and intense, suitable for both recreational and advanced participants. The series also includes the Kullapada prize programme, which rewards consistent participation in every stage over the same distance.

name: 14. ETAPP / Järve terviserada
description: 14th STAGE / The Järve health trail is a 10-stage relay race around Lake Viljandi, held on varied terrain and a health trail with different surface types. Teams consist of 10 members, with an equal number of women and men, who take turns running the different stages. The start and finish are at Viljandi City Stadium, and runners are taken to the stages on buses provided by the organizers. The race is part of the tradition of the Suurjooks ümber Viljandi järve and offers a sporting experience for schools, companies, and sports clubs.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 5. etapp
location: Viljandi Lake Health and Ski Trail, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 5th stage of the Joosu Lake Run series is a running race organized by the Joosu sports club. It takes place on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy beautiful lake views and varied terrain. It is a great opportunity for both recreational and experienced runners to take part in a friendly and supportive environment.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lake views along the route
Varied terrain suitable for runners

name: BAMM
description: BAMM supported by OMM is a two-day ultramarathon in an Arctic mountain environment, where participants compete in pairs using mountain navigation across vast areas of unmarked terrain. The event offers several classes with different levels of difficulty and distances, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced adventurers. During the competition, participants experience spectacular mountain scenery and challenging navigation, with an overnight stay in the mountains. BAMM is a unique opportunity to combine physical challenge with a nature experience in one of Sweden’s most scenic environments.
course_highlights: Mountain navigation across unmarked terrain
Two-day competition with an overnight stay in the mountains
Arctic mountain environment with vast areas to navigate
additional: Participants compete in pairs (men’s, women’s or mixed teams). Transfers are available from Kiruna Airport to Hotell Riksgränsen and back, with times adapted to flight departures. Riksgränsen railway station is close to the hotel. Accommodation, equipment rental, food and practical information are available via the organiser’s website. The competition is held in teams of two. Mandatory equipment is part of the preparations; for BAMM 30, tents and sleeping bags are transported to the shared overnight camp. OMM is the main sponsor.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 27. Viru-Nigula Rahvajooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 offers a varied series of running and walking events, bringing together fitness enthusiasts and recreational athletes from spring to autumn. The 27th Viru-Nigula People’s Run takes place on the Viru-Nigula running track and in the long-jump pit. It is part of a long-running series that encourages participation across different age groups and distances. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and offer participants the chance to test their abilities. The events are well organized, with chip timing, ensuring participants an enjoyable and motivating running experience.

name: Tavelsjö Halvmarathon
location: Tavelsjö Church, Tavelsjö, Umeå Municipality, Sweden
description: Tavelsjö Half Marathon is a family-friendly running event offering races for both adults and children. The half marathon starts and finishes at Tavelsjö Church and is a popular goal for summer training. Children can take part in a Mini race, and there is also a timed youth race, making the event a celebration for the whole family. All participants receive a medal and a treat after crossing the finish line, and there are also prize drawings.
course_highlights: Half marathon starting and finishing at Tavelsjö Church
Timed 2.2 km youth race
Mini race for children, popular with the whole family
additional: The youth race starts at 10:00 and is open to young people aged 8–17. Parents are welcome to help children who need support during the youth race. All participants receive a medal and a treat after crossing the finish line. Gift cards are available to purchase as gifts and are delivered within one week of ordering.

name: Midnattsloppet Stockholm
description: Midnattsloppet Stockholm is a classic night race held on 14 August 2027, with an evening start. The race offers 10 km and 5 km distances, taking participants through the lively streets of Södermalm in a festive atmosphere filled with music, cheers and camaraderie. In addition to the main races, there is also a costume category and children’s races, making the event a festival for all ages. Midnattsloppet is known for its uniquely late start time and the special atmosphere created among runners, spectators and race staff.
course_highlights: The original course around Södermalm in Stockholm
An evening start with a unique night-race atmosphere
A festive atmosphere with music and cheers from spectators along the course
additional: Start times vary by race: the Mini Race (300 m) starts between 11:45 and 15:30, the 2 km children’s races start at 18:30 and 18:50, the 10 km starts at 21:10, the 5 km starts at 21:40, and the costume category starts at 22:00. Corporate races and team competitions are offered to strengthen camaraderie and workplace health. Midnattsloppet is organised by Midnattsloppet Nordic AB, a wholly owned company of Hammarby IF Friidrott, and the surplus goes back to the sports clubs.

name: 6 sjöar
description: 6 Lakes is a race through the beautiful forests just outside Uppsala. You’ll run mainly on small forest roads, with shorter sections of trail. All distances loop around at least one lake, while the full marathon takes you around 6 lakes. With the environment in mind, we provide free bus transport for runners from Uppsala Central Station to the start in Fjällnora, and back after the race. The race is also free of disposable cups; instead, every runner receives a reusable cup.
