name: ÅRC x Copperhill loop!
description:
Welcome to our exciting Åre Run Club x Copperhill loop!

On August 14, runners of all levels will gather to conquer the Copperhill hill. You can choose your own distance—5, 10, 15 or 20 km—and decide for yourself how many laps you want to do before crossing the finish line! We believe everyone should be able to take part and enjoy this amazing experience together. Join us for an unforgettable running celebration, whether you’re a beginner or an experienced runner. Let’s create magical running memories together!

name: Trysilmila
description: Trysilmila is a trail race held in Østby in Trysil, suitable for both children and adults. The race offers varied terrain and beautiful scenery, and largely follows the Trysil Skimaraton course. It is a social and inclusive race day focused on the joy of running and a great atmosphere, with separate children’s races over suitable distances. All participants receive a finisher’s medal, and prizes are awarded in both the children’s race and the main races.
course_highlights: Varied surfaces, including gravel (approx. 3.5 km), trail and forest road (approx. 6.5 km), and some asphalt (approx. 200 m) on the 10 km course
Water stations at 3.8 and 7 km on the long course (10 km), and at 3.5 km on the short course (6.5 km)
The course largely follows the Trysil Skimaraton course near Østby
additional: Children’s race start times: 12:00 (ages 0–6, 500 m), 12:05 (ages 7–10, 800 m), 12:10 (ages 11–15, 1.8 km). The short 6.5 km course starts at 12:45 with timing; the long 10 km course starts at 13:00 with timing. The race office, parking and changing rooms are at Østby Samfunnshus near the stadium area. Bib collection and prize-giving take place at the race office on race day. Trysilmila is part of Trysildobbelen together with Trysil Skimaraton, with prizes for combined results.

name: Nordkjosmila 2027
description: Nordkjosmila is a race in Nordkjosbotn, Balsfjord. In 2026, it featured a children’s race and races over 3.33 km and 10 km; the 10 km course was measured and certified, with individual timing. The race aims to become one of the region’s best road races. Information about the 2027 edition has not yet been confirmed.
course_highlights: The 10 km course was measured and certified in 2026
A 3.33 km race and a children’s race were offered in 2026
Held in Nordkjosbotn, Balsfjord
additional: Distances and practical details are documented for 2026 and have not been confirmed for 2027.

name: 15. ETAPP / Vabaõhumuuseum
description: The Health Run and Walk is a multi-stage running and walking event held in various parts of Tallinn, including the Estonian Open Air Museum. Each stage offers a chance to enjoy beautiful nature trails and the benefits of recreational sport. The Estonian Open Air Museum stage is 4.2 km long and is well suited to both runners and walkers who want to spend active time outdoors. The event is a tradition and is open to everyone interested in recreational sport.

name: Convinistafetten
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Convinistafetten is Sweden’s largest relay race, held annually in Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm. Each team consists of five participants, each running 5 kilometres, and there is also a walking category where the team walks together. The event is a fun, energetic evening that promotes team building and company camaraderie. After the race, all teams are treated to a picnic with food, drinks, fruit and coffee on the grass. Convinistafetten has a long tradition dating back to 1986 and attracts over 3,000 teams every year.
course_highlights: Each team runs five legs of 5 km each
Start and finish by the transition zone in Stora Skuggan
A picnic with food and drinks is included after the race
additional: Relay teams start in three different waves, with the first start at approximately 17:30. The walking category starts at approximately 17:40. The team captain receives all the race bibs by mail. The final runner collects the picnic box from the picnic tent. It is possible to book extra picnic boxes and private tent packages to enhance the experience. Title sponsor Convini treats teams to a picnic after they finish.

name: 10. Üts Ummamuudu liina üüjuusk-kõnd
description: The 10th Üts Ummamuudu City Night Run-Walk is a physical activity event in Võru, featuring running, Nordic walking, and walking. The event is part of the activities of the Physical Activity Competence Centre, which aims to promote an active lifestyle and health. Everyone is welcome to take part, improve their wellbeing, and enjoy being active at every stage of life. The beautiful nature of Võru County provides a pleasant setting for physical activity.

name: Liikumissari 8.Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VII etapp /Käru järve jooks
location: Käru, Türi Parish, Järva County, Estonia

name: Askes Fjällmaraton
location: Torget, Idre Fjäll, Idre, Älvdalen Municipality, Dalarna County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 50 kr som oavkortat går till Viggo Foundation

description: Askes Fjällmaraton is a child-friendly 1 km mountain race held on Friday evening at Idre Fjäll. The course is well marked and suitable for all children born in 2015 or later. There is no timekeeping, but all participants receive a medal and a treat at the finish. Registration is easy online or on site using Swish, and the entire entry fee goes directly to the Viggo Foundation, which supports neuro-adaptive sports for children and young people.
course_highlights: 1 km course with clear markings
Start and finish at Torget, Idre Fjäll
Child-friendly race with no timekeeping
additional: Registration is available online until 15 minutes before the start or on site at bib collection using Swish. All proceeds go to the Viggo Foundation. After the race, every child receives a medal and a treat. The Fjällmaratonklubben for children aged 4–12 also offers fun activities on Saturday. Intended for children; sources give different age limits. Registration is available online until 15 minutes before the start or on site at bib collection. Proceeds go directly to the Viggo Foundation.

name: Lüganuse rahvajooks
description: Lüganuse Public Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place in Kiviõli Central Square. The event offers several distances, from a children’s race to a 9 km run, suitable for different age groups and skill levels. Participants can enjoy a friendly, community-focused atmosphere and compete in the team category. Registration is easy and the entry fee is affordable, making this a great event for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Ultravasan
description: Ultravasan 90 is a trail race starting in Berga by, Sälen, offering runners the classic Vasaloppet route through scenic summer landscapes. The race starts at dawn at 05:00 and follows the historic checkpoints to the finish in Mora, with views of pine forests, waterways, trails and traditional mountain farm settings. The race is 92 km long, has Swedish Championship status in 2026 and is part of Vasaloppstrippeln; the maximum number of participants is 2,500, and the minimum age is 17.
course_highlights: Dawn start at 05:00 in Berga by—watch the sun rise over the marshes around Smågan
Seven Vasaloppet checkpoints along the course, with drinks, energy, toilets and medical care
Scenic stretches through open pine forests, winding waterways, well-trodden trails and picturesque traditional mountain farm settings
additional: Race bibs and chips can be collected in Mora or Sälen in the days before the race, or at the start venue. Start pens open at 04:30, and your time starts when you cross the start line. Baggage transport to Mora is available, and you can send a change-of-clothes bag to Evertsberg. There are refreshment stations approximately every five kilometres, as well as toilets and medical care at all checkpoints. Maximum 2,500 participants; training grants of SEK 60,000 are awarded to the winner in each of the women’s and men’s categories. Ultravasan consists of two longer ultramarathon distances: Ultravasan 90 (Sälen–Mora, approximately 92 km) and Ultravasan 45 (Oxberg–Mora, approximately 45 km). Both finish in Mora and are part of Vasaloppet’s Summer Week.

name: Vasastafetten
description: Vasastafetten is a cross-country relay race held as a festival, where hundreds of teams made up of clubs, companies, families and groups of friends share the classic route from Sälen to Mora. It is the oldest event of the summer and offers a challenging course covering a total of 92 kilometres, divided into ten legs ranging from 4.5 to 15 kilometres. The race starts in Berga by in Sälen and welcomes both elite runners and recreational runners aged 8 and over. The entry fee includes bus transport for participants on the first two legs, and the organiser sends the team captain the race pack with bib numbers and information well in advance of the race.
course_highlights: Cross-country race between Sälen and Mora
Ten legs ranging from 4.5 to 15 km
Start in Berga by, Sälen, and finish in Mora
additional: The race pack with bib numbers and an information letter is sent to the team captain approximately two weeks before the race. The timing chip must be collected on race day at the Vasaloppet start in Sälen between 06:30 and 08:00. A bus ticket to the start for leg 1 must be booked, and runners on leg 2 must take the organiser's bus to Smågan. For legs 2 to 10, teams are responsible for their own transport to and from the changeover points.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://vasaloppet.se/lopning/vasastafetten-lopning/): 2027-08-21 — "Vasastafetten 2027 Datum 21 augusti" (was estimated 2027-08-14)

name: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100
description: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100 is an ultrarunning event in the scenic surroundings of Lill-Jansskogen in Stockholm, offering distances of 30, 50 and 100 miles. The race combines physical endurance with community in an intimate setting with a maximum of 100 participants. The course is an 11.8-kilometre loop with aid stations serving food and drink at set times. Runners finish both day and night, with generous time limits for each distance. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggans väg 22, with good transport links and nearby facilities.
course_highlights: 11.8-kilometre loop course in Lill-Jansskogen
Scenic surroundings with magical forest sections
Aid station with food and drink from Umara served at set times
additional: Maximum 100 participants. Time limits are 32 hours for 100 miles, 16 hours for 50 miles and 9 hours for 30 miles. The 30-mile finish cutoff is 23:00 on Saturday, the 50-mile cutoff is 06:00, and the 100-mile cutoff is 17:00 on Sunday. The start and finish area has parking, toilets, a tent, a restaurant, a 4-H farm and a café. Drinks are provided by Umara. Volunteer opportunities are available. The information states that parking is available at the venue and that it is close to the metro and buses.

name: Fjällvindenterrängen
description: Fjällvindenterrängen is a classic 10-kilometre mountain trail race from Laisaliden to Hemavan. The race takes you through beautiful mountain terrain along Drottningleden and finishes with a run through the ski area, crossing the finish line at the base station of Centrumliften. The race starts at 12:30 with a group warm-up and is limited to 200 participants to ensure a good experience. After the finish, energy, drinks and fruit are provided, and food and fika can be purchased at Anders Bistro. A family evening to get ready for the race is held the night before at Arena Hemavan.
course_highlights: 10 km of mountain terrain along Drottningleden
Crossing Mortsbäcken, followed by a steep, technical downhill section
The final stretch runs through the ski area, descending to the finish
additional: A bus to the start is included, departing at 11:30 from the Centrumhuset car park in Hemavan. There is a water station after approximately 5–6 km. Timing chips are handed out at the start and must be returned after the finish. The prize ceremony takes place at approximately 13:30 in the finish area. Warm-up clothes can be left at the start to be transported to the finish. Toilets are available in Centrumhuset, but there are no showers. There is an outdoor toilet at the start. Start at 12:30 with a group warm-up. Limited to 200 participants; the entry fee includes bus transport to the start and energy at the finish.

name: Tough Viking
description: Tough Viking Kungl. Djurgården is a spectacular obstacle course race that takes you through Stockholm’s beautiful and historic surroundings. The course offers a varied mix of fast running sections, technical obstacles, strength challenges, and water elements. The race is spectator-friendly and suits both beginners and experienced OCR runners looking to combine speed, nature, and an authentic race atmosphere. The start and finish are located on Djurgårdsbrunnsvägen near the Maritime Museum, with a well-organized event area and services.
course_highlights: The course winds through the lush parks and historic landmarks of Royal Djurgården
Varied terrain with fast running sections and technical obstacles
Includes strength challenges and water elements
additional: Start times are selected during registration and sent by SMS before race day. Race bibs and timing chips are collected at the black Tough Viking tents by the Maritime Museum. The chip must be worn around the right ankle. A group warm-up is held 10 minutes before each start. Shoes with metal spikes are prohibited and will result in disqualification. Participants can compete individually or in teams (at least four people per team). Bag storage is available on site. The Open class has a minimum age of 12; participants under 18 need a guardian’s signature. There are four hydration stations along the course. Missing obstacles results in five penalty laps. Parking is limited, and public transport is recommended; changing tents are available, but there are no showers.

name: Rinkebyloppet 2026
location: Ursvikssidan av gångbron, Rinkeby, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Rinkebyloppet is an annual running race that starts on the Ursvik side of the pedestrian bridge in Rinkeby, crosses the bridge and follows Rinkeby Allé to the finish at Rinkeby Square. The race is a welcome tradition that also marks the start of the popular Rinkeby Festival. This year, there is also a class for participants with disabilities who use wheelchairs, following the same course and reaching the same finish as the other runners. Rinkebyloppet welcomes all runners and is part of the active and inclusive Rinkeby Run collaboration.
course_highlights: Start on the Ursvik side of the pedestrian bridge
Run across the bridge and along Rinkeby Allé
Finish at Rinkeby Square, marking the start of the Rinkeby Festival
additional: A new wheelchair class for participants with disabilities follows the same course and has the same finish as the runners. A wheelchair class is offered on the same course, with the same finish as the runners.

name: TMC (Tromsø Mountain Challenge) HalvUltra 25km
description: Tromsø Mountain Challenge is a weekend featuring four trail races in Tromsø’s unique mountain landscape, spread over two days. The HalvUltra 25 km starts at TUIL Arena and follows a demanding course through Tromsdalen, up Djupdalen to Bønntøva (760 m above sea level), and down Fjøyfjellet to Fjellstua before finishing at TUIL Arena. The race combines spectacular scenery with challenging terrain and attracts both new and experienced runners seeking a true Arctic running challenge.
course_highlights: Start at TUIL Arena and run through Tromsdalen
Climb to Bønntøva at 760 m above sea level, the race’s highest point
Spectacular descent via Fjøyfjellet and finish at TUIL Arena
additional: Bib pickup takes place at TUIL Arena in Tromsdalen. The HalvUltra 25 km has a time limit of 6 hours. Transport to the Ultra 50 km start is available by bus from TUIL Arena at 07:45. Bag storage is available at TUIL Arena. A self-declaration form must be completed before the start for the Ultra and HalvUltra. The time limit is 6 hours. Bib pickup takes place at TUIL Arena, and HalvUltra participants must complete a self-declaration form before the start. Places are limited.

name: Tromsø Mountain Ultra 50km
description: Tromsø Mountain Challenge is a weekend featuring four trail races in Tromsø’s unique mountain landscape, including the 50 km La Sportiva Ultra, which starts from Snarbyeidet. The races offer challenging trails, spectacular mountain and plateau views, and finish with a wonderful descent through Tromsdalen to the finish at TUIL Arena. The event attracts runners from all over the world and offers a true Arctic running experience in the fresh autumn air and beautiful fall colors. This is a race for both new and experienced trail runners looking for a challenging and scenic experience.
course_highlights: Start from Snarbyeidet on runnable mountain terrain, climbing to approximately 760 m above sea level
Pass nine checkpoints along the way during the ultra race
Spectacular descent through Tromsdalen to the finish at TUIL Arena
additional: Bib pickup takes place at TUIL Arena in Tromsdalen. The cutoff time for the 50 km ultra is 9 hours, with a checkpoint at Tromsdalselva (32 km) where the cutoff is 5.5 hours. Transport to the start from TUIL Arena is by bus at 07:45. Bags can be stored at TUIL Arena and transported by bus to the finish area. A self-declaration form must be completed before the start for the Ultra and HalvUltra. The maximum time is 9 hours. The cutoff at the Tromsdalselva checkpoint, after 32 km, is 5.5 hours. The organizer provides a bus from TUIL Arena to the start at 07:45, and Ultra runners must complete a self-declaration form. The number of start places is limited.

name: Dalheim Rundt
description: Dalheim Rundt is a family-friendly trail race that starts and finishes at TUIL Arena in Tromsø. The course follows the network of trails and the floodlit ski trail through beautiful Tromsdalen, with a water station at Dalheim. This race is part of Tromsø Mountain Challenge, which offers spectacular nature experiences in rugged Northern Norwegian terrain, with challenging trails and great views. The event takes place in late August, when Northern Norway displays its finest autumn colours.
course_highlights: Start and finish at TUIL Arena in Tromsdalen
The course follows the network of trails and the floodlit ski trail through Tromsdalen to Dalheim
Water station at Dalheim amid scenic surroundings
additional: Race bibs are distributed at TUIL Arena in Tromsdalen. The number of starting places is limited, and registration is open while race bibs are available. The race is part of a weekend featuring several trail races in Tromsø, and several of the races finish with a spectacular descent through Tromsdalen to the finish at TUIL Arena. The race is part of Tromsø Mountain Challenge and the TMC Triple. The start time is listed as 12:00 on Saturday, 21 August 2027.

name: Sami Maraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: kr 100,- Deltakere 7-13 år får kr 50,- i rabatt.

description: Sámi Marathon is mainland Norway’s northernmost marathon and is held in the centre of Tanabru in Deatnu-Tana. The race offers compact, sociable courses with several passes by the stadium, creating a great atmosphere and bringing runners close to the spectators. Distances include the marathon, half marathon, 10 km, Run4Fun and MiniMarathon, with dedicated categories for para-athletes and children. All participants receive a medal at the finish, and prizes are awarded in several categories, with additional prizes for the fastest times over each distance. The race has a strong focus on community and the joy of running in the centre of Tana.
course_highlights: The marathon consists of 4 laps and the half marathon of 2 laps on officially measured courses
The courses are compact and close to the town centre, with several passes by the stadium
Suitable for all ages, with dedicated courses for children and para-athletes
additional: Race numbers and Emit timing chips can be collected at the stadium the day before the race between 18:00 and 19:30, or from 08:30 on race day. Please arrive at least 30 minutes before the start, or 1 hour beforehand if you have not collected your race number and chip. All participants receive medals. Family discount with a maximum combined entry fee of NOK 1,500 per family. Additional prizes for the three fastest times in the 10 km, half marathon and marathon. An earlier marathon start is available for participants expecting a running time of over 5 hours. The information page lists medals for all participants and changing facilities at Tana multi-purpose hall. Distance and price information applies to the published 2027 registration; the date 21 August 2027 has not been confirmed on the source pages.

name: Kveøy halvmaraton 2027
description: Kveøy Half Marathon is held in scenic surroundings on Kveøya, with the start at Kveøy. The event offers distances including a half marathon, 10 km and a children’s race, and is suitable for both experienced runners and families. The event has a tradition of bringing together local running enthusiasts and offers a wonderful opportunity to experience the island’s beautiful nature while running.
course_highlights: Start at Kveøy in scenic surroundings
Half marathon and 10 km distances available
Children’s race for the youngest participants
additional: A children’s race and 10 km distance are offered in addition to the half marathon. The event has previously started at Kveøy and includes registration options via the website. Contact person: Line Hunstad. In 2026, there was a café at Kveøy Grendehus.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: Östersunds SK och Blodcentralerna i Jämtland/Härjedalen

description: Blodomloppet in Östersund is a fun run that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either on your own or with colleagues and friends. The races start and finish in Badhusparken and offer a well-organised, inclusive atmosphere for all participants. After the race, participants often get together for a shared picnic, strengthening the sense of community. Blodomloppet is a recreational activity with an important purpose and a long tradition in Sweden.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses are marked with red ribbons and signs
A lead cyclist shows the way, and course marshals are stationed along the route
Start and finish in Badhusparken
additional: Late registration is possible on race day via the website or in person at the information tent, with payment by Swish. The courses have been officially measured and approved by certified course measurers. The start and finish are in Badhusparken. Marshals and traffic guards are stationed along the course, and a lead cyclist shows the way. Participation is at your own risk, as no accident insurance is provided. By participating, you consent to the publication of photos from the event. The final date for team registration is 20 August; after that, picnic bags are available while supplies last. The start and finish for all races are in Badhusparken. The courses are marked and staffed by marshals and traffic guards. Registration information and fees for 2027 may be updated.

name: Blodomloppet (Sundsvall)
organizer: Sundsvalls Orienteringsklubb och Blodcentralerna i Västernorrland
description: Blodomloppet in Sundsvall is a recreational race that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event takes place at Ungdomsfältet in Södra hamnen, near the marina, and offers both individual and team starts. The courses are certified by the Swedish Athletics Federation and run counterclockwise along Selångersån, with scenic bridge crossings. Blodomloppet is a social, healthy activity that concludes with a group picnic for team participants.
course_highlights: Two certified adult courses: 5 km and 10 km
The courses run counterclockwise along Selångersån, crossing Sporthallsbron (5 km) and Montörsvägsbro (10 km)
Start and finish at Ungdomsfältet in Södra hamnen, near the marina
additional: Teams consist of 3–5 participants, with the option to add team members up to and including 18 August. A picnic bag for 5 people is included with team registration. Participants in the walking category may use poles or a stroller and bring a well-behaved dog on a short leash. Late registration for individual participants is available on race day from 15:30, at an increased fee, with payment by Swish. The courses are officially measured and certified by the Swedish Athletics Federation. Registration for 2027 has not yet opened. The race highlights blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

price_range: 350–450 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100–150 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet

description: Blodomloppet in Västerås is a recreational race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race is open to both individual participants and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, who can take part in different distances. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 1–12, with two shorter distances. The start and finish are at the Rocklunda area, with clearly marked courses and several marshals along the way. After the race, all participants receive a medal and a finish-line goody bag, and team participants are invited to a group picnic.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Rocklunda area, on the football pitches north of the riding arena
The courses are marked with Blodomloppet course tape, with flag marshals at strategic locations
Lilla Blodomloppet for children features two distances of approximately 1,400 m and 500 m around Rocklunda IP
additional: The race offers a warm-up in front of the stage at approximately 17:00. Lilla Blodomloppet has two start times: approximately 17:15 for 1,400 m and approximately 17:25 for 500 m. Teams can consist of 3–5 participants and include a picnic for 5 people. Race bibs and T-shirts are handed out, and there are water stations along the course. Registration is binding and cancellations are not accepted. Teams consist of 3–5 participants. The team fee covers five people and includes a picnic.

name: Norrköpings Stadslopp (Nkpg City)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis anmälan för alla barn och ungdomar.

description: NKPG City Norrköping City Race is a fast-paced and popular running event held in central Norrköping, starting and finishing on Olai Kyrkogata. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km, with a course that passes through classic surroundings, lined with cheering spectators and featuring more than ten music stations to create a wonderful atmosphere. The race welcomes both elite runners and recreational runners in a festive atmosphere, with great prizes and a large crowd. Children can also take part in the free 1 km children’s race, Lilla Lundbergsloppet, with a medal and goodie bag for every participant.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata in central Norrköping
The course passes through classic Norrköping surroundings, lined with cheering spectators
More than ten music stations along the course to keep runners motivated
additional: Lilla Lundbergsloppet starts at 17:00 in four waves and is free for children. The children’s warm-up is led by Friskis & Svettis at 16:40. The 10 km race starts at 18:30 and the 5 km race starts at 19:30, with warm-ups 15 minutes before each start. Race numbers can be collected at XXL Ingelsta on Wednesday 26 August from 11:00 to 18:00, or on race day from 15:00 at the start and finish area. There are veteran, junior and youth categories, as well as team competitions for women, men and mixed teams. Water stations are located at 2 km and 7 km (Nodra), and at 3.5 km and 8.5 km (ICA Strömmen). After finishing, participants are offered water drilled by Finspångs Brunnsborrning. Timing is by chip, and results are published directly after the finish. ARQLY-Spurten is a race within the race on the final 85 metres, with sprint prizes. 5 km and 10 km. Lilla Lundbergsloppet is free for children.

name: Höga Kusten Trail
description: Höga Kusten Trail is one of Sweden’s most popular adventure races, offering a weekend filled with spectacular nature, community and celebration in the High Coast World Heritage Site. The event features five unique distances over two days, with each course taking you across some of the High Coast’s most iconic and dramatic peaks. Combining running, jogging and fast hiking, the event is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Alongside the races, there are cosy pre-event evenings, after-trail parties and a mini expo featuring equipment from leading outdoor brands. Höga Kusten Trail is more than just a race—it’s a complete experience in one of Sweden’s most beautiful settings.
course_highlights: Five unique distances over two days, ranging from 14 km to 60 km
Courses pass through the High Coast World Heritage Site and offer spectacular views and nature experiences
Aid stations and course marshals along the route, plus race briefings and an equipment expo before the races
additional: The races take place over two days, with five distances. On Friday, Three Peaks 18k and Coast to Summits 28k start; on Saturday, Twin Peaks 14k, The Original 45k and The Ultimate 60k start. There is a race briefing before each distance and after-trail parties in the evenings. Buses run from FriluftsByn to the start locations. There is also a mini expo featuring equipment from Icebug and Haglöfs. You can sell your entry through the participant group on Facebook, and optional insurance can be purchased through Startklar. Registration for 2027 opens Friday, 5 March at 15:00. Distance and programme details for 2027 may change; published prices apply to 2026.

name: Arctic Alta Ultra 2027
description: Arctic Alta Ultra is a challenging ultrarun held in Tverrelvdalen, starting and finishing at Ungdomshuset. The race offers several distances from 6 km to 100 miles, with well-marked courses and aid stations along the way. Participants can use bag-drop points on the longer distances, and the finish area has facilities including a café, changing rooms and showers. The event combines nature experiences with challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of Alta.
course_highlights: Aid stations on all distances, with several unmanned stations on the 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile distances
Bag-drop points for the 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile distances
Start and finish at Ungdomshuset in Tverrelvdalen, with facilities including a café and showers
additional: Participants in the 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile races must sign a runner's declaration before the start. Race manuals are available for the 16 km, 29 km, 50 km, 100 km and 100-mile distances. The start and finish address is Sønvismoen 44, 9537 Tverrelvdalen. For the 2026 edition, a café, changing rooms with showers and an awards ceremony at Ungdomshuset in Tverrelvdalen are listed. These practical details have not been confirmed for 2027.

distance_verbose: 50 km, 36 km, 26 km, 18 km, 10 km, 7 km, 1 km

name: 22. Ülemiste metsajooks
description: The 22nd Ülemiste Forest Run is an environmentally friendly 3 km trail run held around the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant. The race centre, start and finish are located at Järvevana tee 3. The run takes place on Saturday, 29 August 2026, starting at 11:50. Participants are provided with a marked route, sports drink and water at the finish, and medical assistance along the entire course. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and offers an enjoyable, active experience.

name: Sillamäe ultra 2026: Eesti meistrivõistlused 100 km jooksus
description: Sillamäe Ultra 2026 is the Estonian 100 km running championship, taking place on the Sillamäe health trail and at outdoor gyms on August 29, 2026. It is a traditional ultrarun in which participants cover a road-running distance while competing for the Estonian championship title. The race offers a challenge for both local and international ultrarunners who appreciate the course’s variety and the event’s organization. Sillamäe Ultra is known for its organization and strong participant community.

name: Tallinna Vee 54. jooks ümber Ülemiste järve
description: The 54th Tallinna Vesi Run Around Lake Ülemiste is a traditional running race taking place on 29 August 2026. The Run Around Lake Ülemiste is part of the Maru Lake Runs series, and this year’s race is the series’ final, fourth event. The marked course is 13.7 km long and starts and finishes at the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant at Järvevana tee 3. The event centre opens early in the morning, and race materials are distributed on site. Participants are provided with chip timing; the chip is attached to the back of the race bib.

name: Stockholm Trail
description: Stockholm Trail is a trail race organised by OK Södertörn, offering a unique running experience in the beautiful Nackareservatet, just outside Stockholm City. The races follow winding forest trails and cross sunlit rock slabs, with courses suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Hammarbyhöjdens IP, and the event has a welcoming atmosphere, with encouraging marshals and personal service. All proceeds from the race go directly to OK Södertörn’s activities.
course_highlights: The course runs entirely through nature, along technical forest trails and over beautiful rock slabs
Fantastic views and unique natural areas in Nackareservatet
Clearly marked courses with encouraging marshals along the way
additional: There are six different courses: 21K, 10K, 5K, 5K fun run (untimed), 2.5K kids, and Mini Trail for the very youngest participants. All participants receive a race bib with their name and a unique medal after completing the race. Showers and changing facilities are available at the venue. The course requires shoes with good grip and careful attention to roots and rocks. The 21K has a generous time limit to suit all runners.

name: Stockholm Halvmarathon
description: Stockholm Half Marathon is a popular half-marathon that runs through central Stockholm, starting and finishing at Strömbron, near the Royal Palace and the Parliament House. The course is 21,098 metres long and offers a fast, scenic route through the districts of Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm. The race is an annual tradition that attracts runners from across the country and offers a unique opportunity to run through Stockholm’s historic and beautiful urban surroundings. The race starts at 15:30, and after the finish there is an after-run event in Kungsträdgården.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the Royal Palace and Strömbron
Fast course through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm
Clearly marked kilometres and police/officials at every intersection
additional: The expo and race-number pickup take place in Kungsträdgården in the days before the race. Race numbers are printed on site at the expo. The metro is the easiest way to get to the event area. After the race, there is an after-run event in Kungsträdgården. Race confirmation is sent by email from mid-August. The first start is provisionally at 15:30. Participants may start from the year they turn 17.

name: Rynningeviken Längre 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 16 augusti - 21 augusti (10.00/13.00) 695 SEK. Begränsat antal platser.

description: Rynningeviken Längre is a running race in Örebro that challenges participants to run as far as they can in three or six hours in the scenic Rynningeviken Nature Reserve. The course is a beautiful loop of approximately 2.4 km, mostly on gravel paths with a few bridges, close to the city centre. The event is a celebration of running, focusing on endurance and community, where participants can take on a unique challenge and aim for personal distance records. There is also a KidsRun for the youngest runners. The event is open to all ages and offers a wonderful day filled with the joy of running.
course_highlights: A 2,412.5-metre loop, mostly on gravel paths
Two bridges, with little elevation gain
Start/finish on cobblestones, with a shorter loop for the final 15–30 minutes
additional: Start times: 6-hour race starts at 11:00, 3-hour race starts at 14:00, KidsRun starts at 11:30. A mandatory race briefing takes place before each start. Timing is recorded using a transponder, which is loaned to participants and must be returned after the race. There is no timing for the KidsRun. At the finish, the distance is measured precisely using a measuring wheel. Water and energy supplies are available along the course, including sports drink, bars, fruit, coffee and more. Changing facilities and showers are not provided, but swimming is possible in the Svartån River. Toilets are available near the start area and after approximately 1 km on the loop. Participation is at your own risk. Group registration and discounts for young people and members of certain running clubs are available. The timed races are 3 and 6 hours long. The KidsRun is for children born in 2015 or later and covers either one full lap or a shorter 700-metre distance.

name: Kraftloppet Skellefteå Löpning 2026
description: Kraftloppet in Skellefteå is a festival for both competitive recreational athletes and casual runners looking to challenge themselves in three different events: skiing, cycling and running. The running event offers distances of 21 km and 12 km, as well as children’s races of 2.7 km and 500 m. Kraftloppet focuses on health and community, and offers the opportunity to complete a Kraftklassiker by taking part in all three events during the same calendar year.
course_highlights: Running distances of 21 km and 12 km, plus children’s races of 2.7 km and 500 m
Recreational races with both shorter and longer distances for different ages and ability levels
Part of the Kraftklassiker, which includes skiing, cycling and running in the same year
additional: The Kraftklassiker rewards participants who complete Kraftloppet skiing, Kraftloppet cycling and Kraftloppet running during the same calendar year. Registration is available via links on the registration page. Contact Bergsbyns SK by phone at +46 (0)910-861 61 or by email at info@kraftloppet.com. The organizer’s published information lists the running event on 29 August 2026; it does not confirm the date of 28 August 2027.

name: Dundret Extreme Running
description: Dundret Extreme Running is a trail race held in Gällivare, starting and finishing at Hellnerstadion. The event offers three distances: 22 km, 10 km and 2 km, all featuring varied terrain and elevation changes that challenge runners of different levels. K22 is a demanding test with 800 metres of elevation gain and beautiful views of Sarek and Kebnekaise, while K10 and K2 offer shorter but still challenging courses. The race is well organised, with safety measures, aid stations, prizes for the fastest runners and a prize draw open to all participants.
course_highlights: K22: 22 km with 800 metres of elevation gain, a mix of trails and paved roads, highest point at 823 metres above sea level
K10: 9.6 km with 240 metres of elevation gain, a mix of gravel and trails, turnaround point at Femmanvägen
K2: 2.1 km trail loop around Hellnerstadion with 60 metres of elevation gain, a fast and manageable distance
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Hellnerstadion from 08:00 to 09:30. All participants must cross the finish line or notify a race official if they withdraw. Aid stations along K22 and K10 offer water and Umara sports drink. Changing rooms and showers are available at Hellnerstadion. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at 13:00 for K10 and K22, including a mountain prize for K22. All K2 finishers receive a medal. Live results and split times will be published via a link on race day. The registration page states that registration is through MittLopp.se and that registration on race day is not possible. Current prices and distances for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

description: The Northern Lithuania Half Marathon 2026 will take place in Pakruojis District, in the northern part of Lithuania. The event aims to promote running culture and encourage residents to be active, offering scenic routes in popular tourist areas. The race will start and finish in Pakruojis City Park, where participants can enjoy not only the sport but also discover the nature and culture of northern Lithuania. The event brings together people of different ages and social groups to spend time actively and healthily.
course_highlights: Scenic routes in popular tourist areas
Start and finish in Pakruojis City Park
Discover northern Lithuania while running
additional: Bib collection is open from 8:00 to 10:00. The half marathon starts at 11:00, and the other distances start at 10:00. Registration will not be available on race day. Participants agree that photographs and video footage taken during the event may be used for marketing purposes. The event includes different distances and categories, and online registration is open until the end of August. The event date is September 4, 2027.

name: Bodø Run Festival 2027
description: Bodø Run Festival is an urban, compact running festival in the heart of Bodø city centre, offering a wide range of races for all ages and levels, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and relay. The festival combines running with food, entertainment, talks and a party, giving participants a weekend filled with authentic Arctic experiences. The courses are officially measured and offer both city life and spectacular nature, with the chance to set new records on a flat, accessible course. The festival also features mountain races, including Bodøryggen with an ultradistance and a hilly half marathon around Soløyvannet.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses in Bodø city centre, close to the airport, train and boat
Bodøryggen mountain race with views of the Lofoten Wall, Børvasstindan and Bodø city
Hilly half marathon around Soløyvannet, starting and finishing at the athletics track at Mørkved
additional: Bodøryggen mountain race is limited to 400 participants and includes a medal, food at the finish, spa access at Wood Hotel and transport to the start for the 22 km distance. Race bibs can be collected at Sport 1 Stormyra and at the start. A long-sleeved windproof jacket is mandatory for the mountain race. Soløyvannet Rundt has a drinks station and prize-giving with draw prizes. The festival also offers a Pasta Party when registering, and there are regular running groups and morning runs in Bodø throughout the year.

name: 9. Kristiine Rahvajooks
description: The 9th Kristiine Community Run takes place on August 30, 2026, at the playground in Löwenruh Park in Tallinn. This family-friendly event features a 5 km main race as well as children’s races for participants up to 10 years old. The event centre, start and finish are located next to Löwenruh Park, providing a pleasant and safe setting for running enthusiasts. The event aims to promote running as an accessible form of exercise and offer a sporting experience for people of different age groups.

name: Vikingatrailen
location: Årsunda IP, Årsunda, Sandviken Municipality, Sweden
description: Vikingatrailen is a trail race organized by Årsunda IF, starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård). The race offers several courses of varying lengths and terrain, including a 1 km mini race. The event has been well received, with many participants praising the organization. Participants can access maps, GPX files, and elevation profiles for the courses in advance. Vikingatrailen is a family-friendly running experience close to nature in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail race starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård)
Several courses of 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
Courses available as GPX files with elevation profiles
additional: The mini race starts 1 km from the finish, with bus transport to the start. Results and photos are published after the race. The courses are listed as public routes in Garmin Connect. Maps and GPX files are available for the courses.

name: Fugeltindmarsjen 2027
location: Tennes gamle skole to Josefvatn, Balsfjord, Troms, Norway
description: Fugeltindmarsjen is a long-standing annual race, and in 2026 it marked its 47th edition. The race runs from the former Tennes School to Josefvatn, covering approximately 12.5 km and reaching a high point of 540 metres above sea level. It is a trail race suitable for both competitive and recreational runners, with registration available in advance or at the start. Josefvatn IL can assist with transport between the start and finish for participants who need it. The race is included in the Troms Athletics Association’s event calendar.
course_highlights: Course distance: approximately 12.5 km
High point: 540 metres above sea level
Start at the former Tennes School
additional: Registration is available at the start or in advance for the competitive class. Josefvatn IL offers transport from Josefvatn community hall to the start and back after the finish, if needed. In 2026, the recreational start was scheduled for 10:00 and the competitive start for 12:00. The organizers could help transport participants from Josefvatn community hall to Tennes before the start and retrieve cars after the finish.

name: Spring för kulturen
description: Spring for Culture is a cultural event through central Stockholm, bringing together artists, cultural workers and everyone interested to highlight the value of culture. The event is non-competitive and open to everyone; participants can run, walk, roll or dance along the route. It starts at Hakberget on Gärdet and finishes at the Swedish Parliament, covering approximately 3 km and passing central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made. During the event, the streets fill with music, dance, circus and other cultural expressions, creating a lively movement to make culture’s importance in everyday life visible.
course_highlights: An approximately 3 km route from Hakberget, Gärdet, to the Swedish Parliament
Passes central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made
The streets fill with music, dance, circus and other cultural expressions
additional: The event is non-competitive and open to everyone to run, walk, roll or dance. The start is by the sculpture Protest at Hakberget, Gärdet. The event is politically independent and aims to foster a sense of community and highlight the value of culture in society. Information for 2026 says the event starts on Gärdet and finishes at Gustav Adolfs torg. Dates and times for 2027 are not specified in the sources.

name: 17. ETAPP / Paljassaare poolsaar
description: STAGE 17 / The Paljassaare Peninsula is part of the Stamina Health Run series and takes place on 2 September 2026 in the Paljassaare Beach car park in Tallinn. The race distance is 6.5 km, and the course winds through the scenic landscape of the Paljassaare Peninsula, offering participants an enjoyable challenge and the chance to enjoy nature. The event is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking to take part in a sporting event focused on health and fitness. Stamina is the organizer and ensures a smooth, enjoyable race experience.

name: Mägede järve jooks 8. etapp , Järvamaa Järvede jooksud sarjas
description: Mägede Lake Run is the 8th event in the Järvamaa Lakes Run series and takes place in the Mägede sports area. This traditional regional race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and a sporting challenge. The routes wind between lakes and forests, making them suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event is part of Järvamaa’s active sports calendar and welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 28. Aseri Savijooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa running series is a traditional running and walking series offering distances suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in various locations across Lääne-Virumaa, offering runners diverse and interesting courses. The series lets participants enjoy both the competition and the sporting community, as well as the natural surroundings. Aseri Savijooks is one of the series’ events and takes place at Aseri Leisure Centre.

name: Jüri Jaansoni Kahe Silla jooks
description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional running event in Pärnu, held on the first weekend of September. It brings together thousands of sports enthusiasts and offers a 10 km run, Nordic walking and an evening run. The event takes place in the beautiful city of Pärnu and around its bridges, providing a sporting experience for participants of all ages. The event is organised by the Pärnu Two Bridges Club, which invites everyone to take part and enjoy being active.

name: 15. Kütioru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: Kütioru Trail Run and Walk is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The event takes place at Kütioru Ski Centre, and the course is off-road, offering a varied running experience. The series includes different distances, from little ones’ races to main events, suitable for all levels. This traditional event is open to everyone interested in sport who wants to enjoy Võrumaa’s beautiful nature and friendly athletic company.

name: Pärnu Õhtujooks ja Kahe Silla jooksu ratastoolisõit ja lastejooksud
description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional sporting event in Pärnu that brings together thousands of running enthusiasts on the first weekend of September. The event takes place in Vaasa Park and offers a range of distances and ways to take part, including an evening run, wheelchair race and children’s races. The Two Bridges Run is known for its beautiful route through the city and along the bridges, offering a sporting challenge and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants. The event is open to recreational and experienced runners alike and celebrates the joy of exercise and community spirit.

name: Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is Sweden’s largest women’s race, offering a wonderful 10 km running experience in the scenic Södra Djurgården area of Stockholm. The race is all about community, strength, and personal goals, and welcomes all women aged 15 and over. Starting groups are divided by running ability to ensure a smooth flow and a positive experience for all participants. The course takes runners through beautiful surroundings, with plenty of crowd support along the way, making it a festive and inspiring day celebrating the joy of running.
course_highlights: 10 km run through scenic Södra Djurgården and central Stockholm
Starting groups divided into 12 levels, from fast runners to walking pace
Option to take a shorter 6 km shortcut from starting group 12
additional: Starting groups are divided into 12 levels to ensure a smooth flow. The option to opt out of timing is available. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start in Stockholm and 2 hours before the start in Sälen and Vemdalen, subject to availability. Payment can be made via online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, or invoice through Klarna.

name: Harstad Summits Trail Marathon
description: Harstad Summits Trail Marathon is a spectacular mountain race held in early September, starting and finishing in central Harstad. The race offers varied, hilly terrain, with trails crossing several local mountain peaks, and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners looking for a wonderful experience in nature. The event is part of Harstadtrippelen, which combines skiing, cycling and running throughout the year, creating an inclusive community celebration with activities for the whole family. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a chance to socialise in the finish area.
course_highlights: A route crossing several mountain peaks, with varied, hilly terrain
Spectacular views and experiences in nature in the Harstad area
Start and finish in central Harstad, with a community celebration and activities
additional: Distances: Marathon (42 km, 2,100 m elevation gain), Half Marathon (21 km, 950 m elevation gain), 12 km recreational run, 10 km boys/girls, children's race in the city centre. There are aid stations along the course and marked routes, and a banquet is held for volunteers and partners after the race. Prizes are drawn among participants, and there are activities and entertainment for the whole family.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Metsajooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Anija Parish, Estonia

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
price_range: 350 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (preliminära uppgifter för 2027)

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Blodomloppet in Eskilstuna is a fun run that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or as part of a team. The race starts and finishes in Stadsparken and follows a scenic course along the river promenade and the city streets. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet for those who want to take part in shorter distances. Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that concludes with a shared picnic for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, Eskilstuna
5 km and 10 km courses along the river promenade and the city streets
Certified 5,000 m course measured by an SFIF course measurer
additional: You can register individually or as a team of 3–5 participants; a picnic for 5 people is included. Team members may take part in different distances/classes (except Lilla Blodomloppet). The deadline for team registration is 31/8. Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet start in Stadsparken and follow shorter courses inside the park. The course is officially measured, and timing is provided for the 5 km and 10 km distances. You can register individually or as a team of 3–5 people. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to age 12; Specialomloppet is 1.5–3 km.

name: Self-Transcendence 2 mailin juoksu, Vaasa
description: Self-Transcendence 2 mailin juoksu Vaasa järjestetään joka tiistai toukokuusta syyskuuhun klo 19.00 Hietalahden rauhanmaililla. Reitti on 1 mailin mittainen puistoreitti, joka kierretään kaksi kertaa. Lähtö ja ilmoittautuminen tapahtuvat uimahallin takana. Juoksu tarjoaa nopean ja miellyttävän puistoreitin, joka sopii kaikentasoisille juoksijoille.

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus, Skärblacka, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early Bird, 250 kr, fram till och med 30 april 23:59.

description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual town race through beautiful Skärblacka in Östergötland. The event offers a festival atmosphere where everyone can take part, whether they choose to run 6 km, walk 4 km or cheer from the sidelines. The course runs on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and partly on trails, with the start and finish at Folkets Hus. There are great prizes and exciting features such as the Mericon sprint and prize ceremonies for both runners and walkers.
course_highlights: 6 km run through Skärblacka on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and trails
4 km walking class without timekeeping, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus
Mericon sprint over the final 300 metres, with a chance to win a gift card
additional: Race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on the Tuesday before the race between 11:00 and 18:00, or at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late registration is available at race-number collection and on race day for an additional fee. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners, gift cards are available for the Mericon sprint, and there are also prizes for picking up trimmers and tyres along the course. The walking class is not timed, and dogs are not allowed. A first-aid volunteer will be on site. There is also a 4 km walking class.

name: Finlandiaviesti
location: Jyväskylä, Rantaraitti, Jyväskylä, Central Finland, Finland
description: Finlandiaviesti 1/2026 on osa Finlandia Marathon -tapahtumaa, joka järjestetään Jyväskylässä 11. - 12.9.2026. Tapahtuma tarjoaa juoksijoille monipuolisia matkoja, kuten 5 km, 10 km, puolimaratonin ja maratonin, ja sopii kaiken tasoisille juoksijoille. Reitti kulkee Jyväskylän Rantaraitilla, joka on palkittu Suomen kauneimpana liikenneväylänä, tarjoten tasaisen ja nopean juoksukokemuksen. Finlandia Marathon tunnetaan juoksijaystävällisestä reitistään, erinomaisesta tunnelmastaan ja elämyksellisestä tapahtumaviikonlopustaan Keski-Suomen kauniissa maisemissa.

name: Sormlands 100 Trail Run
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a running event offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most biologically diverse regions. The races range from 8 km to 100 miles and cover a mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and abilities and offers a memorable weekend in Nävekvarn, surrounded by beautiful nature and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Distances ranging from 8 km to 100 miles
Beautiful, biologically diverse region along the Sörmlandsleden trail
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. After the race, a sauna and Nävekvarn Folkets Park are available. Well-stocked aid stations offer, among other things, Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, and locally produced food. GPS tracking and live results are available. Mandatory equipment requirements vary by distance and include a mobile phone, navigation tools, a first-aid kit, and a headlamp for longer distances. Transport from the finish is available for the 50 km distance, with a bus to Nyköping Central Station. Race weekend runs from 10–12 September 2027. Registration opens on 1 December.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is an ultramarathon offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most species-rich regions. The race offers several distances from 8 km up to 100 miles, across varied terrain including forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and levels and promises a memorable day in beautiful and challenging natural surroundings. After the race, sauna and locally produced food and drinks are available at Nävekvarn Folkets Park.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Beautiful and challenging trail sections on the Sörmlandsleden trail
Well-stocked aid stations with a variety of energy options and drinks
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. Mandatory equipment includes a GPS tracker, a mobile phone with important numbers, a first-aid kit, a rain jacket, and a headlamp with extra batteries. Well-stocked aid stations along the course offer Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, fruit, chips, and local specialties, among other items. After the race, sauna, locally produced food, and non-alcoholic beer are available. Shuttle buses from the finish of the 50 km race to Nyköping Central Station are available.

name: Tahko Trail Run
organizer: Kuopio-Tahko Markkinointi Oy ja TAHKOcom Oy
description: Tahko Trail Run on uusi polkujuoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään Tahkovuoren upeissa maisemissa 12.9.2026. Tapahtuma tarjoaa neljä eripituisen matkan vaihtoehtoa, jotka sopivat niin ensikertalaisille kuin kokeneille polkujuoksijoille. Reitit kulkevat luonnonläheisissä ja vaihtelevissa maastoissa, joissa on sykettä nostattavia nousuja ja henkeäsalpaavia maisemia. Tapahtuma panostaa elämyksellisyyteen, tunnelmaan ja hyvin merkittyihin reitteihin sekä huoltopisteisiin. Maali-alueella on kisafiilis, ruokailu ja mahdollisuus saunaan ja suihkuun Break Sokos Hotel Tahkossa.

name: SaaristoTrail
description: SaaristoTrail on innostava polkujuoksutapahtuma Paraisilla, joka tarjoaa vaihtelevia reittejä upeassa saaristoluonnossa. Tapahtumassa on kolme päämatkaa: 7 km, 14 km ja 21 km puolimaraton, jotka sopivat sekä aloitteleville että kokeneemmille polkujuoksijoille. Reitit sisältävät vaihtelevia polkuja, pururatoja ja merkittäviä korkeuseroja, kuten Svinövuoren jyrkkiä nousuja, tarjoten unohtumattomia maisemia ja haastetta. Tapahtuman rento tunnelma ja huolellinen järjestely tekevät siitä miellyttävän kokemuksen kaikille osallistujille.

name: Tallinna Sügisjooks 10 km
location: Vabaduse väljak, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Tallinn Autumn Run 10 km is an autumn running event held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn. The start is on 12 September 2026 at 14:00. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers, with timed and untimed participation options. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and the city’s autumn beauty.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through central Tallinn
Participate by running or walking, with or without timing
Start and finish at Freedom Square
additional: Discounts: 20% off for seniors aged 60 and over and young people under 20. A 10% group discount applies when at least 10 people register together. The event offers discounts for seniors, young people and groups, and is part of the Tallinn Marathon, taking place on 11–13 September 2026.

name: Nike Noortejooks
description: Nike Youth Run is a running event for young people, held at Freedom Square in the heart of Tallinn. It is part of the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon event series and offers young people the chance to take part in a fun, sporting event. The race starts in the evening, creating a pleasant atmosphere and encouraging an active lifestyle among young people. Registration is easy, and early-bird prices are available.
course_highlights: Held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn
Evening start at 18:30
A safe running environment suitable for young people
additional: Registering early can secure lower entry fees. Young people and seniors can also get special discounts in the Tallinn Marathon series. Participants are provided with a safe running environment and well-organised event. The race takes place in Tallinn’s Old Town and at Freedom Square. Participants can join a community of young athletes, and awards are presented to the top finishers.

name: 84. laste Paala järve jooks
description: The 84th Paala Lake Children’s Run is a traditional children’s running event held on the shore of Paala Lake near Viljandi. The event offers distances suited to different age groups, ranging from 300 metres to a two-lap run around the lake. Organised by the JOOSU recreational sports club, it gives children the chance to enjoy being active and spend time in nature. The run starts on 12 September 2026 at 10:00. Prizes and souvenirs are provided for participants.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a highly regarded race organized by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The race offers a varied course combining asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails through scenic, gently rolling terrain around Lake Bysjön in Åtvidaberg. The start and finish are at Edbergavallen, and the event offers several distances for both children and adults, with timing for most races. It is a family-friendly and inclusive competition, with medals for everyone who finishes and special commemorative medals for loyal participants.
course_highlights: A varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails
Scenic terrain around Lake Bysjön with moderate elevation changes
The 10 km course includes challenging trail sections and floodlit trails
additional: Start times: 700 m at 11:30, 1.3 km at 11:40, and 5 km and 10 km at 13:00. Race bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen. Changing facilities, showers and toilets are available at Kanonvallen. A kiosk serving hot dogs, drinks and sweets is located at the event venue. Teams consist of 4–6 participants in any categories and receive a picnic bag from ICA Supermarket to share after finishing. Late registration is available on site from 10:00, with payment by Swish or cash; discount codes cannot be used for on-site late registration. The race has traditionally been held on the second Saturday in September and offers distances for children and adults.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna StadsTrail is a fun run offering a unique experience in nature and a challenge, with three distances: 5, 10 and 21 km. The race features varied terrain, from asphalt to winding trails through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget. The start and finish are centrally located at Gränna Square, where participants can enjoy beautiful views over Lake Vättern and a mass start. All participants receive a unique medal, and times are recorded for all distances. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to combine performance with an experience in nature.
course_highlights: 21 km course combining asphalt, trails and gravel roads
Route through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget
Start and finish at Gränna Square, with views over Lake Vättern
additional: The mass start is from Gränna Square, going through the town to the harbor, where timing begins. Timing and a unique medal for all participants. The race venue is in the heart of Gränna, close to shops, cafés and accommodation. The courses may change depending on conditions and permits. Timing and a medal at the finish.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a trail race in the beautiful and rugged Paradiset nature reserve in southern Stockholm. The race offers challenging trail running along winding paths, across bogs and boardwalks, where runners experience forest, mountains and sea. The distances are 26 km, 13 km and 6 km, and the 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour. The race is known for its strong sense of community and festive atmosphere after the finish.
course_highlights: Beautiful wild terrain with rocky outcrops and open pine forest
Small winding trails, bogs and boardwalks
The 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: The race offers three distances: 26 km, 13 km and 6 km. There is a strong sense of community and a festive atmosphere after the finish. The terrain is challenging and gives runners a strong sense of achievement. 26 km. The race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet is a family-friendly competitive and recreational race that has been held in Saltsjö-Duvnäs since 2007. The race is primarily intended for residents of Nacka, Värmdö and Saltsjöbaden, but welcomes other participants too. The start and finish are in Ringparken, and the race has strong local roots, with a focus on preserving its character as a family event for all ages. In 2027, the race celebrates 20 years with new start categories and continued community spirit among neighbours and runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Ringparken in Saltsjö-Duvnäs
Courses of 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km (the 10 km course is two laps of the 5 km course)
The course features varied terrain with hills, a waterfront promenade and views around Duvnäs Udde
additional: Timing chips are now integrated into the race bib. Race administration opens the day before and on race day. Participant numbers are limited to preserve the family atmosphere. The children’s race has its own short course around Ringparken.

name: Enköpingsloppet
description: Enköpingsloppet is an annual running festival in Enköping that brings together hundreds of runners from across Sweden. The event offers several distances for runners of all levels, from a children’s race to longer 10 km races, and is a celebration for the whole city. The courses are scenic and flat, with beautiful views of Enköping’s parks and waterfront areas. There is a group warm-up, music and cheering along the course, as well as post-race refreshments with recovery drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: A scenic two-lap course around Drömparken (5.5 km)
A flat, scenic 10 km course through Enköping, officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association
A water station halfway along the 10 km course, with music and cheering along the way
additional: Group warm-up approximately 15 minutes before each race starts. Post-race refreshments with recovery drinks and snacks for all runners. Results and finish times are available online immediately after finishing. The event area at ENA-vallen’s IP opens at 10:00. Start times: 11:00 Ajabaja Cancer Race (children’s race), 12:30 APC Race (5.5 km), 14:00 ICA Maxi Mile (10 km). Prize ceremonies take place after each race. The event area is located at ENA-vallen’s IP. The official website lists a different race date for 2027 than the stated date of 11 September.

name: Skjervøy 20:1000
description: Skjervøy 20:1000 is a challenging mountain race combining a 20 km distance with 1,000 metres of elevation gain in scenic surroundings on Skjervøy, at the edge of the open sea at 70 degrees north. The race features steep, technically demanding trails, cart tracks and boardwalks across marshland, with spectacular views and varied terrain around Skjervøy centre. It is suitable both for the fittest runners and for those looking for a manageable challenge, with recreational and competitive classes. A shorter 10 km course with 500 metres of elevation gain is also held, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The event has a social focus and aims to inspire more people to experience the island’s wonderful routes.
course_highlights: Steep, technically demanding trails with narrow sections
Cart tracks in hilly terrain and boardwalks across marshland
Wonderful views at 70 degrees north and a varied course around Skjervøy centre
additional: The 1 km children’s race is free, with registration on race day. Race bibs can be collected at Sporten Skjervøy on Thursday, Friday and Saturday before the race. Aid stations with water and cordial are located at 8 km and 12 km on the 20:1000 course, and at 3 km on the 10:500 course; runners must bring their own bottle or cup. Poles are allowed, but runners are responsible for their own safety. Headphones are not allowed. The time limit is 7 hours for the recreational class and 5 hours for the competitive class on the 20:1000. Prizes include cash prizes for the three fastest runners in the competitive class, a prize for a new course record, and draw prizes for all finishers. There is also a sprint prize (Seppalaspurten) on the final 160 metres. The programme lists separate starts for the recreational and competitive classes in the 20:1000 and 10:500. The children’s race is 1 km.

name: Trysilrypa
description: Trysilrypa is Norway’s largest mountain race and walking event for women, held in the beautiful autumn-coloured Trysil Mountains. The event offers distances of 6, 10 and 13 km, with the start and finish at SkiStar Lodge in Fageråsen. Participants can choose to run, hike or speedwalk, and enjoy a weekend filled with nature, fun and a sense of achievement alongside thousands of other women. Trysilrypa is an annual weekend for women that combines physical activity with socialising in mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Routes of 6, 10 and 13 km in beautiful high-mountain terrain
Start and finish at SkiStar Lodge in Fageråsen
Autumn-coloured mountain scenery in Trysil
additional: Participants can choose to run, hike or speedwalk. A weekend for women with a social programme is also held at SkiStar Lodge, the event venue.

name: Skogsløp med innlagt KM terrengløp
description: The forest run, which includes the Troms District Championships in cross-country running, is organized in Bardu by Bardu IL Friidrett, which aims to create activity and enjoyable experiences for athletes of all ages. The race is part of the club’s tradition of cross-country running and athletics activities, and takes place in scenic surroundings with varied terrain. Bardu IL Friidrett works with several clubs in Troms to strengthen the athletics community in the region and offers an inclusive environment for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country running on varied forest terrain
Includes the district championships in cross-country running
Scenic surroundings in Bardu
additional: Bardu IL Friidrett offers an inclusive environment for all ages and ability levels, with training and activities such as athletics school, Steilia Opp, and the TINE relay. The club works with other athletics clubs in Troms to strengthen the community and welcomes more volunteers and athletes to join the team.

name: Tampere Maraton 13.9.2026
description: Tampere Maraton on aito kaupunkimaraton, joka juostaan Tampereen sydämessä 13.9.2026. Tapahtuma tarjoaa maratonin, puolimaratonin, 10 km matkan, minimaratonin perheen pienimmille sekä maratonviestin neljän hengen joukkueille. Reitti kulkee kaupungin keskustassa ja Tampereen vesistöjen äärellä, pääosin asvaltilla ja osin hiekkaväylillä, tarjoten kauniita kaupunkimaisemia ja haastetta juoksijoille. Lähtö- ja maalialue sijaitsee Tampereen Stadionilla, josta on hyvät kulkuyhteydet. Tapahtuma on järjestetty juoksijalta juoksijalle, ja se tarjoaa onnistumisen iloa kaikenikäisille ja -tasoisille juoksijoille.

name: Ruskahölkkä
description: Ruskahölkkä on monipuolinen maastojuoksutapahtuma Oulaisissa, joka tarjoaa sarjoja ja matkoja kaikenikäisille ja -kuntoisille juoksijoille. Kilpailu järjestetään Honkamajan alueella ja sisältää matkoja aina 0,3 km lasten sarjoista 10 km yleisiin sarjoihin sekä kuntosarjoja. Tapahtumassa on palkinnot jokaisessa sarjassa ja lisäksi arvontoja, kuten polkupyörän arvonta. Juoksijoille on tarjolla suihkulliset pukuhuoneet ja tapahtuma on osa Oulaisten Tarun monipuolista urheilutoimintaa.

name: Hiekkojen Herruus Trail Run
description: Hiekkojen Herruus Trail Run tarjoaa vauhdikkaita ja sopivasti haastavia reittejä Kalajoen upeissa mäntymetsissä ja meren rantamaisemissa. Reitti kulkee mutkittelevilla neulaspoluilla ja sisältää teknisesti haastavia osuuksia, jotka haastavat juoksijan kunnon ja taidot. Kilpailu on osa kaksipäiväistä tapahtumaa, jossa voi osallistua myös MTB-kilpailuun tai yhdistelmäkilpailuun. Tervetuloa kokemaan Kalajoen hiekkamaastojen ainutlaatuinen tunnelma ja haastamaan itsesi!

name: Mälarömilen
description: Mälarömilen is a recurring running race on Ekerö that welcomes runners of all levels and the whole family. The event offers four different distances, from a children’s race for the youngest runners to the classic 10-kilometre main race. The courses pass through scenic surroundings on paved footpaths and park trails, with the start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Mälarömilen is organised by Mälarö SOK, and all proceeds go back to the club’s sporting activities.
course_highlights: Pleasant, runner-friendly courses on paved footpaths and park trails
Signs at every kilometre marker
Start and finish at Träkvista sports ground, in scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration is available on race day, subject to availability. There is a drinks station shortly after the start/lap point. Toilets, showers and changing rooms are available in the KOM building at Träkvista sports ground. A first-aid tent is staffed throughout the event. All races start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Group registration is available for teams and companies.

name: Brotorp Trailrun
location: Skogsluffarnas klubbstuga Brotorp, Bagarmossen, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Brotorp Trailrun is a challenging and enjoyable trail race on a technical 7 km loop through the finest parts of Nacka Nature Reserve. The race offers several distances, including a children’s course, 7 km, 14 km and 21 km, with the start and finish at Skogsluffarna’s Brotorp clubhouse in Bagarmossen. The courses offer varied terrain, with trails near lakes and hills, marked with orange ribbons and signs. There are aid stations with water, sports drinks and bananas during the race, and hamburgers are served after the finish to runners in the longer distances. Timing is provided by Sportident, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Technical 7 km loop marked with orange ribbons and signs
The course passes through the finest parts of Nacka Nature Reserve, with lakes and hills
Aid stations every 3.5 km with water, sports drinks and bananas
additional: Start and finish at the Brotorp clubhouse. Bib pickup takes place on race day at least one hour before the start. Food and refreshments are available at the clubhouse. Timing by Sportident. The time limit for the longest distance is 4 hours; everyone must finish before 14:00. Showers are available, but runners are advised to shower at home. The prize-giving ceremony is planned for approximately 12:30. A discount code is available for children running 7 km (50% discount). Start and finish at Skogsluffarna’s Brotorp clubhouse. According to the organizer, children who register for 7 km get a 50 percent discount with the code “barnrabatt”.

name: Vildmarksmilen
description: Vildmarksmilen is a fun trail race through the beautiful natural surroundings of Hemlingby Outdoor Recreation Area in Gävle. The varied course features changing terrain affected by the weather, making the race challenging but accessible to runners accustomed to narrow trails and off-trail terrain. The start and finish are at Spårcentralen, and the race ends with a substantial climb up the Hemlingbyberget ski slope. For those looking for a bigger challenge, Vildmark15 is recommended, but this race is not held in 2026 due to construction work.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with trails, roots, rocks and marshland
Water station at 5 km and at the finish
Final climb up the Hemlingbyberget ski slope before the finish
additional: Late registration is available on-site until 15 minutes before the start. Bib collection, late registration, the start and the finish are at Hemlingby Spårcentral. Hemlingbystugan is currently closed, and no food or refreshments are served there. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, and there are performance prizes and raffle prizes. Information about the 2027 edition and course route is not available in the sources. In 2026, an alternative course route was used due to construction work in Hemlingby Outdoor Recreation Area, and Vildmark 15 was not held.

name: RUN & RAVE Palanga
description: RUN & RAVE Palanga is a new community initiative for people who love movement, music, and good energy. The event takes place in Palanga and includes mobility training, a 5 km social run with DJ music, an ice bath ritual, and coffee breaks. It’s a great opportunity to meet new people, make connections, and experience summer energy at a single morning event. Registration is required, and participants are invited to bring running shoes, swim shorts, and a towel.

name: Strandmila 2027
description: Strandmila is an inclusive race day in the beautiful Alcoa Miljøpark, where everyone can take part regardless of age or ability. The event offers a nature trail for walkers, a children’s race for the youngest participants, and 5 km and 10 km races.
