It is a free, family-friendly day with prizes for category winners and children’s race participants, as well as a gift-card draw among nature trail participants. The kiosk in FLIK’s clubhouse will be open, making for an active and enjoyable experience for the whole family.
course_highlights: A 5 km nature trail for walkers
A children’s race of approximately 600–800 metres
5 km and 10 km races in Alcoa Miljøpark
additional: Registration via EQ Timing from 25 August or on site up to 30 minutes before the start. Prizes for category winners and children’s race participants. Kiosk sales at FLIK’s clubhouse. Start times: 12:00 nature trail, 13:45 children’s race, 14:00 5 km and 10 km races. Previous editions have been free, but the price and programme for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Renforsin maraton, Kajaani
description: Renforsin maraton on Kajaanissa 19.9.2026 järjestettävä hyväntekeväisyysjuoksutapahtuma, jonka tuotolla tuetaan paikallista nuorisourheilua. Tapahtuma tarjoaa upean reitin Kajaanin kauneimpien jokimaisemien ja nähtävyyksien äärellä, kuten Kajaanin linnanraunioiden läheisyydessä. Lähtö- ja maalialueena toimii Raatihuoneentori, ja reitti kulkee pitkin Kajaaninjoen rantoja. Tapahtuma sisältää maratonin lisäksi puolimaratonin, varttimaratonin sekä lasten juoksut eri ikäryhmille.

name: Kyröö-hölkkä 19.9.2026
description: Kyröö-hölkkä on leppoisa juoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään Isonkyrön kauniissa maalaismaisemissa. Tapahtuma tarjoaa sopivat matkat sekä hölkkääjille että vauhdikkaammille juoksijoille, ja kisassa ratkotaan myös gravel-juoksun epäviralliset SM-mitalit. Lähtö tapahtuu Kyrön Vierailukeskukselta, ja reitti kulkee vaihtelevassa mutta tasaisessa maastossa. Tule mukaan kokemaan liikunnan riemua hyvässä seurassa ja juokse siellä, missä asfaltti loppuu!

name: Ylivieska Trail Run – Meleko hyvä polokujuoksutapahtuma
description: Ylivieskan Trail Run on polkujuoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään lauantaina 19.9.2026 Törmälän leirikeskuksessa ja Rantakallassa Ylivieskassa. Tapahtuma tarjoaa kilpailusarjat miehille ja naisille 14 kilometrin matkalla sekä kunto- ja retkisarjat 1,5 km, 5 km ja 11 km matkoilla. Nuorten sarjoissa on myös tarjolla palkintoja, ja pienimmille lapsille on ilmainen stadionpyrähdys. Kaikkien osallistujien kesken arvotaan pidennetty viikonloppu Kalajoen Jäkälähovissa. Tapahtuma on monipuolinen ja sopii eri tasoisille polkujuoksijoille.

name: HOKA Messilä Vertical
description: HOKA Messilä Vertical on ainutlaatuinen kilpailu, jossa kilpaillaan siitä, kuka ehtii kerätä eniten nousumetrejä annetussa ajassa. Kilpailu käydään Messilän lumikeskuksessa Hollolassa, ja osallistujat kiertävät 1,2 km pituista reittiä, jolla on noin 90 nousu- ja laskumetriä per kierros. Kilpailussa on kolme sarjaa, joissa aikaa on 1, 2 tai 4 tuntia, ja voittaja on se, joka ehtii suorittaa eniten kierroksia omassa sarjassaan. Tapahtuma on avoin kaikenikäisille, ja kilpailun tunnelma on rento mutta haastava, sopien niin ensikertalaisille kuin kokeneillekin juoksijoille.

name: ASTRI KESKUS Narva Sügisjooks 2026
location: Astri Keskus, Narva, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
description: Astri Keskus Narva Autumn Run 2026 is a running, walking and hiking event held in Ida-Viru County, inviting everyone who enjoys being active to take part. The event is part of the activities of the Centre of Excellence for Recreational Sport, which aims to promote a healthy and active lifestyle. The Autumn Run offers an opportunity to enjoy exercise and support your mental and physical health. Participants can choose the activity that suits them and share the joy of exercise with others.
course_highlights: Takes place around Astri Keskus in Ida-Viru County
Suitable for running, walking and hiking
An event that encourages participants to be active and promotes health
additional: The event includes running, hiking and walking and takes place on 19 September 2026. Registration is open, and the event is intended for all age groups and ability levels.

name: Jõhvi rahvajooks
organizer: Jõhvi kultuuri- ja spordinõunik Avo Sambla
description: The Jõhvi People’s Run is a traditional running event, taking place for the 39th time at Heino Lipp Stadium in Jõhvi. This year, the course has been updated: in addition to city streets, it also runs through a park and the shops of Pargi Centre. The event offers an exciting and varied running experience over both the 5 km and 10 km distances. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a good sporting challenge.

name: 13. Saarepeedi mägede jooks
description: The 13th Saarepeedi Hills Run is a traditional running event held near the Saarepeedi Community Centre. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and hilly trails. It is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking to test their endurance and agility. The organizers welcome all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy an active day.

name: Kung Björn Loppet

price_tiers.distance: Mini Kung Björn (barn upp till 7 år)
Lilla Kung Björn (barn upp till 12 år)
10 km, 6 km och Trail ca 5 km

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmälan sista veckan 345 kr för samtliga klasser

description: Kung Björn Loppet is a trail race in Uppsala that welcomes elite runners, recreational runners and children of all ages, with families at its heart. The race is held at OK Linné’s clubhouse and offers several distances, including a children’s race, 6 km, 10 km and a trail race of approximately 5 km. The courses consist of gravel roads, forest trails and asphalt, with water stations along the longer distances. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a prize draw for participants.
course_highlights: Trail race on gravel roads, forest trails and asphalt
Courses of approximately 10 km and 6 km, plus a trail race of approximately 5 km
Two water stations on the 10 km course and one on the 6 km course
additional: Race bibs with electronic chips can be collected from Löplabbet the day before race day or on race day from 09:00. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the event site, but space is limited. A kiosk sells drinks, hot dogs and baked goods. Start groups are available for the 10 km, with a choice of faster and slower groups. Paid parking is available, but public transport and cycling are recommended. The event includes race-bib collection with electronic chips and an awards ceremony.

name: Kistaloppet
location: Jan Stenbecks torg, Kista, Stockholm, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan till loppet är gratis och i din anmälan ingår medalj.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan till loppet är gratis och i din anmälan ingår medalj.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan till loppet är gratis och i din anmälan ingår medalj.

description: Kistaloppet is a popular running event in Kista, Stockholm, offering races for the whole family, with distances ranging from 400 metres for the youngest participants to 5 km for adults. The race passes through Kista’s distinctive surroundings, including the high-rise buildings of the Million Programme, the green spaces of Järvafältet and the IT cluster that has made Kista known as the Silicon Valley of Northern Europe. The event has a festive atmosphere, with music and entertainment along the course, and an inclusive spirit in which all participants receive a medal. Kistaloppet is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works to promote health and physical activity in suburban communities.
course_highlights: A 5 km measured course through Kista’s Million Programme neighbourhood and green spaces
Start and finish at Jan Stenbecks torg, in central Kista
Entertainment and music stations along the course to keep participants motivated
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the event centre in Kista Galleria, in the premises opposite McDonald’s, on Friday 12:00–18:00 and Saturday 09:15–13:00. Late registration is available on site, subject to availability. There is a water station at the finish. Medical staff will be on site. All participants receive a specially designed medal. Music and DJs along the course create a festive atmosphere. The published information applies to the 2026 edition and does not confirm the date or registration terms for 2027. The 2026 information also lists a 1.6 km untimed Fun Run and children’s races of approximately 1.6 km and 500 metres.

name: Black River Run, 100 miles
location: Västerås SOK clubhouse Orientalen, Västerås, Sweden
description: Black River Run is an ultramarathon in Västerås with several distances: 100 miles (161 km), 50 miles (80.5 km), Instegsultra (48 km), 20 miles (32.2 km) and 10 miles. The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. The course consists of a 10-mile loop with varied surfaces, including technical trails, exercise trails, gravel roads, hiking trails and asphalt. Runners who complete 100 miles within 24 hours receive a belt buckle; other finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: Varied surfaces: technical trails, exercise trails, gravel roads, hiking trails and asphalt
One loop is 10 miles (16.1 km)
The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has showers and a sauna
additional: Changing rooms, showers and a sauna are available at the clubhouse. Runners can choose to forgo their medal in favour of Médecins Sans Frontières, with 20 kr donated for each medal declined. The race is organised by Västerås Löparklubb. The easiest way to get in touch is via Black River Run’s Messenger. Orientalen has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. Finishers receive a medal; those who complete 100 miles within 24 hours also receive a belt buckle.

name: Klarälvsloppet Run 21k
description: Klarälvsloppet Run 21K is a fast and scenic half marathon on a gently descending, paved trail from Forshaga Learning Center to Karlstad. The course is completely traffic-free and has no steep climbs, providing ideal conditions for setting personal records. The race follows Klarälvsbanan through the Värmland countryside and offers a unique running experience on 90 kilometers of paved nature trail. There are three official refreshment stations along the course with water and sports drinks, and fruit and refreshments await at the finish. The race starts on Saturday at 10:30, with a group warm-up in the start area.
course_highlights: Gently descending paved trail from Forshaga to Karlstad
Completely traffic-free course with no steep climbs
Three official refreshment stations with water and sports drinks
additional: The start and race-bib distribution take place at Forshaga Learning Center from 09:00 to 10:00 on race day. Participants must finish within the time limit of 2:45. A minibus follows the field and picks up participants who do not meet the time limit. Buses run from Karlstad City Library to the start for those who have purchased bus transport. Fruit and refreshments are available at the finish. On-site payments are accepted only by card or Swish. Medical assistance is available at the start, finish, and refreshment stations. The organizer describes the race as a possible “Scandinavia’s fastest half marathon?”.

name: Ulvøyløpet
organizer: Ulvøy Challenge (Melbu Idrettslag, Stokmarknes Idrettslag og Lekang Ski- og Bygdelag)
description: Ulvøyløpet is a beautiful trail race through Hadseløya’s stunning landscape in the heart of Lofoten and Vesterålen. The race offers two distances, 13 km and 26 km, with varied terrain featuring technical trails, forest roads and open mountain trails. Whether you’re looking for a challenge or a wonderful experience in nature, Ulvøyløpet offers spectacular views and flowing trails that let you pick up the pace. The event has a long tradition and is organised by volunteers in support of local sports clubs and children and young people.
course_highlights: 13 km course with 450 metres of elevation gain, featuring technical and steep trails, forest roads and open mountain trails
26 km course with 1,000 metres of elevation gain and varied terrain, including forest roads, technical trails and mountain landscape
Flowing trails between Moan and Barheia are a highlight of the long course
additional: The recreational class starts between 09:00 and 11:00. Race numbers can be collected at Corner Sport in Stokmarknes or at Stokmarknes Stadium on race day from 08:30. Drop-bag transport from the start to the finish and return transport from Melbu to Stokmarknes after the race are available. There is ample parking at the start and finish, and toilets are available. The café in the finish area is open from 11:00 to 16:30. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at approximately 14:30 at Havfisk Arena, Melbu. The courses are marked with flags and signs, and downloading the GPX file for navigation is recommended. Aid stations offer bananas, cordial, sports drink and water (bring your own cup). Littering along the course is prohibited. A recreational walk along the 13 km course is also available. Walking participants register at Stokmarknes Stadium and may start between 09:00 and 11:00.

name: Kullervo-maraton 2026
location: Joutsenen urheilukeskus, Joutsenon, Lappeenranta, South Karelia, Finland
description: Kullervo-maraton 2026 juostaan Joutsenon urheilukeskuksessa sunnuntaina 20.9.2026. Tapahtuma on perinteikäs ja tarjoaa Suomen nopeimman maratonreitin, joka on lähes täysin asfaltoitu ja tasainen. Kilpailussa on tarjolla maraton, puolimaraton, 10 km ja lasten minimaraton, joten se sopii monentasoisille juoksijoille. Reitti on hyvin opastettu ja huoltopisteitä on riittävästi. Osallistujat saavat reittihuollon, mitalin, kahvin, pullan ja keittolounaan kisaravintolassa.

name: KOMIA Kyrkösjärven kierros
description: KOMIA Kyrkösjärven kierros on Seinäjoen legendaarinen ja suosittu lenkkeilytapahtuma, jossa juostaan Kyrkösjärven ympäri. Tapahtumapaikkana toimii Kyrkösjärven uimaranta ja Luontotalo Käpälikkö, jossa sijaitsevat lähtö, maali, pysäköinti ja tapahtumakeskus. Päämatkana on 15,4 km mittainen reitti, lisäksi tarjolla on lyhyempi noin 4,3 km Pikku Kyrkkäri nuorille tai hölkkänä sekä Mini Kyrkkäri 400-500 m perheen pienimmille. Tapahtuma tarjoaa elämyksellisen juoksukokemuksen luonnon keskellä, ja se on avoin eri ikä- ja sarjaluokille.

name: Juutuanvaaran kymppi – polkujuoksu Inarissa 2026
location: Juutunvaaran vanha metsä, Inari, Lapland, Finland
description: Juutuanvaaran kymppi on uusi polkujuoksutapahtuma Inarissa, joka tarjoaa elämyksellisiä polkuja eri mittaisina kaikille juoksijoille. Reitti kulkee Juutunvaaran vanhassa metsässä, jossa on vaihtelevaa maastoa mäntykankaista tunturikoivikkoon ja upea näkymä Inarijärvelle. Kilpailu alkaa 20.9.2026 klo 12:00, ja osallistujille on tarjolla kunniapalkintoja sekä muistomitalit. Tapahtuma sopii niin kuntoilijoille kuin kilpaileville juoksijoille, ja osallistujat saavat kisamakkaran ja juoman.

name: Rakvere 43. Rahvajooks
description: The 43rd Rakvere Folk Run is a traditional mass-sport event that welcomes all running enthusiasts. The race takes place at Rakvere City Stadium and offers a variety of distance options for both children and adults. The courses have been carefully chosen to provide an enjoyable running experience and promote a healthy lifestyle. The event is open to anyone sufficiently trained to complete their chosen distance.

name: Coop Linköping Runt
description: Coop Linköping Runt is a popular fun run held in Linköping, starting and finishing at Trädgårdsföreningen. The race offers a pleasant course through the central parts of the city and a great running experience for both recreational and competitive runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and good amenities, including changing rooms, showers and bag drop. It is a traditional autumn race that attracts runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course passes through central Linköping, with lovely views
Start and finish at Trädgårdsföreningen
Paved surface with gentle undulations
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available. A bag drop is offered. Food and drink, as well as medical assistance, are available on site. Bib numbers and race confirmations are handled according to the terms and conditions. It is possible to transfer an entry and change category. The race also seeks volunteers.

name: Sicklaloppet
description: Sicklaloppet is Nacka’s big autumn running festival, with races for all ages and ability levels. The main event is a 10 km fun run along the beautiful lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad, starting and finishing at Sickla Köpkvarter. There is also a 5 km Energiloppet, Lilla Sicklaloppet for children up to 12 years old, and Mini Sickla for the youngest participants. The races offer a scenic, fast course, a great atmosphere and plenty of crowd support. Sicklaloppet is organised by Järla IF Orientering and is a public health event for Nacka and Stockholm.
course_highlights: The course runs along the lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad
The surface consists of asphalt, gravel and a wooden boardwalk
Start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter, with spectators and musical entertainment
additional: The event venue opens at 08:00 at Marcusplatsen in Sickla Köpkvarter, with race bib collection and on-site registration. Food trucks and partners will be on site. Lilla Sicklaloppet has start times from 09:15 to 10:15 for different age groups. The Sicklaloppet 5 km starts at 11:45 and the 10 km starts at 13:00. The time limit for the 10 km is 1 hour and 15 minutes, with a cut-off at Kyrkviken after approximately 7.5 km. The course has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association. All races start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter. The race website describes the 2026 edition; details about the 2027 event format and registration have not been confirmed.

name: 20. ETAPP
description: The 20th stage is part of the running series organized by Stamina Sports Club and takes place on the Järve health trail in Tallinn. This stage gives participants the chance to enjoy a health trail close to the city, well suited to both recreational and experienced runners. The event is traditional and well organized, offering an enjoyable sporting experience and a sense of community. Participants can also enjoy beautiful nature and healthy exercise in the fresh air.

name: Rava järve jooks, Liikumissari 8.Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 9.etapp
description: The Rava Lake Run is part of the Liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Lakes Run Series and takes place by Lake Rava in Järvamaa. Runners of all ages take part, from toddlers to seniors. The race features a single lap around the lake, with prizes awarded to the fastest men and women. It is a traditional, community-focused running event that offers both a sporting challenge and a chance to enjoy nature.

name: TCS Lidingöloppet (Lidingöloppshelgen)
distance_verbose: 30 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 1.7 km
description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world’s largest cross-country race and a much-loved running challenge held annually on Lidingö since 1965. More than 30,000 runners gather during race weekend to run scenic, hilly courses, from short children’s races to the classic 30 km race, a true test of endurance. The race is a world-class celebration of running and a showcase for the joy of movement and public health, with nature always at its heart. Participants can also enjoy a sports expo featuring partners and exhibitors offering inspiration ahead of the race.
course_highlights: A hilly cross-country course featuring flat meadows, gravel roads and steep climbs
The 30 km race has 522 metres of elevation gain and is open for training around the clock before race day
Aid stations along the course offering sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas
additional: The sports expo at Lidingövallen takes place during race weekend, where participants collect their race bibs and can browse offers and expert advice. Free buses run between Ropsten and Lidingövallen during race weekend. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Photographers are stationed along the course and at the finish, with photos available to purchase after the race. The course profile and elevation gains are presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ feature for pace planning. Aid stations offer sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas. Lidingöloppet encourages environmentally friendly travel by public transport, bicycle or carpooling. Lidingöloppet weekend includes races for different ages and levels, from a 1.7 km children’s race.

name: 1. Full Moon Backyard Ultra Kymi
description: Backyard Ultra on ultramaratonjuoksu, jossa kilpailijat juoksevat 6,706 kilometrin mittaisen reitin tunnin sisällä. Kilpailu jatkuu niin kauan kuin useat juoksijat pystyvät suorittamaan kierroksen alle tunnissa, ja voittaja on se, joka juoksee yhden kierroksen enemmän kuin muut. Reitti on joko ympyrälenkki tai edestakainen, ja lähtöalue pysyy samana koko kilpailun ajan. Kilpailussa ei ole ennalta määrättyä loppuaikaa, mikä tekee siitä erityisen haastavan ja jännittävän. Suomessa Backyard Ultra -kilpailuja järjestetään yhteistyössä ja lajia kehitetään aktiivisesti.

name: Vihteljärven ympärijuoksu - 67.
description: Vihteljärven ympärijuoksu on Satakunnan vanhin yhtäjaksoinen vuosittainen juoksutapahtuma, joka on järjestetty vuodesta 1960 lähtien. Tapahtuma tarjoaa 6,5 kilometrin juoksun useissa ikäluokissa sekä hölkkäsarjan ilman ajanottoa. Lisäksi lapsille on omat sarjansa lyhyemmillä matkoilla. Kilpailu järjestetään Kankaanpään Vihteljärven koululla ja tarjoaa osallistujille perinteikkään ja yhteisöllisen juoksukokemuksen luonnonkauniissa ympäristössä.

name: Kiehimänjoen juoksu 2026
description: Kiehimänjoen juoksu on viidettä kertaa järjestettävä juoksutapahtuma Paltamossa, joka tarjoaa maratonin, puolimaratonin, kuntokympin ja lasten juoksun. Tapahtuma alkaa lauantaina 26.9.2026 klo 11 ja kisakeskus sijaitsee Kotolinnassa, jossa on juoksijoiden käytössä huoltotilat, ruokailu, saunat ja majoitusmahdollisuus. Reitit ovat virallisesti mitattuja ja ajanotto on kaikissa sarjoissa. Juoksun jälkeen on mahdollisuus varata palauttava hieronta. Paikan päällä ilmoittautuminen on mahdollista, mutta siitä peritään lisämaksu aikuisilta.

name: Lampaloppet 2026
description: Lampaloppet 2026 järjestetään lauantaina 26.9.2026 Lamminaholla Pyhäjärvellä. Reitti kulkee Honkavuoren maisemissa ja tutustuttaa juoksijat Ahton historiallisiin paikkoihin. Tapahtuma tarjoaa sopivan haasteen sekä tavoitteellisille juoksijoille että rennommille liikkujille. Kilpasarjoissa on ajanotto, mutta myös hölökkäsarja ilman ajanottoa, jossa voi liikkua omalla vauhdilla. Osallistujille on tarjolla juomapisteet, pesumahdollisuus, sauna sekä Lampaloppet-tuubihuivi.

name: ELKE Tallinn Run - Noblessner 2026
description: The ELKE Tallinn Run takes place in Noblessner, offering the joy of exercise and experiences for the whole family. This beautiful seaside area provides an ideal setting for both sporting activities and an enjoyable day out. Race day begins with a children’s run and offers a choice of distances to suit both beginners and experienced runners. In addition to sports, the programme includes a free concert and a varied programme, creating a wonderful atmosphere for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: The beautiful seaside area of Noblessner
Views of Noblessner and North Tallinn
A variety of distances for children and adults
additional: Race day begins with the children’s run at 13:00. The 2.5 km and Stebby 5 km distances start at 14:30, and the Neptunas 10 km distance starts at 15:10. The event centre’s programme runs from 11:00 - 17:10. A free concert by INGER takes place at Noblessner Central Square at 13:40. Outdoor seaside setting, family-friendly, includes a run and a concert, autumn event

name: 44. Viking Window Paide-Türi rahvajooks
description: The Viking Window Paide-Türi Fun Run is a traditional mass-participation sporting event that brings together running enthusiasts from Järvamaa and beyond. The course features varied terrain, offering both challenges and beautiful views. The event is suitable for all age groups and, in addition to the main race, includes children’s runs and other active activities. Completing the course between Paide and Türi is an annual highlight that brings the community and sports enthusiasts together.

name: Tjurruset
description: Tjurruset is an annual cross-country race in Karlstad, featuring a course of approximately 10 kilometres with both natural and constructed obstacles. The race is known for its muddy, challenging terrain, with water, steep hills and creative obstacles, creating a fun, spectator-friendly festival. In addition to the main race, there are children’s races, Kalvruset and Minikalvruset, with shorter courses and child-friendly obstacles. Tjurruset attracts both experienced cross-country runners and enthusiastic recreational runners, all of whom enjoy a memorable, muddy experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km course with natural and constructed obstacles
Terrain featuring mud, water and steep hills
Spectator-friendly spots near the muddiest and wettest obstacles
additional: Bib distribution starts at 09:00 at Norra fältet. The warm-up starts at approximately 13:45. The race bib and timing chip are handed out together; the chip is attached to the ankle and discarded after the race. Participants should change at home, as there are no changing rooms on site. Medical assistance is available at the finish and along the course. Late registration is available on site until 45 minutes before the start. Food service and Tjurruset tights are available for purchase in the event area. There is a team competition with teams of up to six people, with the five fastest times counting. Participants should be able to run 10 km on road or asphalt in under 90 minutes. The children’s races include Kalvruset, 2.5 km, and Minikalvruset, approximately 200–400 metres.

name: Gudö Run of Hope
description: Gudö Run of Hope is a beautiful trail race in Tyresö, held in support of the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary and welcomes runners of all ages and levels to run, walk or jog. Participants can choose from several distances, from 1 km to 10 km, as well as a 5 km walk. The event is part of the fight against childhood cancer and offers a meaningful and enjoyable experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: A beautiful trail race in Tyresö
Several distances: 1 km, 3 km, 6 km and 10 km, plus a 5 km walk
Suitable for runners of all ages
additional: The race is organised by Gudö Sportklubb in Tyresö. Participants can run, walk or jog. The event encourages fundraising via Swish and QR code for those who cannot participate. The Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund is the organiser, and the contact people can be reached via the specified email address. Proceeds go to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund. Information about the distances and event is based on previous editions; details for 2027 are not confirmed by the sources.

name: 58. Vihtijärvihölkkä
description: Vihtijärvihölkkä on perinteikäs juoksutapahtuma, joka tarjoaa kilpailijoille mahdollisuuden osallistua puolimaratonille, 10 kilometrin juoksuun sekä lyhyempiin matkoihin. Reitit kulkevat vaihtelevassa maastossa, ja juoksijoita palvelee useita juomapisteitä matkan varrella. Tapahtuma on avoin eri ikäryhmille ja sarjoille, ja se järjestetään Vihtijärven alueella. Kilpailu on järjestetty jo 58 kertaa, mikä kertoo sen suosiosta ja perinteestä paikallisten keskuudessa.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 41. Jooks ümber Porkuni järve
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of distance options for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in beautiful locations across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners both the excitement of competition and an enjoyable sporting experience. The main races, along with the youth and children’s races, are popular and encourage physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The series’ stages have secured a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts.

name: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (Rosa Bandet-loppet)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet 250 kr till och med 26/9 2027

description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (the Pink Ribbon Race) is an inspiring fun run held amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö. The race offers two distances, 4 km and 10 km, on gentle courses with an elevation gain of 209 metres. It is part of the Pink Ribbon campaign and aims to promote physical activity and raise awareness of cancer-preventive lifestyle habits. Everyone aged 9 and up is welcome to take part, and part of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. The race is an official launch event for the Pink Ribbon campaign and is organised in cooperation with the Swedish Cancer Society.
course_highlights: Gentle courses amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö
Two distances: 4 km and 10 km, with 209 metres of elevation gain
Course profile presented by Garmin with PacePro functionality
additional: All runners aged 9 and up for the 4 km and 11 and up for the 10 km are welcome. SEK 100 of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. All finishers receive a bronze medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Marathon Photos photographs participants along the course and at the finish. The course profile is presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ function for pace planning. The race is part of Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern. From 2025, there is a 4 km category for ages 9–15.

name: 16. ETAPP
description: The 16th stage is part of a recreational running series held in Tallinn. The event centre, start and finish are at Järve Health Trail, offering participants an enjoyable running and Nordic walking experience at the car park by the shared-use path. The route is easily accessible by car and public transport, making it convenient to take part. The series aims to offer everyone an opportunity to spend their free time in an active and healthy way.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking on Järve Health Trail
Start and finish at the car park by the Järve shared-use path
Easy access by car and public transport
additional: The event centre, start and finish are at the car park by the Järve shared-use path, at the Viljandi mnt end of Järve Health Trail. Those arriving by car are advised to park at Järve Selver, from where it is about a 400 m walk or jog to the event centre. Those travelling by bus should get off at the Risti stop, from where it is about a 300 m walk to the event centre.

name: Idrettsheialøpet 27
description: Idrettsheialøpet is a short race at Idrettsheia in Salangen, with a 1.5 km loop. Previous editions have featured varied surfaces, including asphalt, gravel, artificial turf and grass. The course is mostly flat, with a couple of small climbs and descents along the way. Details about the race format and registration for 2027 have not been confirmed.
course_highlights: 1.5 km loop at Idrettsheia
Varied surfaces: asphalt, gravel, artificial turf and grass
Mostly flat course with two small climbs and descents per lap

name: Friday Night Run 2026
description: Friday Night Run is an energetic night run in central Tartu, taking place on 2 October at Town Hall Square. The distance is approximately 4 km, along city streets, offering a chance to enjoy the atmosphere of the autumn city with friends. This is not a race; participants can choose to run with or without timing. The event features music and a live concert, creating a lively evening atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 4 km course in central Tartu
The course runs along city streets and park paths
One split-timing point on the timed distance
additional: The race number must be pinned to the chest and visible throughout the distance. The timing chip is attached to the back of the race number and is for single use. Participants have 45 minutes to complete the course; the finish closes at 21:45. The entry fee includes a marked course, race number, timing (if using a chip), services at the finish, and medical assistance if needed. Registration is available online until 2 October at 17:00 and on site until 20:30. The event includes online and on-site registration, medals and T-shirts for participants, and group discounts.

name: Loimaan Lenkki
description: Loimaan Lenkki on syksyinen juoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään Loimaan keskustassa. Tapahtumassa on tarjolla neljä eri matkaa: 1,2 km, 2,4 km, 5,2 km ja 10,4 km, joten se sopii monenlaisille juoksijoille. Lähtöpaikka on Viljavarastontie 4 ja tapahtuma tarjoaa mukavan mahdollisuuden liikkua ja nauttia yhteisöllisyydestä. Ilmoittautuminen on avoinna, ja tapahtuman järjestää Loimaan Seudun Nuorkauppakamari.

name: KOMIA Esi-Talvijuoksusarja
description: KOMIA Esi-Talvijuoksusarja on talvinen kuusiosainen juoksusarja, joka tarjoaa kaikentasoisille juoksijoille mahdollisuuden testata ja seurata kuntonsa kehitystä. Sarjan reitit lähtevät Pajuluoman koululta ja ovat nopeat sekä tasaiset, tarjoten 2 km, 5 km ja 10 km matkat. Sarja alkaa Esi-Talvijuoksulla lokakuun alussa ja jatkuu kevääseen asti. Sarjan päätteeksi parhaat palkitaan, ja juoksut sopivat hyvin niin kuntoilijoille kuin kilpaileville juoksijoillekin.

name: Keurusselän Syyslenkki
description: Keurusselän Syyslenkki on monipuolinen syksyinen tapahtuma Keuruun kauniissa maisemissa, jossa voi osallistua polkujuoksuun tai maastopyöräilyyn. Polkujuoksussa on kaksi lenkkiä, 6,4 km ja 12 km, ja maastopyöräilyssä useita matkoja eri sarjoissa, mukaan lukien lasten ja sähköpyöräsarjat. Tapahtuma tarjoaa myös lasten lenkit ja mahdollisuuden nauttia hotellin kylpylästä osanottomaksun yhteydessä. Reitit kulkevat Resort Keurusselän ja Montosvuoren maastoissa, tarjoten mäkijuoksua ja teknisesti vaihtelevia polkuja. Osallistujat voivat nauttia myös hotellin ravintolan tarjouksista tapahtumapäivänä.

name: 15. Tartu Linnamaratoni Lastejooksud
description: The Tartu City Marathon children's races are open to all children, with the joy of taking part as the main goal. Recommended guidelines apply to distances and age groups, but every child is welcome on the course and treated equally. Bib numbers are issued one hour before the start, and the event is not ranked. The event takes place in Tartu Town Hall Square, with registration available both in advance and on site.

name: Broloppet Motala

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

description: Broloppet Motala is a popular running race organized by Motala AIF Friidrott, with the start and finish in Stadsparken in Motala. The race features a newly revived course that runs through central Motala, offering a pleasant running experience in an urban setting. There are two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with a separate lane for runners completing the first lap of the 10 km race. Water stations are available at the bridge and at the lap point to provide runners with the best possible support.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, in central Motala
Newly revived course through the city centre
Water stations at the bridge (approx. 3 km) and at the lap point
additional: Late registration is available on race day, 3/10, from 10:00 to 12:30 at Team Sportia. Bib numbers can be collected at Team Sportia from Friday 2/10, 10:00–18:00, and Saturday 3/10, 10:00–12:30. Changing facilities are available at Actic Stora Torget. Bag drop-off is by the stage. The 10 km race has a separate lane for runners completing the first lap.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The Förbifartspremiären is a unique race held only once, giving participants the opportunity to run or walk on the new E4 between Hjulsta and Häggvik, both above and below ground. The race offers different classes and distances for all levels, from walking to racing, with the start and finish at the new Akalla interchange in Stockholm. It’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience where you get to be the first to set foot on the new road before it opens to traffic.
course_highlights: The race runs both above and below ground on the new E4 Förbifart Stockholm
Start and finish at the new Akalla interchange
In the recreational class, you can choose an exit after approximately 4, 7 or 12 km
additional: Race bibs are either mailed to participants’ homes or collected on site, depending on the participant’s address. The competitive class starts at 09:00, the recreational class has start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and the walking class Herr Gårman starts between 18:00 and 19:30. The maximum time for the competitive class is 1 hour and 30 minutes. Entry is personal and cannot be transferred. The event area is easiest to reach by metro to Akalla.

name: Avesta Night Sky Run
description: Avesta Night Sky Run is an autumn event organized by Dalaportens OL in Avesta. The race offers an exciting running experience in scenic surroundings and is part of Dalaportens orienteering activities. Participants can register via MittLopp and enjoy a well-organized event with good service. Together with Backyard Ultra, it creates a unique running weekend in October.
course_highlights: Running in scenic surroundings around Avesta
Part of Dalaportens OL’s autumn event
Backyard Ultra with 6.7 km laps and a mass start every hour
additional: Backyard Ultra starts at 11:00 on October 3, on a 6.7 km course that is mostly on a shared walking and cycling path. A new lap starts every hour, with a mass start, and the competition continues until only one participant remains. A refreshment station with drinks and energy supplies is available at the lap point. Registration for Backyard Ultra is by email to AvestaUltra@outlook.com, with an entry fee of 350 kr. Maximum 80 participants. Previous editions have been held together with Avesta Backyard Ultra.

name: Tromsø Backyard Ultra
description: Tromsø Backyard Ultra is a unique Arctic ultrarun in the heart of Tromsø, where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour. The race challenges endurance and tactics, as each loop must be completed within an hour to continue. It is suitable for all levels, whether you want to test your limits or take part in a social and motivating training session. The race takes place on Tromsdalen’s beautiful network of trails, mostly on gravel roads with some asphalt, offering a special experience in Northern Norwegian nature.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop in Tromsdalen
The course is mostly on gravel roads, with some asphalt
Start/finish outside TUIL Arena in Tromsdalen
additional: Race bibs must be collected well before the race. Parking is available at Entrance A or Elvestrand Cemetery. Discounted accommodation may be available at Tromsø Lodge and Camping. Participants run one loop every hour and must be ready at the start line when the next loop begins. All starters receive a participant medal. The winners in the women’s and men’s categories are determined after 24 loops. Distances build up over the loops: 4 loops is approximately 26.8 km, 7 loops approximately 46.9 km, 12 loops approximately 80 km, and 15 loops approximately 100.6 km.

name: Solvalla Trail
location: Solvalla Sports Institute, Nuuksio, Espoo, Finland
description: Solvalla Trail palaa polkujuoksukalenteriin Espoossa Nuuksion alueella sunnuntaina 4.10.2026. Tapahtuma tarjoaa juoksijoille mahdollisuuden nauttia luonnonkauniista polkuympäristöstä kahdella eri matkalla, 9 km ja 18 km. Esbo IF järjestää tapahtuman, joka sopii niin kokeneille polkujuoksijoille kuin harrastajillekin. Tule mukaan kokemaan vauhdikas ja elämyksellinen polkujuoksutapahtuma upeissa maisemissa.

name: Hostruset

price_tiers.distance: 5 km Män, Kvinnor, PF19, Veteraner 50+ och Motion

description: Hostruset is a fast 5 km race and fun run held in Örebro, starting and finishing at Björkhagaskolan. The course follows cycle paths around Varbergaskogen and has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association. The race is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series and offers both competitive and recreational classes. There is also a 700-metre children’s race for the youngest participants. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. Due to limited parking, the organisers encourage carpooling or cycling.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on cycle paths around Varbergaskogen
Starts and finishes at Björkhagaskolan in Örebro
Officially measured by a course measurer in accordance with the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Start groups are being tested for the 5 km race: runners expecting to finish in over 25 minutes start at 12:30, and those expecting to finish in under 25 minutes start at 12:45. Race numbers are distributed on race day. Timing is done using transponders, which must be returned after the race; otherwise, a charge of 400 kr applies. The prize ceremony takes place in the start/finish area, with honorary prizes for the top 5 in Men/Women and the top 3 in PF19 and Veteran 50+. Changing rooms and showers are available at Björkhagaskolan. Parking is very limited; carpooling or cycling is recommended.

name: /M.Pirksaare/Türi Tehisjärve jooks, liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 11. etapp
description: The Türi Artificial Lake Run is part of the 8th Järvamaa Lakes Running Series, offering a variety of running opportunities for different age groups. The course loops around Rava Artificial Lake and features varied terrain of sand, soil and gravel. The best runners will be awarded, and the event is suitable for both recreational runners and young running enthusiasts. The event takes place on October 7, 2026, by Lake Rava in Järvamaa.

name: Dark Run Lahti
description: Dark Run Lahti on ainutlaatuinen elämysjuoksu, joka järjestetään pimenevässä syysillassa Salpausselän upeissa maisemissa. Tapahtuma tarjoaa 5 km ja 10 km matkat, jotka sopivat kaiken tasoisille liikkujille. Juoksijat kulkevat pääosin ulkoilureiteillä otsalamppujen valossa, ja tapahtumaan kuuluu myös vapaaehtoinen Pimeä Metsä -kauhuelämys, joka tuo jännitystä reitille. Tunnelmallinen tapahtumakeskus sijaitsee Lahden urheilukeskuksessa, ja juoksun jälkeen on palkintojenjako sekä arvontoja.

name: Joutenlammen Jotos 2026, Kajaani
description: Joutenlammen Jotos on Kajaanin seurakunnan järjestämä juoksutapahtuma, joka pidetään Joutenlammen kurssikeskuksessa. Tapahtuma tarjoaa kolme juoksumatkaa: 10 km päämatkan aikuisille, 3 km nuorille ja noin 1,5 km lasten juoksun. Reitti kulkee pääosin hiekkateitä pitkin, ja tapahtuma alkaa klo 11 metsäkirkolla, jonka jälkeen on keittolounas. Joutenlammen Jotos on yhteisöllinen ja perheystävällinen tapahtuma, joka kutsuu kaikenikäiset liikkumaan ja nauttimaan luonnosta.

name: Hercules Trail Run
description: Hercules Trail Run on kymmenennen kerran järjestettävä polkujuoksutapahtuma, joka kutsuu juoksijat kokemaan Porvoon upeimmat polut ja merelliset maisemat lokakuun raikkaudessa. Tapahtuma tarjoaa monipuolisia reittivaihtoehtoja kaiken kuntoisille, aina 2 km lasten Polkurallista aina 42 km polkujuoksuun. Kisapäivä alkaa lasten Polkurallilla ja jatkuu useilla eri matkoilla, jotka kiertävät kauniita ja vaihtelevia polkuja Porvoon alueella. Osallistumismaksu sisältää monipuoliset palvelut ja tapahtuman aikana otetaan valokuva- ja videomateriaalia, jota käytetään tapahtuman tiedottamisessa.

name: Säkylänharjun polkujuoksu
description: Säkylänharjun polkujuoksu järjestetään lauantaina 10.10.2026 Huovinrinteen ampumahiihtokeskuksessa Säkylässä. Tapahtuma tarjoaa polkujuoksun ystäville monipuoliset reitit, jotka kulkevat muun muassa Klopin montun kautta. Kilpailukeskus sijaitsee helposti saavutettavassa paikassa, ja tapahtuma on tunnettu hyväksi todetusta konseptistaan. Osallistujat voivat valita eri matkojen välillä ja nauttia luonnon rauhasta ja vaihtelevasta maastosta.

name: 42. Munamäe–Võru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: The 42nd Munamäe–Võru cross-country run and walk is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, which offers a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance follows trails and asphalt roads, providing a varied course in the Võru area. The series also includes shorter distances and children’s runs, suitable for participants of all ages. The event takes place at the SA Võru Sports Centre ski base in Kubija, known for its beautiful natural surroundings and good course conditions.

name: Ultunamilen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott

description: For many years, Ultunamilen was organized by Upsala IF, but in 2026 it will be replaced by Gränbyloppet, held in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. Gränbyloppet focuses on the joy of running and safety in the area, with the start and finish near IFU Arena. The race is part of Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for young people and adults, on a course that runs through the park and its surroundings.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with 2.5 km laps (blue course)
The race is held alongside the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a visible race number. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held alongside Gränbyloppet for young people aged 14 and under. Results are published around the time of the race.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race that aims to highlight the importance of physical activity for mental health. The race takes place at the Swedish Maritime Museum in Stockholm and offers an easy-to-run 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. All participants contribute to psychiatric research, as all proceeds go directly to this cause. Mental Health Run welcomes everyone, regardless of background or fitness level, and promotes community and the joy of movement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Swedish Maritime Museum
Easy-to-run/walk 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken
Course through the scenic surroundings of Djurgården
additional: A medal can be selected as an optional extra when registering. The dog race is a special event where participants run or walk together with their dog, which must be kept on a leash throughout the race. The dog race focuses on the joy of movement and community rather than performance. Participation is at your own risk, and dog owners are responsible for their dogs. Participants in the dog race start at the back of the field. There is also a virtual race from 10–31 October 2027. A medal is included for in-person participants. The deadline to register for the in-person race is 8 October 2027 at 12:00.

name: Umemaran
organizer: Jalles TC Umeå och IFK Umeå
description: Umemaran is a running festival that brings runners together in Umeå and is organized by Jalles TC together with IFK Umeå. The event offers both a marathon and a half marathon on a fast, scenic course that follows the Ume River via Ön on both sides. It has been a tradition since 1973 and also serves as the Northern Norrland Championships for the marathon. Participants are offered refreshments every four kilometres, a medal at the finish, and coffee and a sandwich after the race.
course_highlights: A fast course that follows the Ume River via Ön on both sides
Every kilometre is marked, and the course has been officially measured by an SFIF certified course measurer
Refreshment stations with Umara sports drink and water approximately every four kilometres
additional: Slow runners with finish times of 4:45 or longer may start at 10:00 after registering in advance. Changing facilities and showers are available at Jubileumshallen near the start area. Bibs and chips must be collected no later than 45 minutes before the start at Tegs Centralskola, with collection also available the day before at Team Sportia Ersboda. The prize ceremony takes place immediately after the 21 km race and at approximately 16:20 for the 42 km race in the auditorium at Tegs Centralskola. Everyone who completes the 42 km race has a chance to win a bicycle in a draw at the prize ceremony. The marathon is the Northern Norrland Championships for seniors and veterans.

name: Tjurruset
organizer: Marathongruppen, Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK
description: Tjurruset is a challenging cross-country race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 kilometres. The race features muddy sections, trail paths and wet terrain, making it an adventure for anyone who isn’t afraid of getting dirty or tackling challenging terrain. It is a fun and demanding race suited to both seasoned runners and beginners, with an emphasis on fighting spirit and camaraderie. After crossing the finish line, showers and rinse-off facilities are available in tents near the finish. Tjurruset is organised by Marathongruppen together with the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK.
course_highlights: Terrain with muddy sections and trail paths
Challenging natural terrain with wet ground and forest trails
Held in Norra Djurgården, a well-known woodland setting
additional: After the race, hot showers are available in tents a few minutes’ walk from the finish, along with basic rinse-off facilities immediately after crossing the finish line. There are collection bins for clothes that cannot be taken home. Participants are advised to wear clothes they don’t mind getting dirty and shoes with good grip that fit securely to handle the mud.

name: Terräng DM
description: Welcome to the District Championships in cross-country running, held at Nytorp sports field near Hammarby Södra School. The race features a course that is mostly on grass, with a short 70-metre hill on asphalt. Runners in different age groups and masters categories can take part over a range of distances. Bib numbers and check-in are at the race office by the start area.
course_highlights: The course is mostly on grass
A 70-metre hill on asphalt
Start and finish at Nytorp sports field near Hammarby Södra School
additional: Check-in and bib numbers are at the race office beside the start. The events include youth and masters categories. Check-in and bib numbers are collected at the race office next to the start.

name: Gränbyloppet
price_range: 100–200 kr för icke-medlemmar (2026 års priser); gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott
description: Gränbyloppet is organized by Upsala IF Friidrott and takes over from Ultunamilen, with a focus on the joy of running in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. The race takes place in conjunction with Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for youth and adults. The start and finish are at the intersection just northeast of the pergola in the middle of Gränbyparken, near IFU Arena. The race is open to both members and non-members, with a simple and clear online registration process.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with a blue 2.5 km loop
The race is held in conjunction with the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a clearly visible race bib. The start and finish are approximately 800 metres from IFU Arena. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held in conjunction with Gränbyloppet for youth aged 14 and under. The race takes place in conjunction with Terrängserien, whose final day is aimed at youth aged 14 and under. Information about distances and fees applies to the 2026 edition.

name: Bėgimas Gintarinė jūrmylė
organizer: Klaipėdos miesto sporto bėgimo klubas “Gintarinė jūrmylė”
description: “Amber Sea Mile” is an international running race held in beautiful Smiltynė. The event offers a range of distances: 0.5 nautical miles for children, 1 nautical mile for anyone who wants to take part, 3 nautical miles for women, and 6 nautical miles for men and professionals. The start and finish are at the Sports and Wellness Base, and participants are treated to army-style porridge and tea. The race tradition commemorates the winners’ names on a memorial stone raised from the bottom of the lagoon.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 7. Võsu Sügisjooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series that offers a variety of running opportunities for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in the Lääne-Virumaa region, offering runners beautiful scenery and an enjoyable sporting experience. Võsu Autumn Run is the 7th stage of the series. It takes place in the Võsu Laine area and is part of a long-running traditional race series. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and enjoy running and recreational sport.

name: 71. Viljandi Linnajooks
description: The Viljandi City Run is a traditional endurance race held every year on the second Sunday of October in the city of Viljandi. The race route goes around Lake Viljandi, and the event is one of Estonia’s oldest sporting competitions, attracting top runners from across the country. In addition to the main race, several recreational sports events take place, including children’s races for different age groups. The Viljandi City Run course is 10.4 km long, offering an energetic and enjoyable experience for both recreational runners and professional athletes.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
location: Hässelby IP, Loviselundsvägen 100, Hässelby, Stockholm, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

description: Hässelbyloppet is a classic 10 km race held in northwestern Stockholm, featuring a flat, fast course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby. The race has a long tradition and is organised by Hässelby SK Friidrott. The same day also features Lilla Hässelbyloppet, a children’s and youth race with shorter distances and timing for participants aged 9 and over. The course is officially measured, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The start and finish are at Hässelby Idrottsplats, near the metro.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km course through northwestern Stockholm
Start and finish at Hässelby Idrottsplats, near the metro
Lilla Hässelbyloppet for children and young people, with timing for participants aged 9 and over
additional: Pacers are available from 37:30 to 60 minutes. Bib pickup opens the day before the race. Lilla Hässelbyloppet offers timing for participants aged 9 and over, and refreshments and snacks after the finish. Hässelbyloppet starts in a large field about 400 metres from Hässelby Idrottsplats. Lilla Hässelbyloppet has bibs and timing for participants aged 9 and over. The start and finish are at Hässelby IP, Loviselundsvägen 100. The official website lists 3 October 2027 as the date of Hässelbyloppet.

name: Nummela BackYard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra on ultramaratonjuoksutapahtuma, jossa kilpailijat juoksevat 6,706 kilometrin kierroksia tunnin sisällä niin kauan kuin useat juoksijat pystyvät jatkamaan. Kilpailu on ainutlaatuinen, koska sillä ei ole ennalta määrättyä loppuaikaa tai -matkaa, ja voittaja on se, joka juoksee yhden kierroksen enemmän kuin muut. Tapahtuma järjestetään Polku-hotellissa Vihtissä ja tarjoaa haastetta sitkeydestä ja kestävyyttä arvostaville juoksijoille. Kilpailun juuret ovat Yhdysvalloissa, ja se tunnetaan myös nimellä "Just one more Loop".

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run is a unique trail race in Sollentuna, focused on the experience of darkness and nature. The race offers several distances, including a challenging 30 km course where runners navigate using GPS and a map. The start and finish are at Väsby gård, and the course is marked with reflectors to create a magical atmosphere in the glow of headlamps. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, with special rules for younger participants on the shorter distances.
course_highlights: Course marked with clear reflectors for a night-running experience
Navigation using GPS and a map on the 21 km and 30 km distances
Start and finish at Väsby gård in Sollentuna
additional: Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 for the 5 km and 10 km. The 21 km and 30 km races start on Saturday, 17 October, at 16:45 and 16:00, respectively. Minimum age is 18, but participants aged 15–18 may run the 5 km and 10 km if accompanied by an adult. A proper headlamp is recommended, ideally with an extra lamp for the 30 km. The time limit for the 30 km is 4 hours and 30 minutes. Aid stations are available along the 21 km and 30 km courses. Previous organizer information states an age limit of 18 and a time limit of 4 hours and 30 minutes for the 30 km. Details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: 53. Saaremaa kolme päeva jooks
description: The Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running event in Kuressaare, inviting all running enthusiasts to take part. The competition offers several distance options and age groups, with opportunities for both young people and adults. Registration takes place on site, and the entry fee is affordable, making the event accessible to a wide range of participants. The competition is part of a larger running series, which also includes season standings and an awards ceremony.

name: Hiidenkierros
description: Hiidenkierros on polkujuoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään Neitvuoren alueella Mikkelissä. Reitit kulkevat kauniissa järvimaisemissa ja teknisillä poluilla, tarjoten juoksijoille vaihtelevia maastoja, kuten kallioita ja metsälampien rantoja. Kilpailukeskuksena toimii idyllinen Hiidenmaan tila, joka luo tapahtumalle ainutlaatuisen tunnelman. Tapahtuma sopii monentasoisille juoksijoille ja tarjoaa myös lapsille oman 4 km matkan.

name: Saaremaa Kolme Päeva Jooks
description: Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running competition held in the village of Iide. The competition consists of three stages, where participants can enjoy Saaremaa’s beautiful nature and varied terrain. The competition is open to different age groups and offers a friendly, supportive atmosphere for all running enthusiasts. Participants are provided with electronic timing, reusable race bibs and drinking cups, and a sweet treat and a drink after the run.

name: Vistakulle Backyard
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organised by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is aimed at people who are a little adventurous and interested in fitness, and places as much emphasis on the experience of nature as on performance. The event takes place on 16 May 2026 and offers a memorable course through hilly terrain close to nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baueractivities.se/loppen/vistakulle-backyard/): 2026-10-17 — "17 Oktober 2026 07.00-19.00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event offering a wonderful day at Hellasgården, close to the city. The races pass through the beautiful Hellas area, by lakes and hills, along lovely running trails and roads. There are races for all ages, from the very youngest children, who can run 100 metres without registering in advance, to children aged 5–8 on a flat course. The day offers the joy of running, uphill sections, music and a lovely autumn setting, with refreshments and activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: Races through the Hellas area, with lakes and hills
Lovely running trails and roads
Flat course for children aged 5–8
additional: The first race starts at 10:00, and the final start for the 10 km race is expected around 12:00. There is plenty of parking and bicycle parking by the start area. Prize ceremonies take place throughout the day. Athletics activities are available on site, with stations where you can try running, throwing and jumping. All children born in 2022 or later can run 100 m without registering in advance and will receive a medal. Refreshments are available throughout the day. The first race starts at 10:00, and the 10 km race is expected to start around 12:00. The 100-metre race for the youngest children does not require advance registration. Parking is available, and refreshments are served.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run Hundtrail is a unique evening race in Sollentuna where you can run with your dog over 5 or 10 kilometres. The courses are marked with reflectors, and headlamps are mandatory to create a magical nighttime experience. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, but young people aged 15 to 18 may participate if accompanied by an adult. It is an unforgettable evening enjoyed by both two- and four-legged participants.
course_highlights: The courses are marked with reflectors
Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 (until 19:00 for 10 km)
Headlamps are mandatory, and dogs must be kept on a leash
additional: A maximum of one dog per runner. Age limit: 18; participants aged 15–18 may take part accompanied by an adult. Dogs must be kept on a leash and be comfortable around other dogs and people. The race takes place in the dark, with narrow passages and frequent encounters with other dogs, so reactive dogs are not recommended. One dog per runner; dogs must be kept on a leash. Flexible start times: 18:00–19:30 for 5 km and 18:00–19:00 for 10 km. Age limit: 18; young people aged 15 and over may participate with a responsible adult.

name: Stockholms Brantaste

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Brantaste Mini kostar 200 kronor hela vägen fram till start.

description: Stockholms Brantaste is an intense, high-energy race that challenges you to run both up and down the steep slopes of Hammarbybacken. The course is just over 3 km long and includes three climbs, taking you up two different ski slopes. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to test their lactate threshold and mental toughness. The finish is at the top of Hammarbybacken, with a fantastic view of Stockholm as the backdrop.
course_highlights: Just over 3 km with three climbs
Uphill on two different ski slopes
Finish at the top of Hammarbybacken with views over Stockholm
additional: Race bib collection takes place at the Hammarby Fabriksväg event area from 09:30 on race day. The race bib is personal and must be worn on the chest with safety pins. There are water stations along the course. In the relay, teams complete 8 laps of approximately 1 km each, with 2–4 people per team. Children’s races are available for ages 7–12 (approximately 500 m) and ages 0–6 (approximately 300 m; registration via Skistar). The event area is easily accessible by public transport; parking is limited. The 2026 edition is listed as taking place on October 17; information about the 2027 race has not yet been confirmed in the available sources. The relay covers approximately 8 km for teams of 2–4 people. Brantaste Mini is approximately 500 metres for children aged 7–12, and Valles Kompislopp is approximately 300 metres for children aged 0–6. The start and finish are at Hammarbybacken; the organiser recommends public transport because there is no parking at the slope.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 75 kr

description: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026 is a unique running event celebrating its 5th anniversary. The race consists of a 6,706-metre loop starting at Bubblan in Toredal and running on asphalt and gravel. Participants run as many loops as they can manage over twelve hours, with a start every hour on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00. To continue, runners must complete each loop in under an hour, and the most enduring runner who is fastest on the final loop wins. There are women’s and men’s categories, as well as a MiniBackyard for children and young people who want to run shorter distances.
course_highlights: The loop is 6,706 metres long, with approximately 80% asphalt and 20% gravel
The course includes several longer climbs, including towards Sandbäcksvägen and the promenade
Start and finish at Bubblan in Toredal, with a final flat asphalt stretch leading to the grass field
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00, with up to 12 loops over twelve hours. Runners must complete each loop in under an hour to continue. MiniBackyard starts at 14:00 and lasts for a maximum of 45 minutes. Registration for MiniBackyard takes place on site. Coffee and refreshments are served at 20:00 after the final loop. The first start is at 09:00 and the last start is at 20:00. There is also a MiniBackyard with a loop of at least 670 metres; on-site registration costs 75 kr.

name: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė
description: The Graužikai–Kelmė Run is a traditional race in Kelmė District held in memory of Vaidotas Rimkus. The event takes place in October and aims to promote running and athletics in Lithuania, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and increase physical activity among local residents. It attracts runners of all ages, who can choose from several distances, including the 8 km main race. Participants are awarded cups, medals, and commemorative prizes.

name: Krusensterni jooks
description: The Krusenstern Run is a traditional running race that starts at the Purila bus stop and finishes at Hagudi Manor. The race is 4.2 km long and is suitable for schoolchildren, pensioners and adults. The top men and women are awarded prizes, with special prizes also awarded to veteran athletes, the youngest and oldest finishers, and the largest family. Participants take part at their own risk, and all finishers are offered water, a treat and hot tea.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is a fast, easy-to-run half marathon in scenic surroundings, starting and finishing at Näsby Castle. The course offers coastal views along the shores of Värtan, a scenic loop around Lake Rönninge, and a finish back by the sea with views towards Bogesundlandet. The course is officially measured and the race is organized by Täby IS Friidrott. It is ideal for runners looking to end the season on a fast and beautiful course. The race has been very popular in previous years, with limited places, so the organizers encourage early registration.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen—perhaps autumn’s fastest officially measured 10K, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on cycle paths and footpaths and is fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for those chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.

name: Pukinmaki Run Helsinki 18.10.2026
description: Pukinmäki Run on vuosittain Helsingissä Pukinmäen kaupunginosassa järjestettävä juoksutapahtuma, joka tarjoaa matkoja 1 km lapsille, 5 km, 10 km ja puolimaratonin. Reitti on tasainen ja nopea, pääosin asfalttia ja ulkoiluteitä, ja se kiertää Pukinmäen rajoja. Tapahtuma on avoin kaikenikäisille ja -tasoisille juoksijoille, ja se tarjoaa mahdollisuuden nauttia liikunnasta ja kauniista luonnosta yhdessä muiden kanssa. Kisakeskus sijaitsee Pukinmäen urheilupuistossa, ja tapahtumassa on tarjolla virvokkeita ja välipaloja.

name: Emili jookseb
description: Emili Runs is a cheerful school community running event held in Kadriorg Park in autumn, with students, teachers and parents taking part. The focus is on the joy of movement and supporting one another, not on speed. This traditional event fosters a sense of togetherness and offers the community enjoyable moments of exercise in the fresh air. The first run took place amid golden leaves and was an inspiring start to the school holiday.

name: Älvsjöloppet night trail
location: Gamla Älvsjö IP, Älvsjö, Stockholm, Sweden
price_range: 250 kr; gratis för medlemmar i OK Älvsjö-Örby
description: Älvsjöloppet Night Trail is an exciting 5 km evening race through hilly terrain in Älvsjöskogen, with 150 metres of elevation gain. The start and finish are at Gamla Älvsjö IP, about a 15-minute walk from Älvsjö station. The course is marked with reflective markers and requires a bright headlamp, preferably at least 1,000 lumens, as well as good trail shoes to handle the terrain. After the finish, all runners are offered a sausage and a drink in a friendly atmosphere. The race is organised by OK Älvsjö Örby and is open to everyone, with free entry for club members.
course_highlights: 5 km reflective-marked course through hilly terrain, with 150 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at Gamla Älvsjö IP, near Älvsjö station
Requires a bright headlamp and trail shoes with good grip
additional: Race bibs and timing chips are handed out from 18.15 to 18.45. The chip must be returned at the finish. Toilets and changing rooms are available at the venue. Parking is available in the area and at Herr Stens väg 2, but walking, cycling or running to the start is recommended. Live results and the results list are available at alvsjoloppet.se. Sausages and drinks are offered to all runners after the finish; no other refreshments are available. The start and finish are at Gamla Älvsjö IP. The organiser's published information applies to 2026 and does not give confirmed details for 2027. For 2026, a headlamp of at least 1,000 lumens and trail shoes, preferably with metal studs, are recommended.

name: Ambla SK SV suusatajate seeriajooks+kepikõnd
description: Ambla SK SV Skiers’ Series Run + Nordic Walking is a multi-stage running and Nordic walking series held at Kangrumägi in Järva County. The competition consists of five stages: the first four are time trials, and the final stage is a mass-start run. The results of the best four stages count toward the series standings, and prizes are awarded by age group. The competition is intended for runners using ski poles, which can be borrowed if needed. Special prizes are awarded to those who complete the series.
course_highlights: Five stages: the first four are time trials, and the final stage is a mass-start run
Held at Kangrumägi in Järva County
Only runners using ski poles are included in the competition standings
additional: Only runners using ski poles are included in the competition standings. Ski poles can be borrowed if needed. Every runner or Nordic walker who completes all five stages receives a special prize. Age groups range from age 6 to 55+. Points are awarded as follows: 1st place 30 points, 2nd place 27 points, 3rd place 25 points, and so on. In the event of a tie, the placing in the final stage decides. The fifth stage is scheduled for 8 November 2026, starting at 12:00. The best four stage results count toward the series standings.

name: 3. Holstre-Polli ööjooks
location: Holstre-Polli Sports Centre, Holstre, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: The 3rd Holstre-Polli Night Run takes place on the health and ski trails of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre in Viljandi County. This night run gives participants the chance to experience the wilderness and tranquillity surrounding the sports centre. The event is part of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre’s sports event series and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners. Participants can enjoy a unique night-running experience amid beautiful nature.

name: Tõstamaa jooks
location: Tõstamaa Keskkool, Tõstamaa, Pärnu County, Estonia

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is one of Östergötland’s most unique and challenging running races, held at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope in Yxbacken, Norrköping. The race challenges participants with five laps up a hill with 100 metres of elevation gain over 350 metres, for a total distance of approximately 7 kilometres. Whether you run fast or take it easy, everyone is welcome to take part, and the most important thing is to make it to the top. New this year is also a relay, adding an extra dimension to the race. Children can take part for free in the Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C, making it a family-friendly running festival.
course_highlights: Five laps up Yxbacken, with 100 metres of elevation gain over 350 metres per lap
Approximately 7 kilometres in a unique race setting in Östergötland
Start at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope
additional: Race bibs can be collected at XXL on Friday 23 October from 14:00 to 18:00, or at the start and finish area no later than one hour before the start. The bib includes a timing chip, which must be used to record your time. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal sponsored by Energi & Inneklimat. Companies can rent a partner tent at the race venue for team spirit and exposure through Rent a Tent. E2C was title partner for the fourth year in the 2024 edition.

name: VSM terräng

late_fee.price: 530 kr för seniorer och veteraner, 430 kr för juniorer och ungdomar

description: The Swedish Cross Country Championships are organised by Västerås FK and the Swedish Athletics Federation at Rocklunda IP in Västerås. The course is 2 km long and consists mostly of grass, with some other surfaces, including fast-running grass and gravel paths. The competition includes several categories, including seniors, youth, masters and para-athletes, with individual races and team competitions. The event also offers the option of pre-booked lunch and good accommodation options close to the venue.
course_highlights: 2 km course consisting mostly of grass, with some other surfaces
Fast-running grass and a 2–3-metre-wide gravel path, crossed four times per lap
Hay-bale obstacles on parts of the course
additional: Race numbers must be collected at the start/finish area at least 60 minutes before the start. Access to the start area opens 10 minutes before the start and closes 2 minutes before. Water is available at the lap point and finish, with Dextrosol at the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available at Expandia Arena. Free parking and local buses are available. Clubs may set up their own tents in the designated area. Pre-booked lunch is served at Good Morning Hotels near the venue. Doping tests may be conducted during the competition weekend. The 2026 event took place at Rocklunda IP in Västerås. The organiser’s website states that Västerås FK handed over hosting duties for the 2027 Swedish Cross Country Championships to Mora.

name: Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail
description: Welcome to the second edition of Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail, a unique and exciting running event in the autumn darkness of Kråksångsskogen. The race consists of 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes allowed for each lap. After the sixth lap, runners change direction, adding an extra dimension to the competition. This is a small-scale race with a limited number of places, and a headlamp is mandatory because almost the entire race takes place in the dark. All participants who complete at least one lap receive a beautiful wooden medal, and the winners receive unique winner’s medals.
course_highlights: 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes per lap
Running direction changes after the sixth lap
The course is marked with reflective markers and trail tape; the surface is mostly trails, with approximately 700 metres of gravel
additional: Energy is served during laps 7 and 8 (pizza from a local pizzeria), along with sweets, bananas, crisps, coffee, hot broth, sports drink and water. Facilities are very limited, with self-service energy, a warm fire and approximately 25 sq m of covered shelter. Toilets are outdoors in the forest. Maximum 70 places. Each lap starts every 30 minutes, and anyone who completes a lap faster can rest for the remaining time before the next lap starts. A headlamp and mobile phone are listed as mandatory equipment. The race website lists 70 places.

name: Pärnu Rannajooks
description: Pärnu Beach Run is the season-ending race and final event in the Pärnu Two Bridges Club’s three-event series. It takes place at Pärnu Beach Stadium. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, which can be completed by running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles. The course runs through the beautiful Pärnu beach area, offering natural scenery and architectural landmarks characteristic of the city, including the seaside promenade. The event is suitable for recreational and experienced runners alike and offers an enjoyable sporting experience.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances, available for running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles
Course through Pärnu’s beach area, with beautiful natural scenery and architectural landmarks
Seaside promenade with views of the sea
additional: The distance options are 5 km and 10 km, which can be completed by running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles. The race is part of the Pärnu Two Bridges Club’s three-event series. Children’s races and virtual race distances are also planned. The event includes virtual races and children’s races and takes place at Pärnu Beach Stadium, offering a chance to enjoy sport and nature together.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is a long-running running race celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026. The race is organized by Boxholm-Ekeby Ski Club and takes place at Boxholm ski stadium. It is a popular event for runners of all ages and abilities, with a scenic and challenging course. More information and registration will be available closer to race day.
course_highlights: Scenic route around the Sjögarp area
Challenging 14 km course with a course profile available
The race takes place at Boxholm ski stadium
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. Links to the invitation, race information, start list and preliminary results from previous years are available. A course profile and map are available for runners. The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. The gathering is scheduled for 09:30.

name: Löfstad Slott Trail
description: Löfstad Castle Trail is an atmospheric trail race held in the autumn darkness around the historic Löfstad Castle. The race offers a unique running experience as participants run through the castle park, along forest trails and over unmarked terrain lit by headlamps. The event consists of two races: the Little Twilight Race for children in the park and Löfstad’s Darkest, a 7-kilometre night race for adults. Löfstad Castle Trail combines nature, history and community in a beautiful and challenging setting.
course_highlights: 7 km night race on gravel roads, trails and unmarked forest terrain
The course is marked with reflectors and course tape
Little Twilight Race: 1,000 metres in the park, with no timing
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 15:00 at the castle courtyard. Löfstad’s Darkest starts at 17:00 and requires a headlamp and trail shoes. The Little Twilight Race is a children’s race with no timing, and all participants receive a prize. The joint awards ceremony takes place after the races. On-site registration is available.
